tools.name: get_hiring_runtime_gate
tools.description: Read the public Hiring intake availability gate. An authorised owner or recruiter can change it with set_hiring_runtime_gate.
tools.sql: SELECT intake_status, reason_code, updated_at FROM hiring_runtime_gate WHERE id = 1 LIMIT 1

tools.name: set_hiring_runtime_gate
tools.description: Audited control for opening or closing authenticated candidate application intake. Brand owners and recruiters may operate it.
statements: UPDATE hiring_runtime_gate SET intake_status=:intake_status,reason_code=CASE WHEN :intake_status='open' THEN 'staff_authorized' ELSE 'staff_closed' END,updated_at=:__now WHERE id=1 AND :intake_status IN ('open','closed') AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND p.requisition_id IS NULL)

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at,object_type,object_id,redacted_summary) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,NULL,CASE WHEN :intake_status='open' THEN 'intake.opened' ELSE 'intake.closed' END,:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now,'runtime_gate','1',CASE WHEN :intake_status='open' THEN 'Authenticated candidate intake enabled' ELSE 'Candidate intake disabled' END WHERE changes()=1

tools.name: list_my_workspaces
tools.description: list my workspaces
tools.sql: SELECT DISTINCT o.id AS organization_id,o.name AS organization_name,b.id AS brand_id,b.name AS brand_name,m.role,EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=o.id AND p.brand_id=b.id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AS can_manage_templates,EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=o.id AND p.brand_id=b.id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AS can_create_requisition,(o.created_by=:__user_id) AS can_create_brand FROM hiring_effective_access m JOIN hiring_organizations o ON o.id=m.organization_id JOIN hiring_brands b ON b.id=m.brand_id WHERE m.user_id=:__user_id ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 100

tools.name: get_my_workspace
tools.description: Resolve one exact authorized organization/brand workspace. Missing and denied IDs both return no rows.
tools.sql: SELECT DISTINCT o.id AS organization_id,o.name AS organization_name,b.id AS brand_id,b.name AS brand_name,m.role,EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=o.id AND p.brand_id=b.id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AS can_manage_templates,EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=o.id AND p.brand_id=b.id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AS can_create_requisition,(o.created_by=:__user_id) AS can_create_brand FROM hiring_effective_access m JOIN hiring_organizations o ON o.id=m.organization_id JOIN hiring_brands b ON b.id=m.brand_id WHERE m.user_id=:__user_id AND o.id=:organization_id AND (:brand_id IS NULL OR b.id=:brand_id) AND (:owner_only IS NULL OR :owner_only=0 OR m.role='owner') ORDER BY CASE m.role WHEN 'owner' THEN 0 WHEN 'recruiter' THEN 1 WHEN 'reviewer' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,b.id LIMIT 1

tools.name: create_workspace
tools.description: Create an organization or add a brand and draft requisition to an organization created by the authenticated user
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_organizations(id,name,created_by,created_at) SELECT :organization_id,:organization_name,:__user_id,:__now WHERE length(trim(:organization_id))>0 AND length(trim(:brand_id))>0 AND length(trim(:requisition_id))>0 AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND length(trim(:organization_name))>0 AND length(trim(:brand_name))>0 AND length(trim(:requisition_title))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_brands WHERE id=:brand_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_requisitions WHERE id=:requisition_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships WHERE id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_brands(id,organization_id,name,created_at,operation_id) SELECT :brand_id,:organization_id,:brand_name,:__now,:operation_id FROM hiring_organizations WHERE id=:organization_id AND created_by=:__user_id AND status='active' AND length(trim(:organization_id))>0 AND length(trim(:brand_id))>0 AND length(trim(:requisition_id))>0 AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND length(trim(:organization_name))>0 AND length(trim(:brand_name))>0 AND length(trim(:requisition_title))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_brands WHERE id=:brand_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_requisitions WHERE id=:requisition_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships WHERE id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_requisitions(id,organization_id,brand_id,title,created_at,operation_id) SELECT :requisition_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:requisition_title,:__now,:operation_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_brands b JOIN hiring_organizations o ON o.id=b.organization_id WHERE b.id=:brand_id AND b.organization_id=:organization_id AND b.operation_id=:operation_id AND o.created_by=:__user_id AND o.status='active') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_memberships(id,organization_id,brand_id,user_id,role,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:__user_id,'owner',:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_brands b JOIN hiring_organizations o ON o.id=b.organization_id WHERE b.id=:brand_id AND b.organization_id=:organization_id AND b.operation_id=:operation_id AND o.created_by=:__user_id AND o.status='active') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,NULL,'workspace.created',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_brands b JOIN hiring_organizations o ON o.id=b.organization_id WHERE b.id=:brand_id AND b.organization_id=:organization_id AND b.operation_id=:operation_id AND o.created_by=:__user_id AND o.status='active') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships WHERE id=:operation_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND user_id=:__user_id AND role='owner') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1

tools.name: add_workspace_member
tools.description: Owner grants a PAS user ID recruiter access to this brand
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_memberships(id,organization_id,brand_id,user_id,role,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:member_user_id,:role,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=NULL) AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND :role='recruiter' AND :member_user_id<>:__user_id AND length(trim(:member_user_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,NULL,'membership.added',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=NULL) AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships WHERE id=:operation_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND user_id=:member_user_id AND role=:role) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1

tools.name: list_workspace_members
tools.description: list workspace members
tools.sql: SELECT user_id, role, created_at FROM hiring_effective_access WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=NULL) AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 100

tools.name: list_requisitions
tools.description: list requisitions
tools.sql: SELECT r.id,r.title,j.version AS expected_version,CASE WHEN j.lifecycle_status='expired' THEN 'expired' WHEN j.lifecycle_status='closed' OR j.status='closed' THEN 'closed' WHEN pc.paused=1 THEN 'paused' WHEN j.status='published' THEN 'published' ELSE 'draft' END AS status FROM hiring_requisitions r LEFT JOIN hiring_job_publications j ON j.requisition_id=r.id LEFT JOIN hiring_publication_controls pc ON pc.requisition_id=r.id WHERE r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=r.id)) ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT 100

tools.name: create_requisition
tools.description: Create a draft requisition for internal sourcing
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_requisitions(id,organization_id,brand_id,title,created_at,operation_id) SELECT :requisition_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:title,:__now,:operation_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=NULL) AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND length(trim(:title))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,NULL,'requisition.created',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=NULL) AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_requisitions WHERE id=:requisition_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND operation_id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1

tools.name: list_applications
tools.description: list applications
tools.sql: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_restricted_internships ri WHERE ri.requisition_id=a.requisition_id) AS is_internship,a.candidate_id,a.id,a.requisition_id,a.discord_handle,a.interns_app_id,a.interns_invite_status,a.interns_registration_status,COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage) AS stage,a.version,CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_intake_receipts ir WHERE ir.application_id=a.id AND ir.organization_id=a.organization_id AND ir.brand_id=a.brand_id) THEN 'direct' ELSE COALESCE((SELECT s.source FROM hiring_application_sources s WHERE s.application_id=a.id),a.source) END AS source,a.source_detail,a.basis_reference,a.contact_context,a.assignee_user_id,a.links_json,a.created_at,a.updated_at,c.name AS candidate_name,c.email,c.phone,COALESCE(c.linkedin_profile_url,NULLIF(c.linkedin_url,'')) AS linkedin_url,COALESCE((SELECT s.profile_url FROM hiring_application_sources s WHERE s.application_id=a.id),c.linkedin_profile_url,NULLIF(c.linkedin_url,'')) AS profile_url,r.title AS requisition_title FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id AND c.organization_id=a.organization_id AND c.brand_id=a.brand_id JOIN hiring_requisitions r ON r.id=a.requisition_id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id WHERE a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) AND (:stage IS NULL OR COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage)=:stage) AND (:requisition_id IS NULL OR a.requisition_id=:requisition_id) AND (:assignee IS NULL OR a.assignee_user_id=:assignee) AND (:source IS NULL OR (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_intake_receipts ir WHERE ir.application_id=a.id AND ir.organization_id=a.organization_id AND ir.brand_id=a.brand_id) THEN 'direct' ELSE COALESCE((SELECT s.source FROM hiring_application_sources s WHERE s.application_id=a.id),a.source) END)=:source) AND (:date_from IS NULL OR a.created_at>=:date_from) AND (:date_to IS NULL OR a.created_at<:date_to) AND (:onboarding IS NULL OR (SELECT ip.status FROM hiring_internship_progress ip WHERE ip.application_id=a.id AND ip.organization_id=a.organization_id AND ip.brand_id=a.brand_id ORDER BY ip.version DESC LIMIT 1)=:onboarding) AND (:invited_from IS NULL OR (SELECT MIN(ip.created_at) FROM hiring_internship_progress ip WHERE ip.application_id=a.id AND ip.organization_id=a.organization_id AND ip.brand_id=a.brand_id AND ip.status='invited')>=:invited_from) AND (:invited_to IS NULL OR (SELECT MIN(ip.created_at) FROM hiring_internship_progress ip WHERE ip.application_id=a.id AND ip.organization_id=a.organization_id AND ip.brand_id=a.brand_id AND ip.status='invited')<:invited_to) ORDER BY a.updated_at DESC LIMIT 100

tools.name: create_linkedin_application
tools.description: Record a LinkedIn sourced candidate and application with basis, contact context, assignment and audit
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_candidates(id,organization_id,brand_id,name,email,phone,linkedin_url,linkedin_profile_url,created_by,created_at) SELECT :candidate_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:candidate_name,NULLIF(:email,''),NULLIF(:phone,''),COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(:linkedin_url),''),''),NULLIF(trim(:linkedin_url),''),:__user_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=:requisition_id)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_requisitions WHERE id=:requisition_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AND (NULLIF(trim(:linkedin_url),'') IS NULL OR :linkedin_url LIKE 'https://www.linkedin.com/%' OR :linkedin_url LIKE 'https://linkedin.com/%') AND length(trim(:candidate_name))>0 AND length(trim(:basis_reference))>0 AND length(trim(:contact_context))>0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:assignee_user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter','reviewer') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=:requisition_id)) AND length(trim(:source_detail))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications WHERE id=:application_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events WHERE id=:operation_id) AND (coalesce(:links_json,'[]')='[]' OR (length(:links_json)<=22000 AND json_valid(:links_json) AND json_type(CASE WHEN json_valid(:links_json) THEN :links_json ELSE '[]' END)='array' AND json_array_length(CASE WHEN json_valid(:links_json) THEN :links_json ELSE '[]' END)<=10 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(:links_json) THEN :links_json ELSE '[]' END) link WHERE link.type<>'object' OR json_type(link.value,'$.url')<>'text' OR length(json_extract(link.value,'$.url')) NOT BETWEEN 8 AND 2000 OR NOT (lower(json_extract(link.value,'$.url')) LIKE 'https://_%' OR lower(json_extract(link.value,'$.url')) LIKE 'http://_%') OR json_extract(link.value,'$.url') GLOB '*[ '||char(9)||char(10)||char(13)||']*' OR instr(json_extract(link.value,'$.url'),'@')>0 OR substr(json_extract(link.value,'$.url'),instr(json_extract(link.value,'$.url'),'://')+3,1) NOT GLOB '[A-Za-z0-9]' OR (json_type(link.value,'$.label') IS NOT NULL AND (json_type(link.value,'$.label')<>'text' OR length(json_extract(link.value,'$.label'))>100)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(link.value) field WHERE field.key NOT IN ('url','label'))))) AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_restricted_internships WHERE requisition_id=:requisition_id) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_internship_requisitions WHERE requisition_id=:requisition_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AND length(trim(:email)) BETWEEN 3 AND 254 AND instr(:email,'@')>1 AND (('recruiter_sourced'='recruiter_sourced' AND coalesce(:campaign_id,'')='') OR ('recruiter_sourced'='linkedin_campaign' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_internship_campaigns WHERE id=:campaign_id AND requisition_id=:requisition_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND enabled=1)))))

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_applications(id,organization_id,brand_id,requisition_id,candidate_id,source,source_detail,basis_reference,contact_context,assignee_user_id,stage,version,created_by,created_at,updated_at,links_json) SELECT :application_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:requisition_id,:candidate_id,'linkedin',:source_detail||CASE WHEN coalesce(:campaign_id,'')<>'' THEN ' [campaign:'||:campaign_id||']' ELSE '' END,:basis_reference,:contact_context,:assignee_user_id,'submitted',1,:__user_id,:__now,:__now,coalesce(:links_json,'[]') WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=:requisition_id)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_requisitions WHERE id=:requisition_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AND length(trim(:source_detail))>0 AND length(trim(:basis_reference))>0 AND length(trim(:contact_context))>0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_candidates WHERE id=:candidate_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:assignee_user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter','reviewer') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=:requisition_id)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events WHERE id=:operation_id) AND (coalesce(:links_json,'[]')='[]' OR (length(:links_json)<=22000 AND json_valid(:links_json) AND json_type(CASE WHEN json_valid(:links_json) THEN :links_json ELSE '[]' END)='array' AND json_array_length(CASE WHEN json_valid(:links_json) THEN :links_json ELSE '[]' END)<=10 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(:links_json) THEN :links_json ELSE '[]' END) link WHERE link.type<>'object' OR json_type(link.value,'$.url')<>'text' OR length(json_extract(link.value,'$.url')) NOT BETWEEN 8 AND 2000 OR NOT (lower(json_extract(link.value,'$.url')) LIKE 'https://_%' OR lower(json_extract(link.value,'$.url')) LIKE 'http://_%') OR json_extract(link.value,'$.url') GLOB '*[ '||char(9)||char(10)||char(13)||']*' OR instr(json_extract(link.value,'$.url'),'@')>0 OR substr(json_extract(link.value,'$.url'),instr(json_extract(link.value,'$.url'),'://')+3,1) NOT GLOB '[A-Za-z0-9]' OR (json_type(link.value,'$.label') IS NOT NULL AND (json_type(link.value,'$.label')<>'text' OR length(json_extract(link.value,'$.label'))>100)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(link.value) field WHERE field.key NOT IN ('url','label'))))) AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_restricted_internships WHERE requisition_id=:requisition_id) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_internship_requisitions WHERE requisition_id=:requisition_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AND length(trim(:email)) BETWEEN 3 AND 254 AND instr(:email,'@')>1 AND (('recruiter_sourced'='recruiter_sourced' AND coalesce(:campaign_id,'')='') OR ('recruiter_sourced'='linkedin_campaign' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_internship_campaigns WHERE id=:campaign_id AND requisition_id=:requisition_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND enabled=1)))))

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_stage_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,from_stage,to_stage,version,reason,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,NULL,'submitted',1,'LinkedIn sourced',:__user_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=:requisition_id)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications WHERE id=:application_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'application.created',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=:requisition_id)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events WHERE id=:operation_id AND application_id=:application_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1

campaign_id.description: Configured LinkedIn ad campaign ID; omit for recruiter-sourced internship intake.

links_json.description: JSON array of up to ten {"url":"https://...","label":"optional"} links. URLs must use http or https. Omit for no links.

tools.name: change_application_stage
tools.description: Change stage using application-stages.json v1 edges, expected version, scoped owner/recruiter authority, operation deduplication and atomic history/audit
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_mutation_checks(kind,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,actor_user_id,expected_version,from_stage,to_stage,operation_id,reason) VALUES('stage',:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,:__user_id,:expected_version,:from_stage,:to_stage,:operation_id,:reason)

INSERT INTO hiring_decisions SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,a.requisition_id,a.id,:__user_id,(SELECT p.role FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id) ORDER BY p.role LIMIT 1),:to_stage,:reason,:__now,a.version,COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage),:operation_id FROM hiring_applications a WHERE id=:application_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND version=:expected_version AND COALESCE(workflow_stage,lifecycle_stage,accepted_stage,stage_extension,stage)=:from_stage AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 tools.description: Append an immutable, full-content Gmail record after an agent receives or sends candidate email; this does not send email Optional logical_email_id requires the exact scoped send claimant; conflicting links abort. Existing unlinked archives remain immutable; zero changes requires readback, never means success.
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_communication_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,direction,channel,from_email,to_email,subject,body,provider_message_id,provider_thread_id,occurred_at,actor_user_id,agent_instance_id,operation_id,created_at,logical_email_id) SELECT :communication_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,:direction,'gmail',:from_email,:to_email,:subject,:body,:provider_message_id,NULLIF(trim(:provider_thread_id),''),:occurred_at,:__user_id,:agent_instance_id,:operation_id,:__now,:logical_email_id FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND ((:direction='inbound' AND lower(trim(:from_email))=lower(trim(c.email))) OR (:direction='outbound' AND lower(trim(:to_email))=lower(trim(c.email)))) AND :direction IN ('inbound','outbound') AND length(trim(:from_email))>0 AND length(trim(:to_email))>0 AND length(trim(:subject))>0 AND length(:subject)<=200 AND length(trim(:body))>0 AND length(:body)<=50000 AND length(trim(:provider_message_id))>0 AND length(trim(:agent_instance_id))>0 AND :occurred_at>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0

tools.name: record_worker_candidate_email
tools.description: Append a full-content Cloudflare email-worker candidate email after an actual read/send; never sends mail. Keep the bridge message/thread IDs opaque and record Cloudflare receipt/event IDs separately when available. mailbox_address must equal inbound To or outbound From. Zero inserted rows means replay/conflict/refusal, never a newly archived message; verify using get_worker_candidate_email. Optional logical_email_id requires the exact scoped send claimant; conflicting links abort. Existing unlinked archives remain immutable; zero changes requires readback, never means success. Conflicting stored worker payloads abort, including unlinked correspondence; exact replays remain no-ops.
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_worker_communication_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,direction,channel,provider,mailbox_address,provider_connection_id,from_email,to_email,subject,body,provider_message_id,provider_thread_id,provider_receipt_id,provider_event_id,occurred_at,actor_user_id,agent_instance_id,operation_id,created_at,logical_email_id) SELECT :communication_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,:direction,'email-worker','cloudflare',lower(trim(:mailbox_address)),COALESCE(:provider_connection_id,''),:from_email,:to_email,:subject,:body,:provider_message_id,NULLIF(:provider_thread_id,''),NULLIF(:provider_receipt_id,''),NULLIF(:provider_event_id,''),:occurred_at,:__user_id,:agent_instance_id,:operation_id,:__now,:logical_email_id FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id AND c.organization_id=a.organization_id AND c.brand_id=a.brand_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND ((:direction='inbound' AND lower(trim(:from_email))=lower(trim(c.email)) AND lower(trim(:to_email))=lower(trim(:mailbox_address))) OR (:direction='outbound' AND lower(trim(:to_email))=lower(trim(c.email)) AND lower(trim(:from_email))=lower(trim(:mailbox_address)))) AND :direction IN ('inbound','outbound') AND length(trim(:communication_id))>0 AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND length(trim(:mailbox_address)) BETWEEN 3 AND 254 AND instr(:mailbox_address,'@')>1 AND length(trim(:from_email))>0 AND length(trim(:to_email))>0 AND length(trim(:subject))>0 AND length(:subject)<=200 AND length(trim(:body))>0 AND length(:body)<=50000 AND length(trim(:provider_message_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND length(COALESCE(:provider_connection_id,''))<=2000 AND length(COALESCE(:provider_thread_id,''))<=2000 AND length(COALESCE(:provider_receipt_id,''))<=2000 AND length(COALESCE(:provider_event_id,''))<=2000 AND length(trim(:agent_instance_id))>0 AND :occurred_at>0 AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_worker_communication_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id))

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,CASE WHEN :direction='inbound' THEN 'communication.email_received' ELSE 'communication.email_sent' END,:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_worker_communication_events WHERE id=:communication_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND application_id=:application_id AND operation_id=:operation_id AND actor_user_id=:__user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND changes()=1

tools.name: get_worker_candidate_email
tools.description: Read back one Cloudflare email-worker record by exact operation ID for a granted application; verify stored provider, mailbox and opaque IDs before treating a replay as recorded. Does not contact Cloudflare or verify delivery.
tools.sql: SELECT e.logical_email_id,e.id,e.direction,e.channel,e.provider,e.mailbox_address,e.provider_connection_id,e.from_email,e.to_email,e.subject,e.body,e.provider_message_id,e.provider_thread_id,e.provider_receipt_id,e.provider_event_id,e.occurred_at,e.actor_user_id,e.agent_instance_id,e.operation_id,e.created_at FROM hiring_worker_communication_events e WHERE e.organization_id=:organization_id AND e.brand_id=:brand_id AND e.application_id=:application_id AND e.operation_id=:operation_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) LIMIT 1

tools.name: record_agent_activity
tools.description: Append an immutable audit record after the agent crawls a candidate profile, search result, or email thread; this does not crawl or send
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_agent_activity(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,activity_type,source_url,summary,occurred_at,actor_user_id,agent_instance_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :activity_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,:activity_type,:source_url,:summary,:occurred_at,:__user_id,:agent_instance_id,:operation_id,:__now FROM hiring_applications a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND :activity_type IN ('candidate_profile_crawled','candidate_search_crawled','email_thread_scanned') AND :source_url LIKE 'https://%' AND length(trim(:summary))>0 AND length(:summary)<=5000 AND length(trim(:agent_instance_id))>0 AND :occurred_at>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'agent.' || :activity_type,:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_agent_activity WHERE id=:activity_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND application_id=:application_id AND operation_id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1

tools.name: list_application_communications
tools.description: List inbound and outbound Gmail and Cloudflare email-worker records for a granted application, preserving their real provider and receipt IDs
tools.sql: SELECT logical_email_id,id,direction,channel,'gmail' AS provider,NULL AS mailbox_address,NULL AS provider_connection_id,from_email,to_email,subject,body,provider_message_id,provider_thread_id,NULL AS provider_receipt_id,NULL AS provider_event_id,occurred_at,actor_user_id,agent_instance_id,operation_id,created_at FROM hiring_communication_events WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND application_id=:application_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) UNION ALL SELECT logical_email_id,id,direction,channel,provider,mailbox_address,provider_connection_id,from_email,to_email,subject,body,provider_message_id,provider_thread_id,provider_receipt_id,provider_event_id,occurred_at,actor_user_id,agent_instance_id,operation_id,created_at FROM hiring_worker_communication_events WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND application_id=:application_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) ORDER BY occurred_at DESC,id ASC LIMIT 100

tools.name: list_application_agent_activity
tools.description: List the immutable agent crawl and email-thread activity for a granted application
tools.sql: SELECT id,activity_type,source_url,summary,occurred_at,actor_user_id,agent_instance_id,created_at FROM hiring_agent_activity WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND application_id=:application_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT 100

tools.name: list_application_audit
tools.description: list application audit
tools.sql: SELECT action,actor_user_id,created_at,operation_id FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND application_id=:application_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter' ,'auditor') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100

tools.name: gateway_list_applications
tools.description: Gateway: paginated, redacted applications for a granted brand. Keyset cursor (cursor_at, cursor_id); 25 per page; no contact details or free text
tools.sql: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_restricted_internships ri WHERE ri.requisition_id=a.requisition_id) AS is_internship,a.id,a.requisition_id,COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage) AS stage,a.version,CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_intake_receipts ir WHERE ir.application_id=a.id AND ir.organization_id=a.organization_id AND ir.brand_id=a.brand_id) THEN 'direct' ELSE COALESCE((SELECT s.source FROM hiring_application_sources s WHERE s.application_id=a.id),a.source) END AS source,a.assignee_user_id,a.created_at,a.updated_at,c.name AS candidate_name,(c.email IS NOT NULL AND c.email<>'') AS has_email,(c.phone IS NOT NULL AND c.phone<>'') AS has_phone,(COALESCE(c.linkedin_profile_url,NULLIF(c.linkedin_url,'')) IS NOT NULL) AS has_linkedin,r.title AS requisition_title FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id AND c.organization_id=a.organization_id AND c.brand_id=a.brand_id JOIN hiring_requisitions r ON r.id=a.requisition_id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id WHERE a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter' ,'reviewer') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id) AND (p.role<>'reviewer' OR a.assignee_user_id=:__user_id)) AND (:cursor_at IS NULL OR a.updated_at < :cursor_at OR (a.updated_at = :cursor_at AND a.id > :cursor_id)) AND (:stage IS NULL OR COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage)=:stage) AND (:requisition_id IS NULL OR a.requisition_id=:requisition_id) AND (:assignee IS NULL OR a.assignee_user_id=:assignee) AND (:source IS NULL OR (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_intake_receipts ir WHERE ir.application_id=a.id AND ir.organization_id=a.organization_id AND ir.brand_id=a.brand_id) THEN 'direct' ELSE COALESCE((SELECT s.source FROM hiring_application_sources s WHERE s.application_id=a.id),a.source) END)=:source) AND (:date_from IS NULL OR a.created_at>=:date_from) AND (:date_to IS NULL OR a.created_at<:date_to) AND (:onboarding IS NULL OR (SELECT ip.status FROM hiring_internship_progress ip WHERE ip.application_id=a.id AND ip.organization_id=a.organization_id AND ip.brand_id=a.brand_id ORDER BY ip.version DESC LIMIT 1)=:onboarding) AND (:invited_from IS NULL OR (SELECT MIN(ip.created_at) FROM hiring_internship_progress ip WHERE ip.application_id=a.id AND ip.organization_id=a.organization_id AND ip.brand_id=a.brand_id AND ip.status='invited')>=:invited_from) AND (:invited_to IS NULL OR (SELECT MIN(ip.created_at) FROM hiring_internship_progress ip WHERE ip.application_id=a.id AND ip.organization_id=a.organization_id AND ip.brand_id=a.brand_id AND ip.status='invited')<:invited_to) ORDER BY a.updated_at DESC, a.id ASC LIMIT 25

tools.name: gateway_get_application
tools.description: Gateway: one redacted application for a granted brand; not-granted and missing both return no row
tools.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access g WHERE g.user_id=:__user_id AND g.organization_id=a.organization_id AND g.brand_id=a.brand_id AND g.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (g.requisition_id IS NULL OR g.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) THEN COALESCE(a.workflow_acceptance_evidence,a.acceptance_evidence) ELSE NULL END AS acceptance_evidence,a.id,a.requisition_id,COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage) AS stage,a.version,CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_intake_receipts ir WHERE ir.application_id=a.id AND ir.organization_id=a.organization_id AND ir.brand_id=a.brand_id) THEN 'direct' ELSE COALESCE((SELECT s.source FROM hiring_application_sources s WHERE s.application_id=a.id),a.source) END AS source,a.assignee_user_id,a.links_json,a.created_at,a.updated_at,c.name AS candidate_name,(c.email IS NOT NULL AND c.email<>'') AS has_email,(c.phone IS NOT NULL AND c.phone<>'') AS has_phone,(COALESCE(c.linkedin_profile_url,NULLIF(c.linkedin_url,'')) IS NOT NULL) AS has_linkedin,r.title AS requisition_title FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id AND c.organization_id=a.organization_id AND c.brand_id=a.brand_id JOIN hiring_requisitions r ON r.id=a.requisition_id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id WHERE a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter' ,'reviewer') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id) AND (p.role<>'reviewer' OR a.assignee_user_id=:__user_id)) AND a.id=:application_id LIMIT 1

tools.name: gateway_list_requisitions
tools.description: Gateway: paginated requisitions for a granted brand. Keyset cursor (cursor_at, cursor_id); 25 per page
tools.sql: SELECT r.id,r.title,CASE WHEN j.lifecycle_status='expired' THEN 'expired' WHEN j.lifecycle_status='closed' OR j.status='closed' THEN 'closed' WHEN pc.paused=1 THEN 'paused' WHEN j.status='published' THEN 'published' ELSE 'draft' END AS status,r.created_at FROM hiring_requisitions r LEFT JOIN hiring_job_publications j ON j.requisition_id=r.id LEFT JOIN hiring_publication_controls pc ON pc.requisition_id=r.id WHERE r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=r.id)) AND (:cursor_at IS NULL OR r.created_at < :cursor_at OR (r.created_at = :cursor_at AND r.id > :cursor_id)) ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id ASC LIMIT 25

tools.name: gateway_get_requisition
tools.description: Gateway: one requisition for a granted brand; not-granted and missing both return no row
tools.sql: SELECT r.id,r.title,CASE WHEN j.lifecycle_status='expired' THEN 'expired' WHEN j.lifecycle_status='closed' OR j.status='closed' THEN 'closed' WHEN pc.paused=1 THEN 'paused' WHEN j.status='published' THEN 'published' ELSE 'draft' END AS status,r.created_at FROM hiring_requisitions r LEFT JOIN hiring_job_publications j ON j.requisition_id=r.id LEFT JOIN hiring_publication_controls pc ON pc.requisition_id=r.id WHERE r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND r.id=:requisition_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=r.id)) LIMIT 1

tools.name: publish_job_requisition
tools.description: Publish immutable job and notice snapshot. Brand owners and recruiters can publish approved content.
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_job_publications(requisition_id,organization_id,brand_id,description,location,arrangement,compensation,notice_version,notice_text,contact,compensation_type,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :requisition_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:description,:location,:arrangement,:compensation,:notice_version,:notice_text,:contact,coalesce(:compensation_type,'unspecified'),:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now FROM hiring_requisitions r WHERE r.id=:requisition_id AND r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=NULL) AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:description)) BETWEEN 1 AND 20000 AND length(trim(:location)) BETWEEN 1 AND 300 AND length(trim(:arrangement)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND length(trim(:compensation)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND length(trim(:notice_version)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND length(trim(:notice_text)) BETWEEN 1 AND 20000 AND length(trim(:contact)) BETWEEN 1 AND 300 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_job_publications WHERE requisition_id=:requisition_id) AND coalesce(:compensation_type,'unspecified') IN ('unspecified','paid','unpaid','internship','volunteer') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_requisition_reviews v WHERE v.requisition_id=r.id AND (v.state!='pending_review' OR v.payload!=json_object('description',:description,'location',:location,'arrangement',:arrangement,'compensation',:compensation,'notice_version',:notice_version,'notice_text',:notice_text,'contact',:contact,'compensation_type',coalesce(:compensation_type,'unspecified')))) AND (:expected_terms_version IS NULL OR :expected_terms_version=(SELECT version FROM hiring_current_vacancy_terms WHERE requisition_id=r.id))

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,NULL,'requisition.published',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE changes()=1

tools.name: close_job_requisition
tools.description: Close publication with version and audit; legacy draft requisition remains compatible.
statements: UPDATE hiring_job_publications SET status='closed',lifecycle_status='closed',version=version+1 WHERE requisition_id=:requisition_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND version=:expected_version AND (status='published' OR lifecycle_status='expired') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=NULL) AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id)

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,NULL,'requisition.closed',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE changes()=1

tools.sql: SELECT display_name,created_at,updated_at FROM hiring_worker_profiles WHERE user_id=:__user_id LIMIT 1

tools.name: submit_job_application
tools.description: Candidate-facing intake: signed-in candidate, no recruiter membership required. Exact published scope, honeypot, validation, per-candidate rate limits, candidate/requisition deduplication and atomic consent/receipt/history/audit.

links_json.description: JSON array of up to ten {"url":"https://...","label":"optional"} links. URLs must use http or https. Omit for no links.

statements: INSERT INTO hiring_candidates(id,organization_id,brand_id,name,email,phone,linkedin_url,created_by,created_at,worker_user_id) SELECT :candidate_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:candidate_name,lower(trim(:email)),NULLIF(:phone,''),'',:__user_id,:__now,:__user_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_runtime_gate WHERE id=1 AND intake_status='open') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_worker_profiles WHERE user_id=:__user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_job_publications j JOIN hiring_organizations o ON o.id=j.organization_id WHERE j.requisition_id=:requisition_id AND j.organization_id=:organization_id AND j.brand_id=:brand_id AND j.status='published' AND coalesce(j.lifecycle_status,'published')='published' AND (j.expiry_date IS NULL OR j.expiry_date>:__now) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_publication_controls pc WHERE pc.requisition_id=j.requisition_id AND pc.paused=1) AND j.version=:expected_version AND j.notice_version=:notice_version AND o.status='active') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND role='owner' AND requisition_id IS NULL) AND :notice_acknowledged=1 AND :talent_pool_consent IN (0,1) AND :communications_consent IN (0,1) AND length(trim(:candidate_name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND length(trim(:email)) BETWEEN 3 AND 254 AND instr(:email,'@')>1 AND length(:phone)<=100 AND length(:statement)<=10000 AND length(trim(:application_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND length(trim(:candidate_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND length(trim(:idempotency_key)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_intake_receipts WHERE worker_user_id=:__user_id AND idempotency_key=:idempotency_key) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_candidates WHERE id=:candidate_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications WHERE id=:application_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events WHERE id=:operation_id) AND (SELECT count(*) FROM hiring_intake_receipts WHERE worker_user_id=:__user_id AND created_at>:__now-86400000)<10 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_intake_receipts WHERE worker_user_id=:__user_id AND created_at>:__now-10000) AND COALESCE(:website,'')='' AND :__user_id IS NOT NULL AND length(:candidate_name)<=200 AND instr(:candidate_name,char(0))=0 AND :email=trim(:email) AND :email NOT GLOB '*[ '||char(9)||char(10)||char(13)||']*' AND instr(:email,char(0))=0 AND length(:email)-length(replace(:email,'@',''))=1 AND length(substr(:email,instr(:email,'@')+1))>=3 AND instr(substr(:email,instr(:email,'@')+1),'.')>1 AND substr(:email,-1)<>'.' AND instr(:phone,char(0))=0 AND instr(:statement,char(0))=0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_intake_receipts WHERE worker_user_id=:__user_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND requisition_id=:requisition_id) AND length(:application_id)<=128 AND instr(:application_id,char(0))=0 AND length(:candidate_id)<=128 AND instr(:candidate_id,char(0))=0 AND length(:idempotency_key)<=128 AND instr(:idempotency_key,char(0))=0 AND length(:operation_id)<=128 AND instr(:operation_id,char(0))=0 AND (coalesce(:links_json,'[]')='[]' OR (length(:links_json)<=22000 AND json_valid(:links_json) AND json_type(CASE WHEN json_valid(:links_json) THEN :links_json ELSE '[]' END)='array' AND json_array_length(CASE WHEN json_valid(:links_json) THEN :links_json ELSE '[]' END)<=10 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(:links_json) THEN :links_json ELSE '[]' END) link WHERE link.type<>'object' OR json_type(link.value,'$.url')<>'text' OR length(json_extract(link.value,'$.url')) NOT BETWEEN 8 AND 2000 OR NOT (lower(json_extract(link.value,'$.url')) LIKE 'https://_%' OR lower(json_extract(link.value,'$.url')) LIKE 'http://_%') OR json_extract(link.value,'$.url') GLOB '*[ '||char(9)||char(10)||char(13)||']*' OR instr(json_extract(link.value,'$.url'),'@')>0 OR substr(json_extract(link.value,'$.url'),instr(json_extract(link.value,'$.url'),'://')+3,1) NOT GLOB '[A-Za-z0-9]' OR (json_type(link.value,'$.label') IS NOT NULL AND (json_type(link.value,'$.label')<>'text' OR length(json_extract(link.value,'$.label'))>100)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(link.value) field WHERE field.key NOT IN ('url','label'))))) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_restricted_internships WHERE requisition_id=:requisition_id)

INSERT INTO hiring_applications(id,organization_id,brand_id,requisition_id,candidate_id,source,source_detail,basis_reference,contact_context,assignee_user_id,stage,version,created_by,created_at,updated_at,submitted_snapshot_json,notice_version,idempotency_key,links_json) SELECT :application_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:requisition_id,:candidate_id,'linkedin','Direct application',:notice_version,'Candidate supplied', (SELECT user_id FROM hiring_effective_access WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND role='owner' AND requisition_id IS NULL ORDER BY created_at,user_id LIMIT 1),'submitted',1,:__user_id,:__now,:__now,json_object('name',:candidate_name,'email',lower(trim(:email)),'phone',:phone,'statement',:statement,'notice_version',:notice_version,'publication_version',:expected_version,'notice_acknowledged',:notice_acknowledged,'talent_pool_consent',:talent_pool_consent,'communications_consent',:communications_consent,'requisition_id',:requisition_id,'brand_id',:brand_id,'organization_id',:organization_id,'links',json(coalesce(:links_json,'[]'))),:notice_version,:idempotency_key,coalesce(:links_json,'[]') WHERE changes()=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_candidates WHERE id=:candidate_id AND worker_user_id=:__user_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_restricted_internships WHERE requisition_id=:requisition_id)

INSERT INTO hiring_intake_receipts(application_id,organization_id,brand_id,requisition_id,worker_user_id,idempotency_key,payload_json,created_at) SELECT :application_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:requisition_id,:__user_id,:idempotency_key,json_object('name',:candidate_name,'email',lower(trim(:email)),'phone',:phone,'statement',:statement,'notice_version',:notice_version,'publication_version',:expected_version,'notice_acknowledged',:notice_acknowledged,'talent_pool_consent',:talent_pool_consent,'communications_consent',:communications_consent,'requisition_id',:requisition_id,'brand_id',:brand_id,'organization_id',:organization_id,'links',json(coalesce(:links_json,'[]'))),:__now WHERE changes()=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications WHERE id=:application_id AND created_by=:__user_id)

INSERT INTO hiring_consent_records(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,purpose,legal_basis,notice_version,evidence_reference,actor_user_id,recorded_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'application_notice','contract',:notice_version,json_object('affirmative_action','application_submit','notice_text',j.notice_text,'publication_version',j.version),:__user_id,:__now FROM hiring_job_publications j WHERE j.requisition_id=:requisition_id AND changes()=1

INSERT INTO hiring_consent_records(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,purpose,legal_basis,notice_version,evidence_reference,actor_user_id,recorded_at) SELECT :operation_id||':'||p.purpose,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,p.purpose,'consent',:notice_version,CASE WHEN p.purpose='talent_pool' THEN 'Optional unchecked checkbox selected: future contact by this brand for 180 days, withdraw in My Applications' ELSE 'Optional unchecked checkbox selected at submission' END,:__user_id,:__now FROM (SELECT 'talent_pool' AS purpose,:talent_pool_consent AS selected UNION ALL SELECT 'communications',:communications_consent) p WHERE p.selected=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_consent_records WHERE id=:operation_id AND actor_user_id=:__user_id AND application_id=:application_id)

INSERT INTO hiring_stage_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,from_stage,to_stage,version,reason,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,NULL,'submitted',1,'Candidate submitted',:__user_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_consent_records WHERE id=:operation_id AND actor_user_id=:__user_id AND application_id=:application_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id)

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'application.submitted',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE changes()=1

tools.name: get_my_application_receipt
tools.description: Read original receipt for authenticated retry reconciliation; compare payload before treating replay as success.
tools.sql: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM email_status_events e WHERE e.logical_email_id=o.logical_email_id AND e.status IN ('accepted','sent')) THEN 'accepted' ELSE CASE o.delivery_state WHEN 'draft' THEN 'pending_setup' WHEN 'sent' THEN 'accepted' ELSE o.delivery_state END END FROM hiring_outbox o WHERE o.receipt_application_id=r.application_id),'not_recorded') AS receipt_delivery_state,r.application_id,r.organization_id,r.brand_id,r.requisition_id,r.payload_json,a.links_json,r.created_at,COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage) AS stage FROM hiring_intake_receipts r JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=r.application_id AND a.organization_id=r.organization_id AND a.brand_id=r.brand_id WHERE r.worker_user_id=:__user_id AND r.idempotency_key=:idempotency_key LIMIT 1

tools.name: list_my_job_applications
tools.description: Candidate-owned applications; excludes staff notes, contact provenance and other candidates.
tools.sql: SELECT r.application_id,r.organization_id,r.brand_id,r.requisition_id,r.created_at,a.version,COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage) AS stage,q.title,b.name AS brand_name FROM hiring_intake_receipts r JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=r.application_id AND a.organization_id=r.organization_id AND a.brand_id=r.brand_id JOIN hiring_requisitions q ON q.id=r.requisition_id JOIN hiring_brands b ON b.id=r.brand_id WHERE r.worker_user_id=:__user_id ORDER BY r.created_at DESC,r.application_id LIMIT 100

tools.name: get_candidate_upload_settings
tools.description: Candidate-owned application upload setting; returns only the current organization upload permission.
tools.sql: SELECT o.allow_candidate_file_uploads FROM hiring_intake_receipts r JOIN hiring_organizations o ON o.id=r.organization_id WHERE r.application_id=:application_id AND r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND r.worker_user_id=:__user_id LIMIT 1

tools.name: create_application_attachment
tools.description: Reserve a private uploader-scoped object with pending_review quarantine. Bytes remain inaccessible to staff until manager release and a checked serving path exists.
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_attachments(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,uploader_user_id,filename,storage_path,mime_type,size_bytes,checksum,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :attachment_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,:__user_id,:filename,'intake/'||:attachment_id,:mime_type,:size_bytes,:checksum,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_intake_receipts r WHERE r.application_id=:application_id AND r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND r.worker_user_id=:__user_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(:attachment_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND :attachment_id NOT GLOB '*[^a-zA-Z0-9-]*' AND length(trim(:filename)) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND :mime_type IN ('application/pdf','text/plain') AND :size_bytes BETWEEN 1 AND 5242880 AND length(:checksum)=64 AND :checksum NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND (SELECT count(*) FROM hiring_attachments WHERE application_id=:application_id AND scan_state<>'deleted')<3 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_attachments WHERE id=:attachment_id)

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'attachment.created',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE changes()=1

tools.name: list_application_attachments
tools.description: Scoped attachment metadata and review state; private paths and bytes are never returned.
tools.sql: SELECT x.id,x.filename,x.mime_type,x.size_bytes,x.scan_state,x.review_status,x.uploaded_at,x.reviewed_by,x.reviewed_at,x.uploader_user_id,x.created_at FROM hiring_attachments x JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=x.application_id AND a.organization_id=x.organization_id AND a.brand_id=x.brand_id WHERE x.organization_id=:organization_id AND x.brand_id=:brand_id AND x.application_id=:application_id AND x.scan_state IN ('pending','clean') AND (x.uploader_user_id=:__user_id OR (a.assignee_user_id=:__user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))))) ORDER BY x.created_at LIMIT 3

tools.name: delete_application_attachment
tools.description: Uploader tombstones attachment before deleting their private object; downloads must refuse tombstones. Retriable object cleanup uses deterministic path.
statements: UPDATE hiring_attachments SET scan_state='deleted',deleted_at=:__now WHERE id=:attachment_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND application_id=:application_id AND uploader_user_id=:__user_id AND scan_state<>'deleted' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_intake_receipts r WHERE r.application_id=:application_id AND r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND r.worker_user_id=:__user_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id)

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'attachment.deleted',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE changes()=1

tools.name: get_application_attachment
tools.description: Approved attachment metadata for uploader or exact assigned brand staff; never returns a storage path, URL or bytes.
tools.sql: SELECT x.id,x.filename,x.mime_type,x.size_bytes,x.checksum FROM hiring_attachments x JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=x.application_id AND a.organization_id=x.organization_id AND a.brand_id=x.brand_id WHERE x.id=:attachment_id AND x.application_id=:application_id AND x.organization_id=:organization_id AND x.brand_id=:brand_id AND x.review_status='approved' AND x.uploaded_at IS NOT NULL AND x.scan_state IN ('pending','clean') AND (x.uploader_user_id=:__user_id OR (a.assignee_user_id=:__user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))))) LIMIT 1

tools.name: list_job_publications
tools.description: Staff publication state for an exact granted brand, including closed jobs.
tools.sql: SELECT j.requisition_id,j.version,j.linkedin_job_id,j.expiry_date,CASE WHEN j.lifecycle_status='expired' THEN 'expired' WHEN j.lifecycle_status='closed' OR j.status='closed' THEN 'closed' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_publication_controls pc WHERE pc.requisition_id=j.requisition_id AND pc.paused=1) THEN 'paused' ELSE 'published' END AS status,r.title FROM hiring_job_publications j JOIN hiring_requisitions r ON r.id=j.requisition_id AND r.organization_id=j.organization_id AND r.brand_id=j.brand_id WHERE j.organization_id=:organization_id AND j.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=NULL) AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) ORDER BY j.created_at DESC LIMIT 100

tools.name: grant_workspace_access
tools.description: grant workspace access
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_grants(id,organization_id,brand_id,requisition_id,user_id,role,granted_by,created_at) SELECT :grant_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:requisition_id,:member_user_id,:role,:__user_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND :role IN ('recruiter','reviewer','auditor') AND :member_user_id<>:__user_id AND length(trim(:member_user_id))>0 AND length(trim(:grant_id))>0 AND (:requisition_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_requisitions WHERE id=:requisition_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships WHERE id=:grant_id)

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at,object_type,object_id) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,'grant.created',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now,'grant',:grant_id WHERE changes()=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL)

tools.description: revoke workspace grant
statements: UPDATE hiring_grants SET status='revoked' WHERE id=:grant_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND (brand_id=:brand_id OR (brand_id IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_organizations WHERE id=:organization_id AND created_by=:__user_id AND status='active'))) AND status='active' AND user_id<>:__user_id AND role<>'owner' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id)

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at,object_type,object_id) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,'grant.created',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now,'grant',:grant_id WHERE changes()=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL)

tools.name: queue_communication
tools.description: outbox.queued; atomic scoped outbox transition, no provider call
statements: UPDATE hiring_outbox SET template_id=(SELECT t.id FROM hiring_communication_templates t JOIN hiring_template_approvals ap ON ap.template_id=t.id AND ap.version=t.version WHERE (hiring_outbox.template_id IS NULL OR (t.id=hiring_outbox.template_id AND t.version=hiring_outbox.template_version)) AND t.organization_id=hiring_outbox.organization_id AND t.brand_id=hiring_outbox.brand_id AND t.subject=hiring_outbox.subject AND t.body=hiring_outbox.body ORDER BY t.id LIMIT 1),template_version=(SELECT version FROM hiring_communication_templates WHERE id=(SELECT t.id FROM hiring_communication_templates t JOIN hiring_template_approvals ap ON ap.template_id=t.id AND ap.version=t.version WHERE (hiring_outbox.template_id IS NULL OR (t.id=hiring_outbox.template_id AND t.version=hiring_outbox.template_version)) AND t.organization_id=hiring_outbox.organization_id AND t.brand_id=hiring_outbox.brand_id AND t.subject=hiring_outbox.subject AND t.body=hiring_outbox.body ORDER BY t.id LIMIT 1)),logical_email_id=COALESCE(logical_email_id,:__uuid),delivery_state='pending',idempotency_key=operation_id WHERE id=:draft_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND application_id=:application_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND delivery_state='draft' AND operation_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_communication_templates t JOIN hiring_template_approvals ap ON ap.template_id=t.id AND ap.version=t.version JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=hiring_outbox.application_id JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id WHERE tools.name: get_admin_settings

tools.sql: SELECT o.name AS organization_name,o.verified_contact,o.allow_candidate_file_uploads,b.name AS brand_name,b.slug,b.notice_version,b.reply_identity,(o.created_by=:__user_id) AS can_manage_organization,(o.created_by=:__user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_grants g WHERE g.organization_id=o.id AND g.brand_id IS NULL AND g.requisition_id IS NULL AND g.user_id=:__user_id AND g.role='owner' AND g.status='active')) AS can_manage_candidate_uploads FROM hiring_organizations o JOIN hiring_brands b ON b.organization_id=o.id WHERE o.id=:organization_id AND b.id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) LIMIT 1

tools.name: list_organization_members
tools.description: Organization creator-owner lists active raw memberships and grants, preserving scope and revocation source
tools.sql: SELECT m.id,m.user_id,m.role,'brand' AS scope_type,m.brand_id AS scope_id,m.brand_id,NULL AS requisition_id,m.created_at AS granted_at,'membership' AS source FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id=:organization_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_membership_revocations r WHERE r.membership_id=m.id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_organizations o WHERE o.id=:organization_id AND o.created_by=:__user_id AND o.status='active') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) UNION ALL SELECT g.id,g.user_id,g.role,CASE WHEN g.requisition_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'requisition' WHEN g.brand_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'brand' ELSE 'organization' END,coalesce(g.requisition_id,g.brand_id,g.organization_id),g.brand_id,g.requisition_id,g.created_at,'grant' FROM hiring_grants g WHERE g.organization_id=:organization_id AND g.status='active' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_organizations o WHERE o.id=:organization_id AND o.created_by=:__user_id AND o.status='active') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) ORDER BY granted_at,id LIMIT 500

tools.name: list_brand_admin_members
tools.description: Brand owner lists raw active grants for their brand
tools.sql: SELECT m.id,m.user_id,m.role,'brand' AS scope_type,m.brand_id AS scope_id,m.brand_id,NULL AS requisition_id,m.created_at AS granted_at,'membership' AS source FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id=:organization_id AND m.brand_id=:brand_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_membership_revocations r WHERE r.membership_id=m.id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) UNION ALL SELECT g.id,g.user_id,g.role,CASE WHEN g.requisition_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'requisition' WHEN g.brand_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'brand' ELSE 'organization' END,coalesce(g.requisition_id,g.brand_id,g.organization_id),g.brand_id,g.requisition_id,g.created_at,'grant' FROM hiring_grants g WHERE g.organization_id=:organization_id AND g.status='active' AND g.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) ORDER BY granted_at,id LIMIT 500

tools.name: save_requisition_review
tools.description: Save a staged review, or let a brand owner revise only the description of an open published requisition. Published edits preserve the original snapshot and create an audited revision.
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_publication_edit_checks(kind,organization_id,brand_id,requisition_id,actor_user_id,expected_version,operation_id,state,payload) SELECT 'review',:organization_id,:brand_id,:requisition_id,:__user_id,:expected_version,:operation_id,:state,json_object('description',:description,'location',:location,'arrangement',:arrangement,'compensation',:compensation,'notice_version',:notice_version,'notice_text',:notice_text,'contact',:contact,'compensation_type',coalesce(:compensation_type,'unspecified')) WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_job_publications WHERE requisition_id=:requisition_id)

INSERT INTO hiring_requisition_reviews(requisition_id,state,payload,actor_user_id,operation_id) SELECT :requisition_id,:state,json_object('description',:description,'location',:location,'arrangement',:arrangement,'compensation',:compensation,'notice_version',:notice_version,'notice_text',:notice_text,'contact',:contact,'compensation_type',coalesce(:compensation_type,'unspecified')),:__user_id,:operation_id FROM hiring_requisitions r WHERE r.id=:requisition_id AND r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=NULL) AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND :state IN ('draft','pending_review') AND (:compensation_type IN ('paid','unpaid','internship','volunteer') OR (:compensation_type='unspecified' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_current_vacancy_terms vt WHERE vt.requisition_id=r.id AND vt.compensation_type='other'))) AND length(trim(:description)) BETWEEN 1 AND 20000 AND length(trim(:location)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND length(trim(:arrangement)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND length(trim(:compensation)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND length(trim(:notice_version)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND length(trim(:notice_text)) BETWEEN 1 AND 20000 AND length(trim(:contact)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_job_publications WHERE requisition_id=r.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access own WHERE own.organization_id=r.organization_id AND own.brand_id=r.brand_id AND own.user_id=:__user_id AND own.role='owner' AND own.requisition_id IS NULL)) AND :expected_version=coalesce((SELECT version FROM hiring_requisition_reviews WHERE requisition_id=r.id),0) ON CONFLICT(requisition_id) DO UPDATE SET state=excluded.state,payload=excluded.payload,actor_user_id=excluded.actor_user_id,operation_id=excluded.operation_id,version=version+1

INSERT INTO hiring_published_description_revisions(requisition_id,publication_version,description,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT j.requisition_id,j.version+1,:description,:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now FROM hiring_job_publications j WHERE j.requisition_id=:requisition_id AND j.organization_id=:organization_id AND j.brand_id=:brand_id AND j.status='published' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_requisition_reviews a WHERE a.requisition_id=:requisition_id AND a.operation_id=:operation_id AND a.actor_user_id=:__user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL)

UPDATE hiring_job_publications SET version=version+1 WHERE requisition_id=:requisition_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_published_description_revisions e WHERE e.requisition_id=:requisition_id AND e.operation_id=:operation_id AND e.publication_version=hiring_job_publications.version+1) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL)

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at,object_type,object_id) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_job_publications WHERE requisition_id=:requisition_id) THEN 'requisition.description_revised' ELSE 'requisition.review_saved' END,:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now,'requisition',:requisition_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_requisition_reviews v WHERE v.requisition_id=:requisition_id AND v.operation_id=:operation_id AND v.actor_user_id=:__user_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events a WHERE a.operation_id=:operation_id) AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_job_publications j WHERE j.requisition_id=:requisition_id AND j.organization_id=:organization_id AND j.brand_id=:brand_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_published_description_revisions e JOIN hiring_job_publications j ON j.requisition_id=e.requisition_id AND j.version=e.publication_version WHERE e.requisition_id=:requisition_id AND e.operation_id=:operation_id))
