statements: UPDATE hiring_job_publications SET version=version+1 WHERE requisition_id=:requisition_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND status='published' AND version=:expected_version AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=NULL) AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_publication_controls WHERE requisition_id=:requisition_id AND paused=0)

tools.name: create_application
tools.description: Add a candidate application from any source: email, referral, LinkedIn, job board, import, manual or another source. Records contact context, assignment and audit. Does not send messages.
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_candidates(id,organization_id,brand_id,name,email,phone,linkedin_url,linkedin_profile_url,created_by,created_at) SELECT :candidate_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:candidate_name,NULLIF(:email,''),NULLIF(:phone,''),'',NULL,:__user_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=:requisition_id)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_requisitions WHERE id=:requisition_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AND length(trim(:candidate_name))>0 AND length(trim(:basis_reference))>0 AND length(trim(:contact_context))>0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:assignee_user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter','reviewer') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=:requisition_id)) AND length(trim(:source_detail))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications WHERE id=:application_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events WHERE id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:source)) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND (:profile_url IS NULL OR trim(:profile_url)='' OR (length(:profile_url)<=2000 AND (:profile_url LIKE 'https://%' OR :profile_url LIKE 'http://%'))) AND (coalesce(:links_json,'[]')='[]' OR (length(:links_json)<=22000 AND json_valid(:links_json) AND json_type(CASE WHEN json_valid(:links_json) THEN :links_json ELSE '[]' END)='array' AND json_array_length(CASE WHEN json_valid(:links_json) THEN :links_json ELSE '[]' END)<=10 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(:links_json) THEN :links_json ELSE '[]' END) link WHERE link.type<>'object' OR json_type(link.value,'$.url')<>'text' OR length(json_extract(link.value,'$.url')) NOT BETWEEN 8 AND 2000 OR NOT (lower(json_extract(link.value,'$.url')) LIKE 'https://_%' OR lower(json_extract(link.value,'$.url')) LIKE 'http://_%') OR json_extract(link.value,'$.url') GLOB '*[ '||char(9)||char(10)||char(13)||']*' OR instr(json_extract(link.value,'$.url'),'@')>0 OR substr(json_extract(link.value,'$.url'),instr(json_extract(link.value,'$.url'),'://')+3,1) NOT GLOB '[A-Za-z0-9]' OR (json_type(link.value,'$.label') IS NOT NULL AND (json_type(link.value,'$.label')<>'text' OR length(json_extract(link.value,'$.label'))>100)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(link.value) field WHERE field.key NOT IN ('url','label'))))) AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_restricted_internships WHERE requisition_id=:requisition_id) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_internship_requisitions WHERE requisition_id=:requisition_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AND length(trim(:email)) BETWEEN 3 AND 254 AND instr(:email,'@')>1 AND ((:source='recruiter_sourced' AND coalesce(:campaign_id,'')='') OR (:source='linkedin_campaign' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_internship_campaigns WHERE id=:campaign_id AND requisition_id=:requisition_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND enabled=1)))))

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_applications(id,organization_id,brand_id,requisition_id,candidate_id,source,source_detail,basis_reference,contact_context,assignee_user_id,stage,version,created_by,created_at,updated_at,links_json) SELECT :application_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:requisition_id,:candidate_id,'linkedin',:source_detail||CASE WHEN coalesce(:campaign_id,'')<>'' THEN ' [campaign:'||:campaign_id||']' ELSE '' END,:basis_reference,:contact_context,:assignee_user_id,'submitted',1,:__user_id,:__now,:__now,coalesce(:links_json,'[]') WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=:requisition_id)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_requisitions WHERE id=:requisition_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AND length(trim(:source_detail))>0 AND length(trim(:basis_reference))>0 AND length(trim(:contact_context))>0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_candidates WHERE id=:candidate_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:assignee_user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter','reviewer') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=:requisition_id)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events WHERE id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:source)) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND (:profile_url IS NULL OR trim(:profile_url)='' OR (length(:profile_url)<=2000 AND (:profile_url LIKE 'https://%' OR :profile_url LIKE 'http://%'))) AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_restricted_internships WHERE requisition_id=:requisition_id) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_internship_requisitions WHERE requisition_id=:requisition_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AND length(trim(:email)) BETWEEN 3 AND 254 AND instr(:email,'@')>1 AND ((:source='recruiter_sourced' AND coalesce(:campaign_id,'')='') OR (:source='linkedin_campaign' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_internship_campaigns WHERE id=:campaign_id AND requisition_id=:requisition_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND enabled=1)))))

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_stage_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,from_stage,to_stage,version,reason,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,NULL,'submitted',1,'Candidate added from '||trim(:source),:__user_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=:requisition_id)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications WHERE id=:application_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1

INSERT INTO hiring_application_sources(application_id,source,profile_url) SELECT :application_id,trim(:source),NULLIF(trim(:profile_url),'') WHERE changes()=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events WHERE id=:operation_id AND application_id=:application_id AND actor_user_id=:__user_id)

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'application.created',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=:requisition_id)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events WHERE id=:operation_id AND application_id=:application_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1

source.description: Where this candidate came from, e.g. email, referral, linkedin, job_board, recruiter_import, manual or another source.

campaign_id.description: Configured LinkedIn ad campaign ID; omit for recruiter-sourced internship intake.

links_json.description: JSON array of up to ten {"url":"https://...","label":"optional"} links. URLs must use http or https. Omit for no links.

tools.name: get_my_requisition_receipt
tools.description: Candidate-owned original receipt for this exact published scope, including retries with a new key. Never exposes another candidate.
tools.sql: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM email_status_events e WHERE e.logical_email_id=o.logical_email_id AND e.status IN ('accepted','sent')) THEN 'accepted' ELSE CASE o.delivery_state WHEN 'draft' THEN 'pending_setup' WHEN 'sent' THEN 'accepted' ELSE o.delivery_state END END FROM hiring_outbox o WHERE o.receipt_application_id=r.application_id),'not_recorded') AS receipt_delivery_state,r.application_id,r.organization_id,r.brand_id,r.requisition_id,r.payload_json,a.links_json,r.created_at,COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage) AS stage FROM hiring_intake_receipts r JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=r.application_id AND a.organization_id=r.organization_id AND a.brand_id=r.brand_id WHERE r.worker_user_id=:__user_id AND r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND r.requisition_id=:requisition_id LIMIT 1

tools.description: Chronological email evidence, 50 per page. Continue with last timestamp/id until empty; no inferred legacy events.

statements: INSERT INTO hiring_publication_edit_checks(kind,organization_id,brand_id,requisition_id,actor_user_id,expected_version,operation_id) SELECT 'pd',:organization_id,:brand_id,:requisition_id,:__user_id,:expected_version,:operation_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_job_publications WHERE requisition_id=:requisition_id)

INSERT INTO hiring_pd_versions(requisition_id,version,payload,actor_user_id,updated_at,operation_id) SELECT r.id,:expected_version+1,json_object('overview',:overview,'rolePurpose',:rolePurpose,'responsibilities',json(:responsibilities),'requirements',json(:requirements),'workingArrangement',:workingArrangement,'compensation',:compensation,'benefits',:benefits,'applicationProcess',:applicationProcess,'privacyContact',:privacyContact),:__user_id,:__now,:operation_id FROM hiring_requisitions r WHERE r.id=:requisition_id AND r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=r.organization_id AND p.brand_id=r.brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=r.id)) AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_job_publications WHERE requisition_id=r.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access own WHERE own.organization_id=r.organization_id AND own.brand_id=r.brand_id AND own.user_id=:__user_id AND own.role='owner' AND own.requisition_id IS NULL)) AND :expected_version=coalesce((SELECT max(version) FROM hiring_pd_versions WHERE requisition_id=r.id),0) AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_pd_versions WHERE operation_id=:operation_id) AND length(:overview)<=20000 AND length(:rolePurpose)<=20000 AND CASE WHEN json_valid(:responsibilities) THEN json_type(:responsibilities)='array' AND json_array_length(:responsibilities)<=100 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(:responsibilities) WHERE type<>'text' OR length(value)>2000) ELSE 0 END AND CASE WHEN json_valid(:requirements) THEN json_type(:requirements)='array' AND json_array_length(:requirements)<=100 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(:requirements) WHERE type<>'text' OR length(value)>2000) ELSE 0 END AND length(:workingArrangement)<=20000 AND length(:compensation)<=20000 AND length(:benefits)<=20000 AND length(:applicationProcess)<=20000 AND length(:privacyContact)<=20000

INSERT INTO hiring_published_pd_revisions(requisition_id,publication_version,pd_version,payload,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT j.requisition_id,j.version+1,p.version,p.payload,:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now FROM hiring_job_publications j JOIN hiring_pd_versions p ON p.requisition_id=j.requisition_id AND p.operation_id=:operation_id WHERE j.requisition_id=:requisition_id AND j.organization_id=:organization_id AND j.brand_id=:brand_id AND j.status='published' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_pd_versions a WHERE a.requisition_id=:requisition_id AND a.operation_id=:operation_id AND a.actor_user_id=:__user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access own WHERE own.organization_id=:organization_id AND own.brand_id=:brand_id AND own.user_id=:__user_id AND own.role='owner' AND own.requisition_id IS NULL)

UPDATE hiring_job_publications SET version=version+1 WHERE requisition_id=:requisition_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_published_pd_revisions e WHERE e.requisition_id=:requisition_id AND e.operation_id=:operation_id AND e.publication_version=hiring_job_publications.version+1) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL)

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at,object_type,object_id) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_job_publications WHERE requisition_id=:requisition_id) THEN 'requisition.pd_revised' ELSE 'requisition.pd_saved' END,:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now,'requisition',:requisition_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_pd_versions v WHERE v.requisition_id=:requisition_id AND v.operation_id=:operation_id AND v.actor_user_id=:__user_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events a WHERE a.operation_id=:operation_id) AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_job_publications j WHERE j.requisition_id=:requisition_id AND j.organization_id=:organization_id AND j.brand_id=:brand_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_published_pd_revisions e JOIN hiring_job_publications j ON j.requisition_id=e.requisition_id AND j.version=e.publication_version WHERE e.requisition_id=:requisition_id AND e.operation_id=:operation_id))

terms_version,r.id,r.title,CASE WHEN j.lifecycle_status='expired' THEN 'expired' WHEN j.lifecycle_status='closed' OR j.status='closed' THEN 'closed' WHEN pc.paused=1 THEN 'paused' WHEN j.status='published' THEN 'published' ELSE 'draft' END AS status,EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access publisher WHERE publisher.organization_id=r.organization_id AND publisher.brand_id=r.brand_id AND publisher.user_id=:__user_id AND publisher.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND publisher.requisition_id IS NULL) AS can_publish,v.state AS review_state,v.version AS review_version,j.compensation_type AS published_compensation_type,j.version AS publication_version,j.linkedin_job_id,(CASE WHEN abs(j.expiry_date)<10000000000 THEN j.expiry_date*1000 ELSE j.expiry_date END) AS expiry_date,j.linkedin_job_id,(CASE WHEN abs(j.expiry_date)<10000000000 THEN j.expiry_date*1000 ELSE j.expiry_date END) AS expiry_date,j.linkedin_job_id,(CASE WHEN abs(j.expiry_date)<10000000000 THEN j.expiry_date*1000 ELSE j.expiry_date END) AS expiry_date,j.linkedin_job_id,j.expiry_date,j.linkedin_job_id,j.expiry_date,j.linkedin_job_id,j.expiry_date,j.linkedin_job_id,j.expiry_date,j.linkedin_job_id,j.expiry_date,coalesce((SELECT e.description FROM hiring_published_description_revisions e WHERE e.requisition_id=j.requisition_id ORDER BY e.publication_version DESC LIMIT 1),j.description) AS published_description,j.location AS published_location,j.arrangement AS published_arrangement,j.compensation AS published_compensation,j.contact AS published_contact,j.notice_version AS published_notice_version,j.notice_text AS published_notice_text,CASE WHEN j.lifecycle_status='expired' THEN 'expired' WHEN j.lifecycle_status='closed' OR j.status='closed' THEN 'closed' WHEN pc.paused=1 THEN 'paused' WHEN j.status='published' THEN 'published' WHEN v.state='pending_review' THEN 'in review' ELSE 'draft' END AS state, max(r.created_at,coalesce(j.created_at,0),coalesce(d.updated_at,0),coalesce((SELECT max(a.created_at) FROM hiring_audit_events a WHERE a.organization_id=r.organization_id AND a.brand_id=r.brand_id AND a.object_id=r.id),0)) AS updated_at FROM hiring_requisitions r LEFT JOIN hiring_job_publications j ON j.requisition_id=r.id LEFT JOIN hiring_publication_controls pc ON pc.requisition_id=r.id LEFT JOIN hiring_requisition_reviews v ON v.requisition_id=r.id LEFT JOIN hiring_pd_versions d ON d.requisition_id=r.id AND d.version=(SELECT max(version) FROM hiring_pd_versions WHERE requisition_id=r.id) WHERE r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND r.id=:requisition_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=r.organization_id AND p.brand_id=r.brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=r.id)) LIMIT 1

tools.sql: SELECT id,name,subject,body,version,updated_at,EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_template_approvals ap WHERE ap.template_id=hiring_communication_templates.id AND ap.version=hiring_communication_templates.version) AS approved FROM hiring_communication_templates WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) ORDER BY updated_at DESC,id LIMIT 100

tools.description: Create or edit a scoped unsent template with optimistic concurrency and audit evidence
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_communication_templates(id,organization_id,brand_id,name,subject,body,version,updated_at,operation_id) SELECT :template_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:name,:subject,:body,1,:__now,:operation_id WHERE :expected_version=0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND length(trim(:name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND length(trim(:subject)) BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND length(trim(:body)) BETWEEN 1 AND 20000 AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_communication_templates WHERE id=:template_id)

UPDATE hiring_communication_templates SET name=:name,subject=:subject,body=:body,version=version+1,updated_at=:__now,operation_id=:operation_id WHERE id=:template_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND version=:expected_version AND :expected_version>0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND length(trim(:name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND length(trim(:subject)) BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND length(trim(:body)) BETWEEN 1 AND 20000 AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id)

tools.name: list_operational_diagnostics
tools.description: Read authorized redacted activity metadata, excluding all candidate content, URLs and summaries; no result evidence means unknown
tools.sql: SELECT x.id,x.agent_instance_id,x.activity_type AS action,x.occurred_at,'unknown' AS outcome FROM hiring_agent_activity x JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=x.application_id AND a.organization_id=x.organization_id AND a.brand_id=x.brand_id WHERE x.organization_id=:organization_id AND x.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=x.organization_id AND p.brand_id=x.brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter','auditor') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) ORDER BY x.occurred_at DESC,x.id LIMIT 100

tools.name: get_org_recruiting_playbook
tools.description: Read contract schema_version=1: latest versioned organisation recruiting playbook for authenticated owners/recruiters (agents need recruiter grants). All readers receive recursive secret_* / meeting_password redaction. Version 0 means unconfigured; no rows means unavailable/denied. Stop policy-dependent activity on either fallback. See docs/agent-playbook-contract.md.
tools.sql: WITH RECURSIVE latest AS (SELECT version,payload,updated_at,actor_user_id FROM hiring_org_playbooks WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1), secrets AS (SELECT fullkey,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY length(fullkey) DESC,fullkey) AS n FROM latest,json_tree(latest.payload) WHERE typeof(key)='text' AND (substr(lower(key),1,7)='secret_' OR lower(key)='meeting_password')), redacted(n,payload) AS (SELECT 0,payload FROM latest UNION ALL SELECT s.n,json_remove(r.payload,s.fullkey) FROM redacted r JOIN secrets s ON s.n=r.n+1) SELECT 1 AS schema_version,l.version,r.payload,l.updated_at,l.actor_user_id,NULL AS message FROM latest l JOIN redacted r ON r.n=(SELECT count(*) FROM secrets) UNION ALL SELECT 1,0,NULL,NULL,NULL,'No playbook configured' WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM latest)

tools.name: save_org_recruiting_playbook
tools.description: Organisation owner creates an immutable playbook version with optimistic concurrency and atomic organisation audit evidence. Read the saved version with get_org_recruiting_playbook.
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_org_playbooks(organization_id,version,payload,actor_user_id,updated_at,operation_id) SELECT :organization_id,:expected_version+1,:payload,:__user_id,:__now,:operation_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p JOIN hiring_organizations o ON o.id=p.organization_id WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL AND o.created_by=:__user_id) AND typeof(:expected_version) IN ('integer','real') AND :expected_version=CAST(:expected_version AS INTEGER) AND :expected_version>=0 AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128

tools.name: get_application
tools.description: Full scoped owner/recruiter application detail by ID, independent of queue limits. Missing and unauthorized IDs return no rows.
tools.sql: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_restricted_internships ri WHERE ri.requisition_id=a.requisition_id) AS is_internship,COALESCE(a.workflow_acceptance_evidence,a.acceptance_evidence) AS acceptance_evidence,a.candidate_id,a.id,a.requisition_id,a.discord_handle,a.interns_app_id,a.interns_invite_status,a.interns_registration_status,COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage) AS stage,a.version,CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_intake_receipts ir WHERE ir.application_id=a.id AND ir.organization_id=a.organization_id AND ir.brand_id=a.brand_id) THEN 'direct' ELSE COALESCE((SELECT s.source FROM hiring_application_sources s WHERE s.application_id=a.id),a.source) END AS source,a.source_detail,a.basis_reference,a.contact_context,a.assignee_user_id,a.links_json,a.created_at,a.updated_at,c.name AS candidate_name,c.email,c.phone,COALESCE(c.linkedin_profile_url,NULLIF(c.linkedin_url,'')) AS linkedin_url,COALESCE((SELECT s.profile_url FROM hiring_application_sources s WHERE s.application_id=a.id),c.linkedin_profile_url,NULLIF(c.linkedin_url,'')) AS profile_url,r.title AS requisition_title FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id AND c.organization_id=a.organization_id AND c.brand_id=a.brand_id JOIN hiring_requisitions r ON r.id=a.requisition_id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id WHERE a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) AND a.id=:application_id LIMIT 1

statements: INSERT INTO interviews(id,tenant_id,brand_id,requisition_id,application_id,scheduled_at,duration_minutes,location,format,operation_id,created_at,updated_at) SELECT :interview_id,:tenant_id,:brand_id,a.requisition_id,a.id,:scheduled_at,:duration_minutes,:location,:format,:operation_id,:__now,:__now FROM hiring_applications a WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:tenant_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:tenant_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:tenant_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:reviewer_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter','reviewer') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id||'-revoked') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM interview_assignment_history WHERE operation_id=:operation_id) AND (:scheduled_at IS NULL OR (:scheduled_at=CAST(:scheduled_at AS INTEGER) AND :scheduled_at>=0)) AND (:duration_minutes IS NULL OR (:duration_minutes=CAST(:duration_minutes AS INTEGER) AND :duration_minutes BETWEEN 1 AND 1440)) AND (:location IS NULL OR length(:location)<=2000) AND :format IN ('phone','video','onsite','panel') AND length(trim(:interview_id))>0 AND length(trim(:assignment_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM interviews WHERE id=:interview_id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM interview_assignments WHERE id=:assignment_id)

INSERT INTO interview_assignments(id,interview_id,tenant_id,brand_id,requisition_id,application_id,reviewer_id,assigned_by,assigned_at,operation_id) SELECT :assignment_id,id,tenant_id,brand_id,requisition_id,application_id,:reviewer_id,:__user_id,:__now,:operation_id FROM interviews WHERE id=:interview_id AND tenant_id=:tenant_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND application_id=:application_id AND operation_id=:operation_id AND changes()=1

tools.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:tenant_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) THEN json_object('candidate_name',c.name,'requisition_title',r.title,'stage',COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage),'scheduled_at',i.scheduled_at,'duration_minutes',i.duration_minutes,'location',i.location,'format',i.format,'status',i.status,'email',c.email,'phone',c.phone,'profile_url',COALESCE((SELECT profile_url FROM hiring_application_sources WHERE application_id=a.id),c.linkedin_profile_url,NULLIF(c.linkedin_url,'')),'source',CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_intake_receipts ir WHERE ir.application_id=a.id AND ir.organization_id=a.organization_id AND ir.brand_id=a.brand_id) THEN 'direct' ELSE COALESCE((SELECT source FROM hiring_application_sources WHERE application_id=a.id),a.source) END,'source_detail',a.source_detail,'basis_reference',a.basis_reference,'contact_context',a.contact_context,'notes',json((SELECT json_group_array(json_object('body',body,'actor_user_id',actor_user_id,'created_at',created_at)) FROM hiring_notes WHERE application_id=a.id AND organization_id=a.organization_id AND brand_id=a.brand_id)),'attachments',json((SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',id,'filename',filename,'mime_type',mime_type,'size_bytes',size_bytes,'scan_state',scan_state)) FROM hiring_attachments WHERE application_id=a.id AND organization_id=a.organization_id AND brand_id=a.brand_id AND deleted_at IS NULL)),'worker_communications',json((SELECT json_group_array(json_object('subject',subject,'body',body,'direction',direction)) FROM hiring_worker_communication_events WHERE application_id=a.id AND organization_id=a.organization_id AND brand_id=a.brand_id)),'communications',json((SELECT json_group_array(json_object('subject',subject,'body',body,'direction',direction)) FROM hiring_communication_events WHERE application_id=a.id AND organization_id=a.organization_id AND brand_id=a.brand_id)),'drafts',json((SELECT json_group_array(json_object('subject',subject,'body',body)) FROM hiring_outbox WHERE application_id=a.id AND organization_id=a.organization_id AND brand_id=a.brand_id))) ELSE json_object('candidate_name',c.name,'requisition_title',r.title,'stage',COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage),'scheduled_at',i.scheduled_at,'duration_minutes',i.duration_minutes,'location',i.location,'format',i.format,'status',i.status) END AS packet_json FROM interviews i JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=i.application_id AND a.organization_id=i.tenant_id AND a.brand_id=i.brand_id AND a.requisition_id=i.requisition_id JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id AND c.organization_id=a.organization_id AND c.brand_id=a.brand_id JOIN hiring_requisitions r ON r.id=a.requisition_id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id WHERE i.id=:interview_id AND i.application_id=:application_id AND i.tenant_id=:tenant_id AND i.brand_id=:brand_id AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:tenant_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) OR (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p JOIN interview_assignments ia ON ia.interview_id=i.id AND ia.reviewer_id=p.user_id AND ia.revoked_at IS NULL WHERE p.organization_id=i.tenant_id AND p.brand_id=i.brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='reviewer' AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=i.requisition_id)) AND i.status='scheduled')) LIMIT 1

tools.name: read_own_scorecard
tools.description: Read only your current assigned scorecard revisions, newest first, 50 per page. No staff override.
tools.sql: SELECT s.assignment_id,s.version,s.status,s.criteria_json,s.created_at,s.submitted_at FROM hiring_scorecard_versions s JOIN interview_assignments a ON a.id=s.assignment_id JOIN interviews i ON i.id=a.interview_id WHERE a.id=:assignment_id AND a.interview_id=:interview_id AND a.application_id=:application_id AND a.tenant_id=:tenant_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND a.reviewer_id=:__user_id AND a.revoked_at IS NULL AND i.status='scheduled' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications app WHERE app.id=a.application_id AND app.organization_id=a.tenant_id AND app.brand_id=a.brand_id AND app.requisition_id=a.requisition_id) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=a.tenant_id AND p.brand_id=a.brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter','reviewer') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) AND s.reviewer_id=:__user_id AND s.tenant_id=:tenant_id AND s.brand_id=:brand_id AND s.application_id=:application_id AND s.interview_id=:interview_id AND s.version<COALESCE(:before_version,2147483647) ORDER BY s.version DESC LIMIT 50

statements: INSERT INTO hiring_scorecard_versions(id,assignment_id,interview_id,application_id,tenant_id,brand_id,requisition_id,reviewer_id,version,status,criteria_json,created_at,submitted_at,operation_id) SELECT :__uuid,a.id,a.interview_id,a.application_id,a.tenant_id,a.brand_id,a.requisition_id,:__user_id,:expected_version+1,:status,:criteria_json,:__now,CASE WHEN :status='submitted' THEN :__now END,:operation_id FROM interview_assignments a JOIN interviews i ON i.id=a.interview_id WHERE a.id=:assignment_id AND a.interview_id=:interview_id AND a.application_id=:application_id AND a.tenant_id=:tenant_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND a.reviewer_id=:__user_id AND a.revoked_at IS NULL AND i.status='scheduled' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications app WHERE app.id=a.application_id AND app.organization_id=a.tenant_id AND app.brand_id=a.brand_id AND app.requisition_id=a.requisition_id) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=a.tenant_id AND p.brand_id=a.brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter','reviewer') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) AND :expected_version=COALESCE((SELECT MAX(version) FROM hiring_scorecard_versions WHERE assignment_id=a.id),0) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_scorecard_versions WHERE assignment_id=a.id AND status='submitted') AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_scorecard_versions WHERE operation_id=:operation_id)

INSERT INTO hiring_decisions SELECT :operation_id,:tenant_id,:brand_id,a.requisition_id,a.id,:__user_id,(SELECT p.role FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:tenant_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id) ORDER BY p.role LIMIT 1),:disposition,COALESCE(:rationale,''),:__now,a.version,COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage),:operation_id FROM hiring_applications a WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:tenant_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:tenant_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) AND :__user_id NOT IN ('system','automation','api_key','system'||char(58)||'worker') AND a.requisition_id=:requisition_id AND a.version=:expected_version AND (:actor_id IS NULL OR :actor_id=:__user_id) AND (:actor_role IS NULL OR :actor_role=(SELECT p.role FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:tenant_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id) ORDER BY p.role LIMIT 1)) AND ((:disposition='hired' AND COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage)='offered') OR (:disposition='rejected' AND COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage) IN ('in_review','shortlisted','offered','decision_pending')) OR (:disposition IN ('withdrawn','deferred') AND COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage) IN ('submitted','in_review','shortlisted','interviewing','decision_pending','offered'))) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE id=:operation_id OR operation_id=:operation_id)

UPDATE hiring_applications SET stage=CASE WHEN :disposition='deferred' THEN stage ELSE :disposition END,stage_extension=CASE WHEN :disposition='deferred' THEN stage_extension ELSE NULL END,version=version+1,updated_at=:__now WHERE id=:application_id AND changes()=1 AND organization_id=:tenant_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_decisions d WHERE d.operation_id=:operation_id AND d.application_id=hiring_applications.id AND d.actor_id=:__user_id AND d.application_version=:expected_version)

INSERT INTO hiring_stage_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,from_stage,to_stage,version,reason,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:tenant_id,:brand_id,a.id,(SELECT from_stage FROM hiring_decisions WHERE operation_id=:operation_id AND actor_id=:__user_id),COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage),a.version,COALESCE(:rationale,''),:__user_id,:__now FROM hiring_applications a WHERE a.id=:application_id AND changes()=1

tools.name: request_candidate_erasure
tools.description: Owner confirms identity and hold review; atomically redacts candidate and all applications in this brand, fences future writes and records blocked MAIL propagation. This is partial erasure, never completion. Read get_candidate_erasure_status after any response or timeout.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO erasure_requests(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,candidate_id,operation_id,actor_user_id,identity_verified,holds_reviewed,created_at) SELECT :__uuid,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,a.candidate_id,:operation_id,:__user_id,:identity_verified,:holds_reviewed,:__now FROM hiring_applications a WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND :identity_verified=1 AND :holds_reviewed=1 AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erasure_requests r WHERE r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id AND r.candidate_id=a.candidate_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id)

target.brand_id=r.brand_id WHERE target.id=:application_id AND r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL)), stores AS (SELECT 'hiring_notes' AS store,count(*) AS remaining_records FROM hiring_notes x JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=x.application_id JOIN r ON r.candidate_id=a.candidate_id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id UNION ALL SELECT 'hiring_outbox' AS store,count(*) AS remaining_records FROM hiring_outbox x JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=x.application_id JOIN r ON r.candidate_id=a.candidate_id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id UNION ALL SELECT 'hiring_communication_events' AS store,count(*) AS remaining_records FROM hiring_communication_events x JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=x.application_id JOIN r ON r.candidate_id=a.candidate_id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id UNION ALL SELECT 'hiring_worker_communication_events' AS store,count(*) AS remaining_records FROM hiring_worker_communication_events x JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=x.application_id JOIN r ON r.candidate_id=a.candidate_id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id UNION ALL SELECT 'hiring_agent_activity' AS store,count(*) AS remaining_records FROM hiring_agent_activity x JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=x.application_id JOIN r ON r.candidate_id=a.candidate_id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id UNION ALL SELECT 'hiring_consent_records' AS store,count(*) AS remaining_records FROM hiring_consent_records x JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=x.application_id JOIN r ON r.candidate_id=a.candidate_id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id UNION ALL SELECT 'hiring_intake_receipts' AS store,count(*) AS remaining_records FROM hiring_intake_receipts x JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=x.application_id JOIN r ON r.candidate_id=a.candidate_id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id UNION ALL SELECT 'hiring_application_sources' AS store,count(*) AS remaining_records FROM hiring_application_sources x JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=x.application_id JOIN r ON r.candidate_id=a.candidate_id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id UNION ALL SELECT 'hiring_attachments' AS store,count(*) AS remaining_records FROM hiring_attachments x JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=x.application_id JOIN r ON r.candidate_id=a.candidate_id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id UNION ALL SELECT 'hiring_stage_events' AS store,count(*) AS remaining_records FROM hiring_stage_events x JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=x.application_id JOIN r ON r.candidate_id=a.candidate_id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id UNION ALL SELECT 'hiring_assignment_events' AS store,count(*) AS remaining_records FROM hiring_assignment_events x JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=x.application_id JOIN r ON r.candidate_id=a.candidate_id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id UNION ALL SELECT 'interviews' AS store,count(*) AS remaining_records FROM interviews x JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=x.application_id JOIN r ON r.candidate_id=a.candidate_id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id UNION ALL SELECT 'interview_assignments' AS store,count(*) AS remaining_records FROM interview_assignments x JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=x.application_id JOIN r ON r.candidate_id=a.candidate_id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id UNION ALL SELECT 'interview_assignment_history' AS store,count(*) AS remaining_records FROM interview_assignment_history x JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=x.application_id JOIN r ON r.candidate_id=a.candidate_id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id UNION ALL SELECT 'hiring_scorecard_versions' AS store,count(*) AS remaining_records FROM hiring_scorecard_versions x JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=x.application_id JOIN r ON r.candidate_id=a.candidate_id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id UNION ALL SELECT 'hiring_decisions' AS store,count(*) AS remaining_records FROM hiring_decisions x JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=x.application_id JOIN r ON r.candidate_id=a.candidate_id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND 'hiring_offer_approval_events' AS store,count(*) AS remaining_records FROM hiring_offer_approval_events x JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=x.application_id JOIN r ON r.candidate_id=a.candidate_id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id UNION ALL SELECT 'hiring_outbox_authorizations' AS store,count(*) AS remaining_records FROM hiring_outbox_authorizations x JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=x.application_id JOIN r ON r.candidate_id=a.candidate_id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id UNION ALL SELECT 'candidate_core' AS store,count(*) AS remaining_records FROM hiring_candidates c JOIN r ON c.id=r.candidate_id WHERE c.name<>'[redacted]' OR c.email IS NOT '[redacted]' OR c.phone IS NOT '[redacted]' OR c.linkedin_url<>'[redacted]' OR c.linkedin_profile_url IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'application_core' AS store,count(*) AS remaining_records FROM hiring_applications a JOIN r ON a.candidate_id=r.candidate_id AND a.organization_id=r.organization_id AND a.brand_id=r.brand_id WHERE a.source_detail<>'[redacted]' OR a.basis_reference<>'[redacted]' OR verification_code,l.processor,l.status AS processor_status,l.reason_code AS processor_reason FROM r JOIN processor_erasure_log l ON l.request_id=r.id LIMIT 1

tools.name: record_candidate_erasure_hold
tools.description: Brand owner appends a candidate hold/release with reason reference and review date; dates never automatically release a hold. Candidate scope derives from the application. Cannot change after redaction.
statements: INSERT INTO erasure_hold_events(operation_id,organization_id,brand_id,candidate_id,state,reason_reference,review_at,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,a.candidate_id,:state,:reason_reference,:review_at,:__user_id,:__now FROM hiring_applications a WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND :state IN ('active','released') AND :review_at>0 AND length(trim(:reason_reference)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erasure_hold_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id)

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'erasure.hold_recorded',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE changes()=1

tools.name: get_candidate_erasure_hold
tools.description: Brand owner reads current hold metadata only; no candidate contact data. Review dates do not expire holds.
tools.sql: SELECT h.state,h.reason_reference,h.review_at,h.actor_user_id,h.created_at FROM erasure_hold_events h JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.candidate_id=h.candidate_id AND a.organization_id=h.organization_id AND a.brand_id=h.brand_id WHERE a.id=:application_id AND h.organization_id=:organization_id AND h.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) ORDER BY h.sequence DESC LIMIT 1

tools.name: record_acceptance
tools.description: Record explicit candidate acceptance of approved offer terms. Read back with get_acceptance_result.
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_acceptances_v2 SELECT :operation_id,a.organization_id,a.brand_id,a.id,o.id,o.current_version,:__user_id,a.version,:acceptance_evidence,:__now FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_offers o ON o.application_id=a.id AND o.tenant_id=a.organization_id AND o.brand_id=a.brand_id JOIN hiring_offer_versions v ON v.offer_id=o.id AND v.version=o.current_version WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:tenant_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access g WHERE g.user_id=:__user_id AND g.organization_id=a.organization_id AND g.brand_id=a.brand_id AND g.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (g.requisition_id IS NULL OR g.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) AND :__user_id NOT IN ('system','automation','api_key','system'||char(58)||'worker') AND a.version=:expected_version AND COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage)='offered' AND length(trim(:acceptance_evidence)) BETWEEN 1 AND 10000 AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_acceptance_history WHERE operation_id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE id=:operation_id OR operation_id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events WHERE id=:operation_id)

INSERT INTO hiring_mutation_checks(kind,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,actor_user_id,expected_version,operation_id,reason) VALUES('acceptance',:tenant_id,:brand_id,:application_id,:__user_id,:expected_version,:operation_id,:acceptance_evidence)

tools.name: get_acceptance_result
tools.description: Scoped exact acceptance retry readback; current application and committed operation.
tools.sql: SELECT a.id,a.version,COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage) AS stage,COALESCE(a.workflow_acceptance_evidence,a.acceptance_evidence) AS acceptance_evidence,x.operation_id FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_acceptance_history x ON x.application_id=a.id WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:tenant_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access g WHERE g.user_id=:__user_id AND g.organization_id=a.organization_id AND g.brand_id=a.brand_id AND g.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (g.requisition_id IS NULL OR g.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) AND :__user_id NOT IN ('system','automation','api_key','system'||char(58)||'worker') AND x.operation_id=:operation_id AND x.actor_user_id=:__user_id AND x.expected_version=:expected_version AND x.acceptance_evidence=:acceptance_evidence

tools.name: reconcile_communication
tools.description: Human evidence-backed resolution of failed/unknown sends. Not accepted creates one unsent replacement; never sends or queues. Original evidence remains immutable. Offer attempts are reconciled without replacement because existing immutable offer authorization permits only one draft. Application receipts also never create replacement jobs; use approved alternate contact after reconciliation.
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_outbox(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,recipient_email,subject,body,status,actor_user_id,created_at,operation_id,logical_email_id) SELECT :__uuid,o.organization_id,o.brand_id,o.application_id,o.recipient_email,o.subject,o.body,'draft',:__user_id,:__now,:operation_id,:__uuid FROM hiring_outbox o WHERE o.id=:draft_id AND o.organization_id=:organization_id AND o.brand_id=:brand_id AND o.application_id=:application_id AND o.delivery_state IN ('failed','unknown') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND :outcome IN ('accepted','not_accepted') AND length(trim(:evidence)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_mail_reconciliations r WHERE r.original_draft_id=o.id) AND (:outcome='accepted' OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM email_status_events e WHERE e.logical_email_id=o.logical_email_id AND e.status IN ('accepted','sent'))) AND :outcome='not_accepted' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_offers f WHERE f.application_id=o.application_id) AND o.receipt_application_id IS NULL

INSERT INTO hiring_mail_reconciliations(id,original_draft_id,replacement_draft_id,outcome,evidence,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,o.id,CASE WHEN :outcome='not_accepted' AND o.receipt_application_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_offers f WHERE f.application_id=o.application_id) THEN :__uuid END,:outcome,:evidence,:__user_id,:__now FROM hiring_outbox o WHERE o.id=:draft_id AND o.organization_id=:organization_id AND o.brand_id=:brand_id AND o.application_id=:application_id AND o.delivery_state IN ('failed','unknown') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND :outcome IN ('accepted','not_accepted') AND length(trim(:evidence)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_mail_reconciliations r WHERE r.original_draft_id=o.id) AND (:outcome='accepted' OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM email_status_events e WHERE e.logical_email_id=o.logical_email_id AND e.status IN ('accepted','sent')))

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at,request_id,object_type,object_id,redacted_summary) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'outbox.reconciled',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now,:operation_id,'outbox',:draft_id,'outbox.reconciled' WHERE changes()=1

INSERT INTO email_status_events(id,logical_email_id,status,timestamp,actor,attempt_number,metadata_json) SELECT :operation_id || '-reconciled',o.logical_email_id,CASE WHEN :outcome='accepted' THEN 'accepted' ELSE 'failed' END,:__now,:__user_id,o.attempt_count,'{"evidence":"human_reconciliation"}' FROM hiring_outbox o JOIN hiring_mail_reconciliations r ON r.original_draft_id=o.id WHERE r.id=:operation_id AND changes()=1 AND o.logical_email_id IS NOT NULL

tools.name: get_communication_reconciliation
tools.description: Scoped readback of human mail recovery evidence; never returns claim credentials.
tools.sql: SELECT r.id AS operation_id,r.outcome,r.evidence,r.actor_user_id,r.created_at,r.replacement_draft_id FROM hiring_mail_reconciliations r JOIN hiring_outbox o ON o.id=r.original_draft_id WHERE o.id=:draft_id AND o.organization_id=:organization_id AND o.brand_id=:brand_id AND o.application_id=:application_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND (:operation_id IS NULL OR (r.id=:operation_id AND r.actor_user_id=:__user_id AND r.outcome=:outcome AND r.evidence=:evidence))

tools.name: reclaim_stale_communication
tools.description: Operator recovery of a stale sending attempt to unknown only; preserves the claim and never authorizes resend. Default staleness 15 minutes, configurable in milliseconds. Compare expected_last_attempt_at from scoped draft reads. Zero changes is not confirmation.
statements: UPDATE hiring_outbox SET delivery_state='unknown' WHERE id=:draft_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND application_id=:application_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND delivery_state='sending' AND last_attempt_at=:expected_last_attempt_at AND typeof(:expected_last_attempt_at) IN ('integer','real') AND :expected_last_attempt_at=CAST(:expected_last_attempt_at AS INTEGER) AND typeof(COALESCE(:stale_after_ms,900000)) IN ('integer','real') AND COALESCE(:stale_after_ms,900000)=CAST(COALESCE(:stale_after_ms,900000) AS INTEGER) AND COALESCE(:stale_after_ms,900000) BETWEEN 1 AND 2147483647 AND last_attempt_at<=:__now-COALESCE(:stale_after_ms,900000)

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at,request_id,object_type,object_id,redacted_summary) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'outbox.completed',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now,:operation_id,'outbox',:draft_id,'outbox.stale_reclaimed' WHERE changes()=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id)))

tools.name: record_candidate_rights_event
tools.description: Owner-only versioned rights receipt, identity review, processing or decision. Opaque references only; no identity documents. Deletion/correction/withdrawal cannot be marked fulfilled by this action.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO hiring_rights_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,request_id,request_type,version,status,owner_user_id,deadline_at,proof_reference,decision_reference,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,:request_id,:request_type,:expected_version+1,:status,:owner_user_id,:deadline_at,:proof_reference,:decision_reference,:__user_id,:__now FROM hiring_applications a WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND length(trim(:request_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND length(trim(:owner_user_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND :deadline_at>0 AND :deadline_at=CAST(:deadline_at AS INTEGER) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:owner_user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND :request_type IN ('access','correction','withdrawal','deletion','export','objection') AND :status IN ('received','identity_verification','processing','fulfilled','denied_with_reason') AND (:proof_reference IS NULL OR length(trim(:proof_reference)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128) AND (:decision_reference IS NULL OR length(trim(:decision_reference)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE id=:operation_id OR operation_id=:operation_id) AND ((:expected_version=0 AND :status='received' AND :proof_reference IS NULL AND :decision_reference IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_rights_events WHERE request_id=:request_id)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT e.* FROM hiring_rights_events e WHERE e.request_id=:request_id ORDER BY e.version DESC LIMIT 1) old WHERE old.organization_id=:organization_id AND old.brand_id=:brand_id AND old.application_id=:application_id AND old.request_type=:request_type AND old.version=:expected_version AND ((old.status='received' AND :status IN ('identity_verification','denied_with_reason')) OR (old.status='identity_verification' AND :status IN ('processing','denied_with_reason')) OR (old.status='processing' AND :status IN ('fulfilled','denied_with_reason'))) AND (:status NOT IN ('processing','fulfilled') OR length(trim(:proof_reference)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128) AND (:status NOT IN ('fulfilled','denied_with_reason') OR length(trim(:decision_reference)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128))) AND (:status<>'fulfilled' OR :request_type IN ('access','export')) AND NOT (:request_type='correction' AND :status='denied_with_reason' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_corrections c WHERE c.request_id=:request_id))

tools.name: list_candidate_rights_events
tools.description: Owner-only bounded rights history for an exact application; missing and unauthorized both return no rows. Page by exclusive before_at/before_id.
tools.sql: SELECT e.* FROM hiring_rights_events e WHERE e.organization_id=:organization_id AND e.brand_id=:brand_id AND e.application_id=:application_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND (:rights_request_id IS NULL OR e.request_id=:rights_request_id) AND (:before_at IS NULL OR e.created_at<:before_at OR (e.created_at=:before_at AND e.id<:before_id)) ORDER BY e.created_at DESC,e.id DESC LIMIT 50

tools.name: authorize_gateway_list_applications
tools.description: Persist a content-free, server-derived access outcome before the corresponding audited read. Missing and denied share not_found. Receipt expires after 60 seconds.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO hiring_privacy_access(id,organization_id,brand_id,actor_user_id,action,target_id,outcome,created_at,expires_at) SELECT :request_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:__user_id,'gateway_list_applications','',CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT a.id,a.requisition_id,COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage) AS stage,a.version,CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_intake_receipts ir WHERE ir.application_id=a.id AND ir.organization_id=a.organization_id AND ir.brand_id=a.brand_id) THEN 'direct' ELSE COALESCE((SELECT s.source FROM hiring_application_sources s WHERE s.application_id=a.id),a.source) END AS source,a.assignee_user_id,a.created_at,a.updated_at,c.name AS candidate_name,(c.email IS NOT NULL AND c.email<>'') AS has_email,(c.phone IS NOT NULL AND c.phone<>'') AS has_phone,(COALESCE(c.linkedin_profile_url,NULLIF(c.linkedin_url,'')) IS NOT NULL) AS has_linkedin,r.title AS requisition_title FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id AND c.organization_id=a.organization_id AND c.brand_id=a.brand_id JOIN hiring_requisitions r ON r.id=a.requisition_id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id WHERE a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter' ,'reviewer') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id) AND (p.role<>'reviewer' OR a.assignee_user_id=:__user_id)) AND (:cursor_at IS NULL OR a.updated_at < :cursor_at OR (a.updated_at = :cursor_at AND a.id > :cursor_id)) AND (:stage IS NULL OR COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage)=:stage) AND (:requisition_id IS NULL OR a.requisition_id=:requisition_id) AND (:assignee IS NULL OR a.assignee_user_id=:assignee) AND (:source IS NULL OR (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_intake_receipts ir WHERE ir.application_id=a.id AND ir.organization_id=a.organization_id AND ir.brand_id=a.brand_id) THEN 'direct' ELSE COALESCE((SELECT s.source FROM hiring_application_sources s WHERE s.application_id=a.id),a.source) END)=:source) AND (:date_from IS NULL OR a.created_at>=:date_from) AND (:date_to IS NULL OR a.created_at<:date_to) ORDER BY a.updated_at DESC, a.id ASC LIMIT 25) permitted) THEN 'authorized' ELSE 'not_found' END,:__now,:__now+60000 WHERE length(trim(:request_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_privacy_access WHERE id=:request_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE id=:request_id OR operation_id=:request_id)
