tools.name: authorize_gateway_list_requisitions
tools.description: Persist a content-free, server-derived access outcome before the corresponding audited read. Missing and denied share not_found. Receipt expires after 60 seconds.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO hiring_privacy_access(id,organization_id,brand_id,actor_user_id,action,target_id,outcome,created_at,expires_at) SELECT :request_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:__user_id,'gateway_list_requisitions','',CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT r.id,r.title,r.status,r.created_at FROM hiring_requisitions r WHERE r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=r.id)) AND (:cursor_at IS NULL OR r.created_at < :cursor_at OR (r.created_at = :cursor_at AND r.id > :cursor_id)) ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id ASC LIMIT 25) permitted) THEN 'authorized' ELSE 'not_found' END,:__now,:__now+60000 WHERE length(trim(:request_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_privacy_access WHERE id=:request_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE id=:request_id OR operation_id=:request_id)

tools.name: audited_gateway_list_requisitions
tools.description: Receipt-bound restricted read. Current grants and assignment are rechecked; authorize_gateway_list_requisitions first.
tools.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT r.id,r.title,CASE WHEN j.lifecycle_status='expired' THEN 'expired' WHEN j.lifecycle_status='closed' OR j.status='closed' THEN 'closed' WHEN pc.paused=1 THEN 'paused' WHEN j.status='published' THEN 'published' ELSE 'draft' END AS status,r.created_at FROM hiring_requisitions r LEFT JOIN hiring_job_publications j ON j.requisition_id=r.id LEFT JOIN hiring_publication_controls pc ON pc.requisition_id=r.id WHERE r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=r.id)) AND (:cursor_at IS NULL OR r.created_at < :cursor_at OR (r.created_at = :cursor_at AND r.id > :cursor_id)) ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id ASC LIMIT 25) permitted WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_privacy_access x WHERE x.id=:request_id AND x.actor_user_id=:__user_id AND x.organization_id=:organization_id AND x.brand_id=:brand_id AND x.action='gateway_list_requisitions' AND x.target_id='' AND x.outcome='authorized' AND x.expires_at>:__now) LIMIT 25

tools.name: authorize_gateway_get_requisition
tools.description: Persist a content-free, server-derived access outcome before the corresponding audited read. Missing and denied share not_found. Receipt expires after 60 seconds.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO hiring_privacy_access(id,organization_id,brand_id,actor_user_id,action,target_id,outcome,created_at,expires_at) SELECT :request_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:__user_id,'gateway_get_requisition',:requisition_id,CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT r.id,r.title,r.status,r.created_at FROM hiring_requisitions r WHERE r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND r.id=:requisition_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=r.id)) LIMIT 1) permitted) THEN 'authorized' ELSE 'not_found' END,:__now,:__now+60000 WHERE length(trim(:request_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_privacy_access WHERE id=:request_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE id=:request_id OR operation_id=:request_id)

tools.name: audited_gateway_get_requisition
tools.description: Receipt-bound restricted read. Current grants and assignment are rechecked; authorize_gateway_get_requisition first.
tools.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT r.id,r.title,CASE WHEN j.lifecycle_status='expired' THEN 'expired' WHEN j.lifecycle_status='closed' OR j.status='closed' THEN 'closed' WHEN pc.paused=1 THEN 'paused' WHEN j.status='published' THEN 'published' ELSE 'draft' END AS status,r.created_at FROM hiring_requisitions r LEFT JOIN hiring_job_publications j ON j.requisition_id=r.id LEFT JOIN hiring_publication_controls pc ON pc.requisition_id=r.id WHERE r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND r.id=:requisition_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=r.id)) LIMIT 1) permitted WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_privacy_access x WHERE x.id=:request_id AND x.actor_user_id=:__user_id AND x.organization_id=:organization_id AND x.brand_id=:brand_id AND x.action='gateway_get_requisition' AND x.target_id=:requisition_id AND x.outcome='authorized' AND x.expires_at>:__now) LIMIT 25

tools.name: request_candidate_export
tools.description: Passkey-gated brand-wide owner export after recorded identity review. Audits authorized or not_found without disclosing existence. Private handle expires in 15 minutes. No stored export copy or email.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO hiring_privacy_access(id,organization_id,brand_id,actor_user_id,action,target_id,context_id,outcome,created_at,expires_at) SELECT :request_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:__user_id,'candidate_export',:application_id,:rights_request_id,CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT a.* FROM hiring_applications a WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id) a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT e.* FROM hiring_rights_events e WHERE e.request_id=:rights_request_id ORDER BY e.version DESC LIMIT 1) e WHERE e.organization_id=:organization_id AND e.brand_id=:brand_id AND e.application_id=:application_id AND e.request_type IN ('access','export') AND e.status='processing' AND length(trim(e.proof_reference)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erasure_requests er WHERE er.organization_id=a.organization_id AND er.brand_id=a.brand_id AND er.candidate_id=a.candidate_id)) THEN 'authorized' ELSE 'not_found' END,:__now,:__now+900000 WHERE length(trim(:request_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_privacy_access WHERE id=:request_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE id=:request_id OR operation_id=:request_id)

tools.name: get_candidate_export
tools.description: Private receipt-bound core export; rechecks owner, verified processing request, expiry and erasure on every read. No full-export claim; file bytes and confidential material excluded.
tools.sql: SELECT c.id AS candidate_id,c.name,c.email,c.phone,COALESCE(c.linkedin_profile_url,NULLIF(c.linkedin_url,'')) AS profile_url,(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('application_id',a.id,'requisition_title',r.title,'stage',COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage),'created_at',a.created_at,'notice_version',a.notice_version)) FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_requisitions r ON r.id=a.requisition_id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id WHERE a.candidate_id=c.id AND a.organization_id=c.organization_id AND a.brand_id=c.brand_id) AS applications_json,(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('application_id',cr.application_id,'purpose',cr.purpose,'legal_basis',cr.legal_basis,'notice_version',cr.notice_version,'recorded_at',cr.recorded_at,'withdrawn_at',cr.withdrawn_at)) FROM hiring_consent_records cr JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=cr.application_id AND a.organization_id=cr.organization_id AND a.brand_id=cr.brand_id WHERE a.candidate_id=c.id AND a.organization_id=c.organization_id AND a.brand_id=c.brand_id) AS consent_json,'scoped_core_export' AS coverage,'confidential_review_material_and_file_bytes_excluded' AS exclusions FROM hiring_candidates c JOIN hiring_applications target ON target.candidate_id=c.id AND target.organization_id=c.organization_id AND target.brand_id=c.brand_id WHERE target.id=:application_id AND c.organization_id=:organization_id AND c.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT e.* FROM hiring_rights_events e WHERE e.request_id=:rights_request_id ORDER BY e.version DESC LIMIT 1) e WHERE e.organization_id=:organization_id AND e.brand_id=:brand_id AND e.application_id=:application_id AND e.request_type IN ('access','export') AND e.status='processing' AND length(trim(e.proof_reference)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_privacy_access x WHERE x.id=:request_id AND x.organization_id=:organization_id AND x.brand_id=:brand_id AND x.actor_user_id=:__user_id AND x.action='candidate_export' AND x.context_id=:rights_request_id AND x.target_id=:application_id AND x.outcome='authorized' AND x.expires_at>:__now) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erasure_requests er WHERE er.candidate_id=c.id AND er.organization_id=c.organization_id AND er.brand_id=c.brand_id) LIMIT 1

tools.name: list_privacy_access_events
tools.description: Content-free access authorization history for brand-wide owners/auditors. Includes missing/denied attempts. Keyset page of 50.
tools.sql: SELECT id,actor_user_id,action,outcome,created_at,expires_at,EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_privacy_read_failures f WHERE f.request_id=hiring_privacy_access.id) AS read_unconfirmed FROM hiring_privacy_access WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','auditor') AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND (:before_at IS NULL OR created_at<:before_at OR (created_at=:before_at AND id<:before_id)) ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 50

tools.name: record_privacy_read_failure
tools.description: Append caller-reported unconfirmed retrieval against an existing owned authorization. This is uncertainty evidence, never a provider or server failure verdict. No error text stored.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO hiring_privacy_read_failures(request_id,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT x.id,:__user_id,:__now FROM hiring_privacy_access x WHERE x.id=:request_id AND x.actor_user_id=:__user_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_privacy_read_failures f WHERE f.request_id=x.id)

tools.name: get_operational_health
tools.description: Content-free exact brand/requisition outbox counts and ages. Failed/unknown counts exclude reconciled attempts. Privacy denial/unconfirmed counts cover recorded gateway/export attempts in the past 24 hours and require brand-wide owner/auditor; otherwise null. No provider delivery or complete telemetry claim. Brand-wide owner/auditor also sees retention failures, blocked/unknown steps, quota and outage counts; restricted callers receive null.
tools.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hiring_outbox o JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=o.application_id AND a.organization_id=o.organization_id AND a.brand_id=o.brand_id WHERE o.organization_id=:organization_id AND o.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter','auditor') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) AND o.delivery_state='pending') AS pending_count,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hiring_outbox o JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=o.application_id AND a.organization_id=o.organization_id AND a.brand_id=o.brand_id WHERE o.organization_id=:organization_id AND o.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter','auditor') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) AND o.delivery_state='sending') AS sending_count,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hiring_outbox o JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=o.application_id AND a.organization_id=o.organization_id AND a.brand_id=o.brand_id WHERE o.organization_id=:organization_id AND o.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter','auditor') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) AND o.delivery_state='failed' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_mail_reconciliations r WHERE r.original_draft_id=o.id)) AS failed_count,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hiring_outbox o JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=o.application_id AND a.organization_id=o.organization_id AND a.brand_id=o.brand_id WHERE o.organization_id=:organization_id AND o.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter','auditor') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) AND o.delivery_state='unknown' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_mail_reconciliations r WHERE r.original_draft_id=o.id)) AS unknown_count,(SELECT MAX(0,:__now-MIN(o.created_at)) FROM hiring_outbox o JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=o.application_id AND a.organization_id=o.organization_id AND a.brand_id=o.brand_id WHERE o.organization_id=:organization_id AND o.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter','auditor') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) AND o.delivery_state='pending') AS oldest_pending_draft_age_ms,(SELECT MAX(0,:__now-MIN(o.last_attempt_at)) FROM hiring_outbox o JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=o.application_id AND a.organization_id=o.organization_id AND a.brand_id=o.brand_id WHERE o.organization_id=:organization_id AND o.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter','auditor') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) AND o.delivery_state='sending') AS oldest_sending_age_ms,CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','auditor') AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hiring_privacy_access x WHERE x.organization_id=:organization_id AND x.brand_id=:brand_id AND x.created_at>=:__now-86400000 AND x.created_at<=:__now AND x.outcome='not_found') END AS denied_or_missing_24h,CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','auditor') AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hiring_privacy_access x WHERE x.organization_id=:organization_id AND x.brand_id=:brand_id AND x.created_at>=:__now-86400000 AND x.created_at<=:__now AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_privacy_read_failures f WHERE f.request_id=x.id)) END AS unconfirmed_reads_24h,CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','auditor') AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hiring_deletion_steps WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND state='failed') END AS retention_failed_count,CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','auditor') AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hiring_deletion_steps WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND state='blocked') END AS retention_blocked_count,CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','auditor') AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hiring_deletion_steps WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND state='unknown') END AS retention_unknown_count,CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','auditor') AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hiring_outbox o WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND delivery_state='failed' AND delivery_reason='quota' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_mail_reconciliations r WHERE r.original_draft_id=o.id)) END AS quota_count,CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','auditor') AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hiring_outbox o WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND delivery_state='failed' AND delivery_reason IN ('unavailable','approval_unavailable') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_mail_reconciliations r WHERE r.original_draft_id=o.id)) END AS outage_count,:__now AS observed_at WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter','auditor')) LIMIT 1

tools.name: withdraw_my_application
tools.description: Authenticated candidate withdraws their own exact application, without staff membership. Active state and expected version required. Atomic attributed stage/audit history; same operation retries cannot duplicate. Does not erase data or recall in-flight mail.
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_stage_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,from_stage,to_stage,version,reason,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,a.organization_id,a.brand_id,a.id,COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage),'withdrawn',a.version+1,'Candidate withdrew application',:__user_id,:__now FROM hiring_applications a WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_intake_receipts r WHERE r.application_id=a.id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id AND r.worker_user_id=:__user_id) AND a.version=:expected_version AND COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage) IN ('submitted','in_review','shortlisted','interviewing','decision_pending','offered') AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events WHERE id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE id=:operation_id OR operation_id=:operation_id)

UPDATE hiring_applications AS a SET stage='withdrawn',stage_extension=NULL,version=version+1,updated_at=:__now WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_intake_receipts r WHERE r.application_id=a.id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id AND r.worker_user_id=:__user_id) AND a.version=:expected_version AND a.accepted_stage IS NULL AND changes()=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events e WHERE e.id=:operation_id AND e.application_id=a.id AND e.organization_id=a.organization_id AND e.brand_id=a.brand_id AND e.actor_user_id=:__user_id AND e.version=a.version+1 AND e.to_stage='withdrawn')

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at,object_type,object_id,redacted_summary) SELECT :operation_id,a.organization_id,a.brand_id,a.id,'application.withdrawn',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now,'application',a.id,'Candidate withdrew application' FROM hiring_applications a WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_intake_receipts r WHERE r.application_id=a.id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id AND r.worker_user_id=:__user_id) AND changes()=1 AND a.stage='withdrawn' AND a.version=:expected_version+1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events e WHERE e.id=:operation_id AND e.application_id=a.id AND e.actor_user_id=:__user_id)

tools.name: issue_candidate_access_token
tools.description: Register a candidate-generated cryptographically random 256-bit hex token for one owned application and status or withdraw purpose. Expires after 15 minutes. Requires candidate sign-in, no staff role. Never put tokens in URLs or logs. At most 20 issuances per candidate per 15 minutes.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO hiring_candidate_access_tokens(token,application_id,worker_user_id,purpose,created_at,expires_at) SELECT :token,r.application_id,:__user_id,:purpose,:__now,:__now+900000 FROM hiring_intake_receipts r WHERE r.application_id=:application_id AND r.worker_user_id=:__user_id AND :purpose IN ('status','withdraw') AND length(:token)=64 AND :token NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_candidate_access_tokens WHERE token=:token) AND (SELECT count(*) FROM hiring_candidate_access_tokens WHERE worker_user_id=:__user_id AND created_at>:__now-900000)<20

tools.name: get_candidate_application_status
tools.description: Read only candidate-safe status using a live status-purpose token bound to the signed-in owner and exact application.
tools.sql: SELECT r.application_id,r.organization_id,r.brand_id,r.requisition_id,r.created_at,a.version,COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage) AS stage,q.title,b.name AS brand_name,o.name AS organization_name FROM hiring_intake_receipts r JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=r.application_id AND a.organization_id=r.organization_id AND a.brand_id=r.brand_id JOIN hiring_requisitions q ON q.id=r.requisition_id JOIN hiring_brands b ON b.id=r.brand_id JOIN hiring_organizations o ON o.id=r.organization_id WHERE r.worker_user_id=:__user_id AND r.application_id=:application_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_candidate_access_tokens t WHERE t.token=:token AND t.application_id=:application_id AND t.worker_user_id=:__user_id AND t.purpose='status' AND t.created_at<=:__now AND t.expires_at>:__now AND t.consumed_at IS NULL) LIMIT 1

tools.name: withdraw_candidate_application
tools.description: Single-use withdrawal token plus exact candidate ownership and version checks. Atomic stage, audit and token consumption. No staff login required.
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_stage_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,from_stage,to_stage,version,reason,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,a.organization_id,a.brand_id,a.id,COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage),'withdrawn',a.version+1,'Candidate withdrew application',:__user_id,:__now FROM hiring_applications a WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_intake_receipts r WHERE r.application_id=a.id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id AND r.worker_user_id=:__user_id) AND a.version=:expected_version AND COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage) IN ('submitted','in_review','shortlisted','interviewing','decision_pending','offered') AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events WHERE id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE id=:operation_id OR operation_id=:operation_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_candidate_access_tokens t WHERE t.token=:token AND t.application_id=:application_id AND t.worker_user_id=:__user_id AND t.purpose='withdraw' AND t.created_at<=:__now AND t.expires_at>:__now AND t.consumed_at IS NULL)

UPDATE hiring_applications AS a SET stage='withdrawn',stage_extension=NULL,version=version+1,updated_at=:__now WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_intake_receipts r WHERE r.application_id=a.id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id AND r.worker_user_id=:__user_id) AND a.version=:expected_version AND a.accepted_stage IS NULL AND changes()=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events e WHERE e.id=:operation_id AND e.application_id=a.id AND e.organization_id=a.organization_id AND e.brand_id=a.brand_id AND e.actor_user_id=:__user_id AND e.version=a.version+1 AND e.to_stage='withdrawn')

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at,object_type,object_id,redacted_summary) SELECT :operation_id,a.organization_id,a.brand_id,a.id,'application.withdrawn',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now,'application',a.id,'Candidate withdrew application' FROM hiring_applications a WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_intake_receipts r WHERE r.application_id=a.id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id AND r.worker_user_id=:__user_id) AND changes()=1 AND a.stage='withdrawn' AND a.version=:expected_version+1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events e WHERE e.id=:operation_id AND e.application_id=a.id AND e.actor_user_id=:__user_id)

UPDATE hiring_candidate_access_tokens SET consumed_at=:__now WHERE token=:token AND application_id=:application_id AND worker_user_id=:__user_id AND purpose='withdraw' AND consumed_at IS NULL AND changes()=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events e WHERE e.id=:operation_id AND e.application_id=:application_id AND e.actor_user_id=:__user_id AND e.action='application.withdrawn')

tools.name: suggest_candidate_duplicates
tools.description: suggest candidate duplicates
tools.sql: SELECT DISTINCT d.id,d.name,d.email,d.phone,COALESCE(d.linkedin_profile_url,NULLIF(d.linkedin_url,'')) AS linkedin_url,'email_match' AS match_reason FROM hiring_candidates c JOIN hiring_candidates d ON d.organization_id=c.organization_id AND d.brand_id=c.brand_id AND d.id<>c.id WHERE c.id=:candidate_id AND c.organization_id=:organization_id AND c.brand_id=:brand_id AND c.merged_into IS NULL AND d.merged_into IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_effective_access g ON g.organization_id=a.organization_id AND g.brand_id=a.brand_id WHERE a.candidate_id=c.id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND g.user_id=:__user_id AND g.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (g.requisition_id IS NULL OR g.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_effective_access g ON g.organization_id=a.organization_id AND g.brand_id=a.brand_id WHERE a.candidate_id=d.id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND g.user_id=:__user_id AND g.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (g.requisition_id IS NULL OR g.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) AND length(trim(c.email))>0 AND lower(trim(c.email))=lower(trim(d.email)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erasure_requests e WHERE e.candidate_id IN (c.id,d.id) AND e.organization_id=c.organization_id AND e.brand_id=c.brand_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_candidate_merges x WHERE x.source_id IN (c.id,d.id) OR x.target_id IN (c.id,d.id)) ORDER BY d.id LIMIT 50

tools.name: merge_candidates
tools.description: merge candidates
tools.sql: INSERT INTO hiring_candidate_merges(operation_id,organization_id,brand_id,source_id,target_id,actor_user_id,reason,field_sources_json,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,c.id,d.id,:__user_id,:reason,json_object('name',:name_source,'email',:email_source,'phone',:phone_source,'linkedin_url',:linkedin_url_source),:__now FROM hiring_candidates c JOIN hiring_candidates d ON d.organization_id=c.organization_id AND d.brand_id=c.brand_id WHERE c.id=:source_id AND d.id=:target_id AND c.id<>d.id AND c.organization_id=:organization_id AND c.brand_id=:brand_id AND c.merged_into IS NULL AND d.merged_into IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access g WHERE g.organization_id=:organization_id AND g.brand_id=:brand_id AND g.user_id=:__user_id AND g.role='owner' AND g.requisition_id IS NULL) AND :name_source IN (c.id,d.id) AND :email_source IN (c.id,d.id) AND :phone_source IN (c.id,d.id) AND :linkedin_url_source IN (c.id,d.id) AND length(trim(:reason)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000 AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_candidate_merges WHERE source_id=c.id OR target_id=c.id OR target_id=d.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE id=:operation_id OR operation_id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erasure_requests WHERE candidate_id IN (c.id,d.id) AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id)

tools.name: list_candidate_merges
tools.description: list candidate merges
tools.sql: SELECT x.*,f0.name AS name,f1.email AS email,f2.phone AS phone,COALESCE(f3.linkedin_profile_url,NULLIF(f3.linkedin_url,'')) AS linkedin_url FROM hiring_candidate_merges x JOIN hiring_candidates f0 ON f0.id=json_extract(x.field_sources_json,'$.name') AND f0.organization_id=x.organization_id AND f0.brand_id=x.brand_id JOIN hiring_candidates f1 ON f1.id=json_extract(x.field_sources_json,'$.email') AND f1.organization_id=x.organization_id AND f1.brand_id=x.brand_id JOIN hiring_candidates f2 ON f2.id=json_extract(x.field_sources_json,'$.phone') AND f2.organization_id=x.organization_id AND f2.brand_id=x.brand_id JOIN hiring_candidates f3 ON f3.id=json_extract(x.field_sources_json,'$.linkedin_url') AND f3.organization_id=x.organization_id AND f3.brand_id=x.brand_id WHERE x.organization_id=:organization_id AND x.brand_id=:brand_id AND (x.source_id=:candidate_id OR x.target_id=:candidate_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access g WHERE g.organization_id=:organization_id AND g.brand_id=:brand_id AND g.user_id=:__user_id AND g.role='owner' AND g.requisition_id IS NULL) ORDER BY x.created_at DESC LIMIT 50

tools.name: approve_communication_template
tools.description: Owner approves the exact current template version after review; edits invalidate approval
tools.sql: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_template_approvals(template_id,version,organization_id,brand_id,subject,body,approved_by,approved_at,operation_id) SELECT id,version,organization_id,brand_id,subject,body,:__user_id,:__now,:operation_id FROM hiring_communication_templates WHERE id=:template_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND version=:expected_version AND length(subject)<=200 AND instr(subject,char(10))=0 AND instr(subject,char(13))=0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128

tools.name: list_approved_communication_templates
tools.description: Approved current templates available to an authorized application sender
tools.sql: SELECT t.id,t.name,t.subject,t.body,t.version FROM hiring_communication_templates t JOIN hiring_template_approvals ap ON ap.template_id=t.id AND ap.version=t.version WHERE t.organization_id=:organization_id AND t.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_effective_access p ON p.organization_id=a.organization_id AND p.brand_id=a.brand_id WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) ORDER BY t.name LIMIT 100

tools.name: record_store_hold
tools.description: Owner records a candidate-wide hold across D1, R2 and indexes; in-flight deletion must settle before a new hold can be accepted.
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_store_holds(sequence,operation_id,organization_id,brand_id,candidate_id,state,reason_reference,review_at,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT MAX(COALESCE((SELECT MAX(sequence) FROM hiring_store_holds),0),COALESCE((SELECT MAX(sequence) FROM hiring_restore_hold_events WHERE ledger='stores'),0))+1,:operation_id,a.organization_id,a.brand_id,a.candidate_id,:state,:reason_reference,:review_at,:__user_id,:__now FROM hiring_applications a WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_store_holds WHERE operation_id=:operation_id)

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'retention.hold_recorded',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE changes()=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL)

tools.name: request_store_deletion
tools.description: Explicit owner continuation of an existing identity-verified core erasure request; never age-triggered.
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_deletion_requests(id,organization_id,brand_id,candidate_id,application_id,actor_user_id,created_at,origin) SELECT r.id,r.organization_id,r.brand_id,r.candidate_id,r.application_id,:__user_id,:__now,'explicit' FROM erasure_requests r WHERE r.id=:request_id AND r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND NOT (COALESCE((SELECT state FROM (SELECT h.state,h.sequence FROM erasure_hold_events h WHERE h.organization_id=r.organization_id AND h.brand_id=r.brand_id AND h.candidate_id=r.candidate_id UNION ALL SELECT h.state,h.sequence FROM hiring_restore_hold_events h WHERE h.organization_id=r.organization_id AND h.brand_id=r.brand_id AND h.candidate_id=r.candidate_id AND h.ledger='legacy') ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1),'released')='active' OR COALESCE((SELECT state FROM (SELECT h.state,h.sequence FROM hiring_store_holds h WHERE h.organization_id=r.organization_id AND h.brand_id=r.brand_id AND h.candidate_id=r.candidate_id UNION ALL SELECT h.state,h.sequence FROM hiring_restore_hold_events h WHERE h.organization_id=r.organization_id AND h.brand_id=r.brand_id AND h.candidate_id=r.candidate_id AND h.ledger='stores') ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1),'released')='active') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_deletion_requests WHERE id=:request_id)

INSERT INTO hiring_deletion_tombstones(request_id,organization_id,brand_id,candidate_id,application_id,created_at) SELECT id,organization_id,brand_id,candidate_id,application_id,created_at FROM hiring_deletion_requests r WHERE r.id=:request_id AND r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) ON CONFLICT(request_id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO hiring_deletion_objects(request_id,object_id,organization_id,brand_id,storage_path) SELECT r.id,f.id,r.organization_id,r.brand_id,f.storage_path FROM hiring_attachments f JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=f.application_id JOIN hiring_deletion_requests r ON r.candidate_id=a.candidate_id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id WHERE r.id=:request_id AND r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) ON CONFLICT(request_id,object_id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO hiring_deletion_steps(request_id,organization_id,brand_id,store,state) SELECT id,organization_id,brand_id,'d1','pending' FROM hiring_deletion_requests r WHERE r.id=:request_id AND r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) ON CONFLICT(request_id,store) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO hiring_deletion_steps(request_id,organization_id,brand_id,store,state) SELECT id,organization_id,brand_id,'r2','pending' FROM hiring_deletion_requests r WHERE r.id=:request_id AND r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) ON CONFLICT(request_id,store) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO hiring_deletion_steps(request_id,organization_id,brand_id,store,state) SELECT id,organization_id,brand_id,'index','pending' FROM hiring_deletion_requests r WHERE r.id=:request_id AND r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) ON CONFLICT(request_id,store) DO NOTHING

tools.name: get_store_deletion
tools.description: Read owner-scoped durable progress; no content or storage keys.
tools.sql: SELECT s.store,s.state,s.reason_code,s.attempts FROM hiring_deletion_steps s JOIN hiring_deletion_requests r ON r.id=s.request_id WHERE r.id=:request_id AND r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) ORDER BY s.store LIMIT 3

tools.name: check_store_hold
tools.description: Worker-authoritative current hold check, exact deletion scope.
tools.sql: SELECT r.id AS request_id,r.candidate_id,r.application_id,(COALESCE((SELECT state FROM (SELECT h.state,h.sequence FROM erasure_hold_events h WHERE h.organization_id=r.organization_id AND h.brand_id=r.brand_id AND h.candidate_id=r.candidate_id UNION ALL SELECT h.state,h.sequence FROM hiring_restore_hold_events h WHERE h.organization_id=r.organization_id AND h.brand_id=r.brand_id AND h.candidate_id=r.candidate_id AND h.ledger='legacy') ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1),'released')='active' OR COALESCE((SELECT state FROM (SELECT h.state,h.sequence FROM hiring_store_holds h WHERE h.organization_id=r.organization_id AND h.brand_id=r.brand_id AND h.candidate_id=r.candidate_id UNION ALL SELECT h.state,h.sequence FROM hiring_restore_hold_events h WHERE h.organization_id=r.organization_id AND h.brand_id=r.brand_id AND h.candidate_id=r.candidate_id AND h.ledger='stores') ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1),'released')='active') AS held FROM hiring_deletion_requests r WHERE r.id=:request_id AND r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND :__user_id=('system'||char(58)||'worker') LIMIT 1

tools.name: claim_store_deletion
tools.description: Worker claims a store step atomically against latest holds. No age-based reclaim.
statements: UPDATE hiring_deletion_steps SET state='running',attempt_id=:attempt_id,attempts=attempts+1,reason_code=NULL WHERE request_id=:request_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND store=:store AND state IN ('pending','failed','blocked') AND :__user_id=('system'||char(58)||'worker') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_deletion_requests r WHERE r.id=:request_id AND r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND NOT (COALESCE((SELECT state FROM (SELECT h.state,h.sequence FROM erasure_hold_events h WHERE h.organization_id=r.organization_id AND h.brand_id=r.brand_id AND h.candidate_id=r.candidate_id UNION ALL SELECT h.state,h.sequence FROM hiring_restore_hold_events h WHERE h.organization_id=r.organization_id AND h.brand_id=r.brand_id AND h.candidate_id=r.candidate_id AND h.ledger='legacy') ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1),'released')='active' OR COALESCE((SELECT state FROM (SELECT h.state,h.sequence FROM hiring_store_holds h WHERE h.organization_id=r.organization_id AND h.brand_id=r.brand_id AND h.candidate_id=r.candidate_id UNION ALL SELECT h.state,h.sequence FROM hiring_restore_hold_events h WHERE h.organization_id=r.organization_id AND h.brand_id=r.brand_id AND h.candidate_id=r.candidate_id AND h.ledger='stores') ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1),'released')='active')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_restore_sessions WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND state='importing')

INSERT INTO hiring_retention_evidence(request_id,organization_id,brand_id,store,attempt_id,outcome,created_at) SELECT request_id,organization_id,brand_id,store,attempt_id,state,:__now FROM hiring_deletion_steps WHERE request_id=:request_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND store=:store AND attempt_id=:attempt_id AND :__user_id=('system'||char(58)||'worker') AND changes()=1

tools.name: get_store_deletion_attempt
tools.description: Worker reads its exact running/unknown attempt.
tools.sql: SELECT s.store,s.state,s.attempt_id,r.candidate_id,r.application_id,r.origin FROM hiring_deletion_steps s JOIN hiring_deletion_requests r ON r.id=s.request_id WHERE r.id=:request_id AND r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND s.store=:store AND s.attempt_id=:attempt_id AND s.state IN ('running','unknown') AND :__user_id=('system'||char(58)||'worker') LIMIT 1

tools.name: finish_store_deletion
tools.description: Worker persists verified outcome and content-free evidence atomically. Unknown outcomes keep the hold interlock.
statements: UPDATE hiring_deletion_steps SET state=:outcome,reason_code=:reason_code WHERE request_id=:request_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND store=:store AND attempt_id=:attempt_id AND state IN ('running','unknown') AND :outcome IN ('complete','failed','blocked','unknown') AND :reason_code IN ('verified_absent','retryable','adapter_unavailable','protected_records','unconfirmed') AND (:outcome<>'complete' OR :reason_code='verified_absent') AND :__user_id=('system'||char(58)||'worker') AND state<>:outcome

INSERT INTO hiring_retention_evidence(request_id,organization_id,brand_id,store,attempt_id,outcome,created_at) SELECT request_id,organization_id,brand_id,store,attempt_id,state,:__now FROM hiring_deletion_steps WHERE request_id=:request_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND store=:store AND attempt_id=:attempt_id AND :__user_id=('system'||char(58)||'worker') AND changes()=1

tools.name: list_deletion_objects
tools.description: Worker-only attachment inventory derived from the candidate scope; cursor pages every object.
tools.sql: SELECT f.object_id AS id,f.storage_path FROM hiring_deletion_objects f JOIN hiring_deletion_requests r ON r.id=f.request_id WHERE r.id=:request_id AND r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND f.object_id>COALESCE(:after_id,'') AND :__user_id=('system'||char(58)||'worker') UNION SELECT f.id,f.storage_path FROM hiring_attachments f JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=f.application_id JOIN hiring_deletion_requests r ON r.candidate_id=a.candidate_id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id WHERE r.id=:request_id AND r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND f.id>COALESCE(:after_id,'') AND :__user_id=('system'||char(58)||'worker') ORDER BY id LIMIT 100

tools.name: export_retention_tombstones
tools.description: Owner exports a paged private content-free tombstone ledger, including original core-only requests.
tools.sql: SELECT request_id,organization_id,brand_id,candidate_id,application_id,MIN(created_at) AS created_at FROM (SELECT r.id AS request_id,r.organization_id,r.brand_id,r.candidate_id,r.application_id,r.created_at FROM erasure_requests r WHERE r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND r.id>COALESCE(:after_id,'') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) UNION SELECT t.request_id,t.organization_id,t.brand_id,t.candidate_id,t.application_id,t.created_at FROM hiring_deletion_tombstones t WHERE t.organization_id=:organization_id AND t.brand_id=:brand_id AND t.request_id>COALESCE(:after_id,'') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) UNION SELECT t.request_id,t.organization_id,t.brand_id,t.candidate_id,t.application_id,t.created_at FROM hiring_restore_tombstones t WHERE t.organization_id=:organization_id AND t.brand_id=:brand_id AND t.request_id>COALESCE(:after_id,'') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL)) GROUP BY request_id,organization_id,brand_id,candidate_id,application_id ORDER BY request_id LIMIT 100

tools.name: export_retention_holds
tools.description: Owner exports both hold ledgers, including releases and review metadata. Keep reason references private.
tools.sql: SELECT sequence,operation_id,organization_id,brand_id,candidate_id,state,reason_reference,review_at,actor_user_id,created_at FROM hiring_store_holds WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND sequence>COALESCE(:after_sequence,0) AND :ledger='stores' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) UNION ALL SELECT sequence,operation_id,organization_id,brand_id,candidate_id,state,reason_reference,review_at,actor_user_id,created_at FROM erasure_hold_events WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND sequence>COALESCE(:after_sequence,0) AND :ledger='legacy' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) ORDER BY sequence LIMIT 100

tools.name: retention_ledger_watermark
tools.description: Authorize private owner export and detect concurrent ledger changes.
tools.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM erasure_requests WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AS core_count,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hiring_deletion_tombstones WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AS tombstone_count,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM erasure_hold_events WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AS legacy_count,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hiring_store_holds WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AS store_count,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hiring_restore_hold_events WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AS replayed_hold_count,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hiring_deletion_objects WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AS object_count,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hiring_restore_tombstones WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AS restored_tombstone_count,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hiring_attachments WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AS attachment_count FROM hiring_brands WHERE id=:brand_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) LIMIT 1

tools.name: begin_retention_restore
tools.description: Worker starts a closed-gate isolated restore. The signed manifest digest identifies the exact ledger.
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_restore_sessions(id,organization_id,brand_id,digest,tombstone_count,hold_count,state,created_at) SELECT :restore_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:digest,:tombstone_count,:hold_count,'importing',:__now WHERE :__user_id=('system'||char(58)||'worker') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_deletion_steps WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND state IN ('running','unknown')) ON CONFLICT(id) DO NOTHING

tools.name: import_retention_tombstone
tools.description: Worker imports verified manifest tombstones and creates fresh replay steps; previous completion never skips restored copies.
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_restore_tombstones(restore_id,request_id,organization_id,brand_id,candidate_id,application_id,created_at) SELECT :restore_id,:request_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:candidate_id,:application_id,:created_at WHERE :__user_id=('system'||char(58)||'worker') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_restore_sessions WHERE id=:restore_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND state='importing') ON CONFLICT(restore_id,request_id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO hiring_deletion_requests(id,organization_id,brand_id,candidate_id,application_id,actor_user_id,created_at,origin) SELECT :restore_id||':'||request_id,organization_id,brand_id,candidate_id,application_id,('system'||char(58)||'worker'),created_at,'restore' FROM hiring_restore_tombstones WHERE restore_id=:restore_id AND request_id=:request_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND :__user_id=('system'||char(58)||'worker') ON CONFLICT(id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO hiring_deletion_steps(request_id,organization_id,brand_id,store,state) SELECT id,organization_id,brand_id,'d1','pending' FROM hiring_deletion_requests r WHERE id=:restore_id||':'||:request_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND :__user_id=('system'||char(58)||'worker') ON CONFLICT(request_id,store) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO hiring_deletion_steps(request_id,organization_id,brand_id,store,state) SELECT id,organization_id,brand_id,'r2','pending' FROM hiring_deletion_requests r WHERE id=:restore_id||':'||:request_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND :__user_id=('system'||char(58)||'worker') ON CONFLICT(request_id,store) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO hiring_deletion_steps(request_id,organization_id,brand_id,store,state) SELECT id,organization_id,brand_id,'index','pending' FROM hiring_deletion_requests r WHERE id=:restore_id||':'||:request_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND :__user_id=('system'||char(58)||'worker') ON CONFLICT(request_id,store) DO NOTHING

tools.name: import_retention_hold
tools.description: Worker imports verified hold history before replay, preserving separate legacy/store ledgers.
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_restore_hold_events(restore_id,ledger,sequence,organization_id,brand_id,candidate_id,state,reason_reference,review_at,actor_user_id,created_at,operation_id) SELECT :restore_id,:ledger,:sequence,:organization_id,:brand_id,:candidate_id,:state,:reason_reference,:review_at,:actor_user_id,:created_at,:operation_id WHERE :__user_id=('system'||char(58)||'worker') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_restore_sessions WHERE id=:restore_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND state='importing') ON CONFLICT(restore_id,ledger,sequence) DO NOTHING

tools.name: seal_retention_restore
tools.description: Worker seals complete import before any store claim is permitted.
statements: UPDATE hiring_restore_sessions SET state='replaying' WHERE id=:restore_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND digest=:digest AND state='importing' AND :__user_id=('system'||char(58)||'worker') AND tombstone_count=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hiring_restore_tombstones WHERE restore_id=:restore_id) AND hold_count=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hiring_restore_hold_events WHERE restore_id=:restore_id)

tools.name: get_retention_restore
tools.description: Worker reads replay readiness. Caller must keep access/intake/dispatch closed until ready and separately verified.
tools.sql: SELECT z.state,z.digest,z.tombstone_count,z.hold_count,NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_restore_tombstones t JOIN hiring_deletion_steps s ON s.request_id=z.id||':'||t.request_id WHERE t.restore_id=z.id AND s.state<>'complete') AS stores_complete FROM hiring_restore_sessions z WHERE z.id=:restore_id AND z.digest=:digest AND z.organization_id=:organization_id AND z.brand_id=:brand_id AND :__user_id=('system'||char(58)||'worker') LIMIT 1

tools.name: finish_retention_restore
tools.description: Worker records readiness only after all restored store steps verify absence.
statements: UPDATE hiring_restore_sessions SET state='ready' WHERE id=:restore_id AND digest=:digest AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND state='replaying' AND :__user_id=('system'||char(58)||'worker') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_restore_tombstones t LEFT JOIN hiring_deletion_steps s ON s.request_id=:restore_id||':'||t.request_id WHERE t.restore_id=:restore_id GROUP BY t.request_id HAVING COUNT(s.store)<>3 OR SUM(s.state='complete')<>3)

tools.name: worker_get_store_deletion
tools.description: Worker reads scoped progress without caller claims.
tools.sql: SELECT s.store,s.state,s.reason_code,s.attempts FROM hiring_deletion_steps s JOIN hiring_deletion_requests r ON r.id=s.request_id WHERE r.id=:request_id AND r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND :__user_id=('system'||char(58)||'worker') ORDER BY s.store LIMIT 3

tools.name: purge_store_d1
tools.description: Worker redacts restored core and deletes mutable local content only. Protected archives are reported as blockers; this action cannot declare whole-subject erasure.
statements: UPDATE hiring_candidates SET name='[redacted]',email='[redacted]',phone='[redacted]',linkedin_url='[redacted]',linkedin_profile_url=NULL WHERE id IN (SELECT candidate_id FROM hiring_deletion_requests r WHERE r.id=:request_id AND r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_deletion_steps s JOIN hiring_deletion_requests r ON r.id=s.request_id WHERE r.id=:request_id AND r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND s.store='d1' AND s.attempt_id=:attempt_id AND s.state='running' AND NOT (COALESCE((SELECT state FROM (SELECT h.state,h.sequence FROM erasure_hold_events h WHERE h.organization_id=r.organization_id AND h.brand_id=r.brand_id AND h.candidate_id=r.candidate_id UNION ALL SELECT h.state,h.sequence FROM hiring_restore_hold_events h WHERE h.organization_id=r.organization_id AND h.brand_id=r.brand_id AND h.candidate_id=r.candidate_id AND h.ledger='legacy') ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1),'released')='active' OR COALESCE((SELECT state FROM (SELECT h.state,h.sequence FROM hiring_store_holds h WHERE h.organization_id=r.organization_id AND h.brand_id=r.brand_id AND h.candidate_id=r.candidate_id UNION ALL SELECT h.state,h.sequence FROM hiring_restore_hold_events h WHERE h.organization_id=r.organization_id AND h.brand_id=r.brand_id AND h.candidate_id=r.candidate_id AND h.ledger='stores') ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1),'released')='active') AND :__user_id=('system'||char(58)||'worker')) AND (name<>'[redacted]' OR email<>'[redacted]' OR phone<>'[redacted]' OR linkedin_url<>'[redacted]' OR linkedin_profile_url IS NOT NULL)

tools.name: export_retention_objects
tools.description: Owner exports private opaque object inventory for an exact core tombstone; never expose storage paths as audit evidence.
tools.sql: SELECT f.object_id AS id,f.storage_path FROM hiring_deletion_objects f JOIN hiring_deletion_requests r ON r.id=f.request_id WHERE r.id=:request_id AND r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND f.object_id>COALESCE(:after_id,'') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) UNION SELECT f.id,f.storage_path FROM hiring_attachments f JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=f.application_id JOIN erasure_requests r ON r.candidate_id=a.candidate_id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id WHERE r.id=:request_id AND r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND f.id>COALESCE(:after_id,'') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) UNION SELECT f.object_id AS id,f.storage_path FROM hiring_deletion_objects f JOIN hiring_restore_tombstones t ON f.request_id=t.restore_id||':'||t.request_id WHERE t.request_id=:request_id AND t.organization_id=:organization_id AND t.brand_id=:brand_id AND f.object_id>COALESCE(:after_id,'') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) ORDER BY id LIMIT 100

tools.name: import_retention_object
tools.description: Worker imports signed private object inventory; exact scope derives from the replay request.
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_deletion_objects(request_id,object_id,organization_id,brand_id,storage_path) SELECT r.id,:object_id,r.organization_id,r.brand_id,:storage_path FROM hiring_deletion_requests r WHERE r.id=:request_id AND r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND r.origin='restore' AND :__user_id=('system'||char(58)||'worker') ON CONFLICT(request_id,object_id) DO NOTHING

tools.name: export_replayed_retention_holds
tools.description: Owner exports previously restored hold ledgers so subsequent backups preserve them too.
tools.sql: SELECT restore_id||'/'||ledger||'/'||printf('%020d',sequence) AS cursor,ledger,sequence,operation_id,organization_id,brand_id,candidate_id,state,reason_reference,review_at,actor_user_id,created_at FROM hiring_restore_hold_events WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND restore_id||'/'||ledger||'/'||printf('%020d',sequence)>COALESCE(:after_id,'') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) ORDER BY cursor LIMIT 100

tools.name: release_restored_store_hold
tools.description: Owner explicitly releases a restored hold stream after reviewing it. No review-date expiry.
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_restore_hold_events(restore_id,ledger,sequence,organization_id,brand_id,candidate_id,state,reason_reference,review_at,actor_user_id,created_at,operation_id) SELECT :restore_id,:ledger,MAX(COALESCE((SELECT MAX(sequence) FROM hiring_restore_hold_events WHERE ledger=:ledger),0),CASE WHEN :ledger='legacy' THEN COALESCE((SELECT MAX(sequence) FROM erasure_hold_events),0) ELSE COALESCE((SELECT MAX(sequence) FROM hiring_store_holds),0) END)+1,:organization_id,:brand_id,a.candidate_id,'released',:reason_reference,:review_at,:__user_id,:__now,:operation_id FROM hiring_applications a WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND :ledger IN ('legacy','stores') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_restore_hold_events WHERE restore_id=:restore_id AND candidate_id=a.candidate_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND ledger=:ledger) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_deletion_steps s JOIN hiring_deletion_requests r ON r.id=s.request_id WHERE r.candidate_id=a.candidate_id AND r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND s.state IN ('running','unknown')) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_restore_hold_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id)

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'retention.restored_hold_released',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE changes()=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL)

tools.name: submit_my_rights_request
tools.description: Submit access, correction, withdrawal or erasure (deletion) request for an application owned by the authenticated candidate. No email lookup. Retry with the same request ID and confirm through list_my_rights_requests. Identity review and deadline assignment follow separately.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO hiring_rights_intake(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,request_type,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT :request_id,i.organization_id,i.brand_id,i.application_id,:request_type,:__user_id,:__now FROM hiring_intake_receipts i WHERE i.organization_id=:organization_id AND i.brand_id=:brand_id AND i.application_id=:application_id AND i.worker_user_id=:__user_id AND :request_type IN ('access','correction','withdrawal','deletion') AND length(trim(:request_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_rights_intake WHERE id=:request_id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_rights_events WHERE request_id=:request_id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE id=:request_id OR operation_id=:request_id)

tools.name: list_my_rights_requests
tools.description: Scoped rights receipts and latest status. No identity or decision case references. Missing and unauthorized return identical empty rows. Newest first, 50 per page.
tools.sql: SELECT i.id AS request_id,i.application_id,i.request_type,i.created_at,COALESCE(e.status,'received') AS status,e.deadline_at,e.owner_user_id,e.version FROM hiring_rights_intake i LEFT JOIN hiring_rights_events e ON e.request_id=i.id AND e.version=(SELECT MAX(v.version) FROM hiring_rights_events v WHERE v.request_id=i.id) WHERE i.organization_id=:organization_id AND i.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_intake_receipts r WHERE r.application_id=i.application_id AND r.organization_id=i.organization_id AND r.brand_id=i.brand_id AND r.worker_user_id=:__user_id) AND i.application_id=:application_id AND i.actor_user_id=:__user_id AND (:before_at IS NULL OR i.created_at<:before_at OR (i.created_at=:before_at AND i.id<:before_id)) ORDER BY i.created_at DESC,i.id DESC LIMIT 50

tools.name: list_brand_rights_intake
tools.description: Scoped rights receipts and latest status. No identity or decision case references. Missing and unauthorized return identical empty rows. Newest first, 50 per page.
tools.sql: SELECT i.id AS request_id,i.application_id,i.request_type,i.created_at,COALESCE(e.status,'received') AS status,e.deadline_at,e.owner_user_id,e.version FROM hiring_rights_intake i LEFT JOIN hiring_rights_events e ON e.request_id=i.id AND e.version=(SELECT MAX(v.version) FROM hiring_rights_events v WHERE v.request_id=i.id) WHERE i.organization_id=:organization_id AND i.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=i.organization_id AND p.brand_id=i.brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND (:before_at IS NULL OR i.created_at<:before_at OR (i.created_at=:before_at AND i.id<:before_id)) ORDER BY i.created_at DESC,i.id DESC LIMIT 50

tools.name: attest_candidate_rights_completion
tools.description: Owner/passkey reviewed completion. Correction requires local execution and verified completion of every queued processor. Withdrawal/deletion remain external execution attestations.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO hiring_rights_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,request_id,request_type,version,status,owner_user_id,deadline_at,proof_reference,decision_reference,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,:request_id,:request_type,:expected_version+1,:status,:owner_user_id,:deadline_at,:proof_reference,:decision_reference,:__user_id,:__now FROM hiring_applications a WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND length(trim(:request_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND length(trim(:owner_user_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND :deadline_at>0 AND :deadline_at=CAST(:deadline_at AS INTEGER) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:owner_user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND :request_type IN ('access','correction','withdrawal','deletion','export','objection') AND :status IN ('received','identity_verification','processing','fulfilled','denied_with_reason') AND (:proof_reference IS NULL OR length(trim(:proof_reference)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128) AND (:decision_reference IS NULL OR length(trim(:decision_reference)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE id=:operation_id OR operation_id=:operation_id) AND ((:expected_version=0 AND :status='received' AND :proof_reference IS NULL AND :decision_reference IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_rights_events WHERE request_id=:request_id)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT e.* FROM hiring_rights_events e WHERE e.request_id=:request_id ORDER BY e.version DESC LIMIT 1) old WHERE old.organization_id=:organization_id AND old.brand_id=:brand_id AND old.application_id=:application_id AND old.request_type=:request_type AND old.version=:expected_version AND ((old.status='received' AND :status IN ('identity_verification','denied_with_reason')) OR (old.status='identity_verification' AND :status IN ('processing','denied_with_reason')) OR (old.status='processing' AND :status IN ('fulfilled','denied_with_reason'))) AND (:status NOT IN ('processing','fulfilled') OR length(trim(:proof_reference)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128) AND (:status NOT IN ('fulfilled','denied_with_reason') OR length(trim(:decision_reference)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128))) AND :status='fulfilled' AND :request_type IN ('correction','withdrawal','deletion') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_corrections c JOIN hiring_rectification_targets t ON t.correction_id=c.id WHERE c.request_id=:request_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_rectification_attempts x WHERE x.correction_id=t.correction_id AND x.processor_id=t.processor_id AND x.state='complete')) AND (:request_type<>'correction' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_corrections c WHERE c.request_id=:request_id))

tools.name: queue_candidate_export
tools.description: Queue private asynchronous subject export using an existing verified, principal-bound authorization. Retries never extend expiry.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO hiring_export_jobs(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,candidate_id,rights_request_id,actor_user_id,created_at,expires_at) SELECT :request_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,c.id,:rights_request_id,:__user_id,:__now,(SELECT expires_at FROM hiring_privacy_access WHERE id=:request_id) FROM hiring_candidates c JOIN hiring_applications target ON target.candidate_id=c.id AND target.organization_id=c.organization_id AND target.brand_id=c.brand_id WHERE target.id=:application_id AND c.organization_id=:organization_id AND c.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT e.* FROM hiring_rights_events e WHERE e.request_id=:rights_request_id ORDER BY e.version DESC LIMIT 1) e WHERE e.organization_id=:organization_id AND e.brand_id=:brand_id AND e.application_id=:application_id AND e.request_type IN ('access','export') AND e.status='processing' AND length(trim(e.proof_reference)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_privacy_access x WHERE x.id=:request_id AND x.organization_id=:organization_id AND x.brand_id=:brand_id AND x.actor_user_id=:__user_id AND x.action='candidate_export' AND x.context_id=:rights_request_id AND x.target_id=:application_id AND x.outcome='authorized' AND x.expires_at>:__now) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erasure_requests er WHERE er.candidate_id=c.id AND er.organization_id=c.organization_id AND er.brand_id=c.brand_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_export_jobs WHERE id=:request_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_deletion_requests d WHERE d.candidate_id=c.id AND d.organization_id=c.organization_id AND d.brand_id=c.brand_id)

tools.name: get_candidate_export_status
tools.description: Private current authorization and expiry checked job status. Missing and denied are identical.
tools.sql: SELECT j.state,j.expires_at FROM hiring_export_jobs j WHERE j.id=:request_id AND j.organization_id=:organization_id AND j.brand_id=:brand_id AND j.application_id=:application_id AND j.rights_request_id=:rights_request_id AND j.actor_user_id=:__user_id AND j.expires_at>:__now AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=j.organization_id AND p.brand_id=j.brand_id AND p.user_id=j.actor_user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_rights_events e WHERE e.request_id=j.rights_request_id AND e.organization_id=j.organization_id AND e.brand_id=j.brand_id AND e.application_id=j.application_id AND e.request_type IN ('access','export') AND e.status='processing' AND length(trim(e.proof_reference)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND e.version=(SELECT max(version) FROM hiring_rights_events WHERE request_id=e.request_id)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erasure_requests er WHERE er.organization_id=j.organization_id AND er.brand_id=j.brand_id AND er.candidate_id=j.candidate_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_deletion_requests d WHERE d.organization_id=j.organization_id AND d.brand_id=j.brand_id AND d.candidate_id=j.candidate_id) LIMIT 1

tools.name: list_candidate_export_queue
tools.description: Trusted worker polls pending exports; no PII or artifact returned.
tools.sql: SELECT id AS request_id,organization_id,brand_id FROM hiring_export_jobs WHERE state='queued' AND expires_at>:__now AND :__user_id=('system'||char(58)||'worker') ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT 25

tools.name: assemble_candidate_export
tools.description: Worker assembles a durable private JSON snapshot from an explicit server projection; excludes confidential fields. Atomic readiness and content-free audit.
tools.sql: UPDATE hiring_export_jobs AS j SET payload_json=(SELECT json_object('format_version',1,'coverage','brand_subject_export','candidate',json_object('id',candidate_id,'name',name,'email',email,'phone',phone,'profile_url',profile_url),'applications',json(applications_json),'consents',json(consent_json),'submissions',json((SELECT json_group_array(json_object('application_id',r.application_id,'statement',json_extract(r.payload_json,'$.statement'),'notice_acknowledged',json_extract(r.payload_json,'$.notice_acknowledged'),'created_at',r.created_at)) FROM hiring_intake_receipts r JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=r.application_id AND a.organization_id=r.organization_id AND a.brand_id=r.brand_id WHERE a.candidate_id=j.candidate_id AND a.organization_id=j.organization_id AND a.brand_id=j.brand_id)),'attachments',json((SELECT json_group_array(json_object('application_id',f.application_id,'filename',f.filename,'mime_type',f.mime_type,'size_bytes',f.size_bytes,'scan_state',f.scan_state)) FROM hiring_attachments f JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=f.application_id AND a.organization_id=f.organization_id AND a.brand_id=f.brand_id WHERE a.candidate_id=j.candidate_id AND a.organization_id=j.organization_id AND a.brand_id=j.brand_id AND f.deleted_at IS NULL AND f.scan_state<>'deleted')),'internship_onboarding',json((SELECT json_group_array(json_object('application_id',x.application_id,'status',x.status,'discord_status',x.discord_status,'discord_username',x.discord_username,'created_at',x.created_at)) FROM hiring_internship_progress x JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=x.application_id AND a.organization_id=x.organization_id AND a.brand_id=x.brand_id WHERE a.candidate_id=j.candidate_id AND a.organization_id=j.organization_id AND a.brand_id=j.brand_id)),'exclusions',json_array('confidential sourcing, notes, reviews, decisions and internal correspondence','independent worker account','file bytes - available through separately authorized private file retrieval')) FROM (SELECT c.id AS candidate_id,c.name,c.email,c.phone,COALESCE(c.linkedin_profile_url,NULLIF(c.linkedin_url,'')) AS profile_url,(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('application_id',a.id,'requisition_title',r.title,'stage',COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage),'created_at',a.created_at,'notice_version',a.notice_version)) FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_requisitions r ON r.id=a.requisition_id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id WHERE a.candidate_id=c.id AND a.organization_id=c.organization_id AND a.brand_id=c.brand_id) AS applications_json,(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('application_id',cr.application_id,'purpose',cr.purpose,'legal_basis',cr.legal_basis,'notice_version',cr.notice_version,'recorded_at',cr.recorded_at,'withdrawn_at',cr.withdrawn_at)) FROM hiring_consent_records cr JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=cr.application_id AND a.organization_id=cr.organization_id AND a.brand_id=cr.brand_id WHERE a.candidate_id=c.id AND a.organization_id=c.organization_id AND a.brand_id=c.brand_id) AS consent_json FROM hiring_candidates c WHERE c.id=j.candidate_id AND c.organization_id=j.organization_id AND c.brand_id=j.brand_id)),state='ready',assembled_at=:__now WHERE j.id=:request_id AND j.organization_id=:organization_id AND j.brand_id=:brand_id AND :__user_id=('system'||char(58)||'worker') AND j.state='queued' AND j.expires_at>:__now AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=j.organization_id AND p.brand_id=j.brand_id AND p.user_id=j.actor_user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_rights_events e WHERE e.request_id=j.rights_request_id AND e.organization_id=j.organization_id AND e.brand_id=j.brand_id AND e.application_id=j.application_id AND e.request_type IN ('access','export') AND e.status='processing' AND length(trim(e.proof_reference)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND e.version=(SELECT max(version) FROM hiring_rights_events WHERE request_id=e.request_id)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erasure_requests er WHERE er.organization_id=j.organization_id AND er.brand_id=j.brand_id AND er.candidate_id=j.candidate_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_deletion_requests d WHERE d.organization_id=j.organization_id AND d.brand_id=j.brand_id AND d.candidate_id=j.candidate_id)

tools.name: authorize_candidate_export_download
tools.description: Log each private artifact access attempt before retrieval, including denied/expired attempts. A fresh access_id is required for each download.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO hiring_privacy_access(id,organization_id,brand_id,actor_user_id,action,target_id,context_id,outcome,created_at,expires_at) SELECT :access_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:__user_id,'candidate_export_download',:application_id,:request_id,CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_export_jobs j WHERE j.id=:request_id AND j.organization_id=:organization_id AND j.brand_id=:brand_id AND j.application_id=:application_id AND j.rights_request_id=:rights_request_id AND j.actor_user_id=:__user_id AND j.expires_at>:__now AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=j.organization_id AND p.brand_id=j.brand_id AND p.user_id=j.actor_user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_rights_events e WHERE e.request_id=j.rights_request_id AND e.organization_id=j.organization_id AND e.brand_id=j.brand_id AND e.application_id=j.application_id AND e.request_type IN ('access','export') AND e.status='processing' AND length(trim(e.proof_reference)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND e.version=(SELECT max(version) FROM hiring_rights_events WHERE request_id=e.request_id)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erasure_requests er WHERE er.organization_id=j.organization_id AND er.brand_id=j.brand_id AND er.candidate_id=j.candidate_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_deletion_requests d WHERE d.organization_id=j.organization_id AND d.brand_id=j.brand_id AND d.candidate_id=j.candidate_id) AND j.state='ready') THEN 'authorized' ELSE 'not_found' END,:__now,:__now+60000 WHERE length(trim(:access_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_privacy_access WHERE id=:access_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE id=:access_id OR operation_id=:access_id)

tools.name: download_candidate_export

tools.sql: SELECT j.payload_json,j.expires_at FROM hiring_export_jobs j WHERE j.id=:request_id AND j.organization_id=:organization_id AND j.brand_id=:brand_id AND j.application_id=:application_id AND j.rights_request_id=:rights_request_id AND j.actor_user_id=:__user_id AND j.expires_at>:__now AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=j.organization_id AND p.brand_id=j.brand_id AND p.user_id=j.actor_user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_rights_events e WHERE e.request_id=j.rights_request_id AND e.organization_id=j.organization_id AND e.brand_id=j.brand_id AND e.application_id=j.application_id AND e.request_type IN ('access','export') AND e.status='processing' AND length(trim(e.proof_reference)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND e.version=(SELECT max(version) FROM hiring_rights_events WHERE request_id=e.request_id)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erasure_requests er WHERE er.organization_id=j.organization_id AND er.brand_id=j.brand_id AND er.candidate_id=j.candidate_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_deletion_requests d WHERE d.organization_id=j.organization_id AND d.brand_id=j.brand_id AND d.candidate_id=j.candidate_id) AND j.state='ready' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_privacy_access x WHERE x.id=:access_id AND x.organization_id=j.organization_id AND x.brand_id=j.brand_id AND x.actor_user_id=:__user_id AND x.action='candidate_export_download' AND x.target_id=j.application_id AND x.context_id=j.id AND x.outcome='authorized' AND x.expires_at>:__now) LIMIT 1
