account','file bytes - available through separately authorized private file retrieval')) FROM (SELECT c.id AS erasure_requests er WHERE er.organization_id=j.organization_id AND er.brand_id=j.brand_id AND er.candidate_id=j.candidate_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_deletion_requests d WHERE tools.name: inspect_operational_jobs
tools.description: Brand-wide owner/auditor content-free keyset inspection. Replay uses existing human reconciliation or hold-aware worker claims; never bulk resend.
tools.sql:
SELECT kind,job_id,state,reason_code,attempts,created_at FROM (
SELECT 'mail' kind,o.id job_id,o.delivery_state state,CASE WHEN o.delivery_reason IN ('quota','unavailable','forbidden','provider_rejected','approval_unavailable','approval_required','scope_mismatch','invalid_payload','reconcile_required') THEN o.delivery_reason ELSE 'unclassified' END reason_code,o.attempt_count attempts,o.created_at FROM hiring_outbox o WHERE o.organization_id=:organization_id AND o.brand_id=:brand_id AND o.delivery_state IN ('failed','unknown','sending') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_mail_reconciliations r WHERE r.original_draft_id=o.id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'retention',s.request_id||'/'||s.store,s.state,s.reason_code,s.attempts,r.created_at FROM hiring_deletion_steps s JOIN hiring_deletion_requests r ON r.id=s.request_id AND r.organization_id=s.organization_id AND r.brand_id=s.brand_id WHERE s.organization_id=:organization_id AND s.brand_id=:brand_id AND s.state IN ('failed','blocked','unknown','running')
) WHERE kind||':'||job_id>COALESCE(:after_key,'') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','auditor') AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) ORDER BY kind||':'||job_id LIMIT 100

tools.name: register_rectification_processor
tools.description: Owner/passkey: register an installed processor before approving corrections. Append-only inventory; MAIL is always required.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO hiring_rectification_processors SELECT :organization_id,:brand_id,:processor_id,:__user_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND length(trim(:processor_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_rectification_processors WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND processor_id=:processor_id)

tools.name: apply_candidate_correction
tools.description: Approve one eligible field on an exact verified processing request. Immutable provenance; shared candidate contact corrections require separate scoped review. MAIL and installed processors are queued atomically.
tools.sql:
INSERT INTO hiring_corrections(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,candidate_id,request_id,rights_version,application_version,field,previous_value,new_value,reason_reference,actor_user_id,created_at)
SELECT :operation_id,a.organization_id,a.brand_id,a.id,c.id,e.request_id,e.version,a.version,:field,CASE :field WHEN 'name' THEN c.name WHEN 'email' THEN c.email WHEN 'phone' THEN c.phone WHEN 'contact_context' THEN a.contact_context END,:new_value,:reason_reference,:__user_id,:__now
FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id AND c.organization_id=a.organization_id AND c.brand_id=a.brand_id JOIN hiring_rights_events e ON e.application_id=a.id AND e.organization_id=a.organization_id AND e.brand_id=a.brand_id
WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND e.request_id=:request_id AND e.request_type='correction' AND e.status='processing' AND length(trim(e.proof_reference))>0 AND e.version=:expected_version AND e.version=(SELECT MAX(version) FROM hiring_rights_events WHERE request_id=e.request_id) AND a.version=:expected_application_version AND c.merged_into IS NULL
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erasure_requests d WHERE d.organization_id=a.organization_id AND d.brand_id=a.brand_id AND d.candidate_id=c.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_deletion_requests d WHERE d.organization_id=a.organization_id AND d.brand_id=a.brand_id AND d.candidate_id=c.id)
AND (:field='contact_context' OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications other WHERE other.candidate_id=c.id AND other.id<>a.id))
AND :field IN ('name','email','phone','contact_context') AND length(:new_value)<=2000 AND (:field IN ('phone','contact_context') OR length(trim(:new_value))>0) AND (:field<>'email' OR (:new_value LIKE '%_@_%._%' AND length(:new_value)<=254 AND instr(:new_value,char(10))=0 AND instr(:new_value,char(13))=0)) AND length(trim(:reason_reference)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_corrections WHERE request_id=:request_id OR id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE id=:operation_id OR operation_id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_corrections prior JOIN hiring_rectification_targets t ON t.correction_id=prior.id WHERE prior.candidate_id=c.id AND prior.field=:field AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_rectification_attempts x WHERE x.correction_id=t.correction_id AND x.processor_id=t.processor_id AND x.state='complete'))

tools.name: list_candidate_rectifications
tools.description: Owner-only correction provenance and per-processor latest outcome. No subject values; pending and partial failures stay visible.
tools.sql: SELECT c.id AS correction_id,c.field,c.reason_reference,c.actor_user_id,c.created_at,c.application_version,t.processor_id,COALESCE(x.state,'pending') AS state,COALESCE(x.version,0) AS version,x.evidence_reference FROM hiring_corrections c JOIN hiring_rectification_targets t ON t.correction_id=c.id LEFT JOIN hiring_rectification_attempts x ON x.correction_id=t.correction_id AND x.processor_id=t.processor_id AND x.version=(SELECT MAX(version) FROM hiring_rectification_attempts v WHERE v.correction_id=t.correction_id AND v.processor_id=t.processor_id) WHERE c.organization_id=:organization_id AND c.brand_id=:brand_id AND c.application_id=:application_id AND c.request_id=:request_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) ORDER BY t.processor_id

tools.name: get_candidate_rectification_payload
tools.description: Owner-only exact processor payload for private rectification adapter; rechecks grants, processing state and erasure. Never use as a public URL.
tools.sql: SELECT c.id AS correction_id,c.organization_id,c.brand_id,c.application_id,c.candidate_id,c.field,c.new_value,t.processor_id FROM hiring_corrections c JOIN hiring_rectification_targets t ON t.correction_id=c.id WHERE c.organization_id=:organization_id AND c.brand_id=:brand_id AND c.application_id=:application_id AND c.request_id=:request_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND t.processor_id=:processor_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erasure_requests d WHERE d.organization_id=c.organization_id AND d.brand_id=c.brand_id AND d.candidate_id=c.candidate_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_deletion_requests d WHERE d.organization_id=c.organization_id AND d.brand_id=c.brand_id AND d.candidate_id=c.candidate_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_rights_events e WHERE e.request_id=c.request_id AND e.version=(SELECT MAX(version) FROM hiring_rights_events WHERE request_id=c.request_id) AND e.status='processing') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_rectification_attempts x WHERE x.correction_id=c.id AND x.processor_id=t.processor_id AND x.state='complete') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_restore_tombstones d WHERE d.organization_id=c.organization_id AND d.brand_id=c.brand_id AND d.candidate_id=c.candidate_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_candidates subject ON subject.id=a.candidate_id AND subject.organization_id=a.organization_id AND subject.brand_id=a.brand_id WHERE a.id=c.application_id AND a.organization_id=c.organization_id AND a.brand_id=c.brand_id AND a.candidate_id=c.candidate_id AND subject.merged_into IS NULL AND CASE c.field WHEN 'name' THEN subject.name WHEN 'email' THEN subject.email WHEN 'phone' THEN subject.phone WHEN 'contact_context' THEN a.contact_context END=c.new_value)

tools.name: record_candidate_rectification
tools.description: Owner/passkey verified processor outcome with opaque evidence. Retry failed/unknown through an idempotent adapter. Complete requires verified provider evidence.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO hiring_rectification_attempts SELECT :operation_id,c.id,t.processor_id,:expected_version+1,:state,:evidence_reference,:__user_id,:__now FROM hiring_corrections c JOIN hiring_rectification_targets t ON t.correction_id=c.id WHERE c.organization_id=:organization_id AND c.brand_id=:brand_id AND c.application_id=:application_id AND c.request_id=:request_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND t.processor_id=:processor_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erasure_requests d WHERE d.organization_id=c.organization_id AND d.brand_id=c.brand_id AND d.candidate_id=c.candidate_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_deletion_requests d WHERE d.organization_id=c.organization_id AND d.brand_id=c.brand_id AND d.candidate_id=c.candidate_id) AND :state IN ('complete','failed','unknown') AND length(trim(:evidence_reference)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND :expected_version=COALESCE((SELECT MAX(version) FROM hiring_rectification_attempts WHERE correction_id=c.id AND processor_id=t.processor_id),0) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_rectification_attempts WHERE correction_id=c.id AND processor_id=t.processor_id AND (state='complete' OR id=:operation_id)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_rights_events e WHERE e.request_id=c.request_id AND e.version=(SELECT MAX(version) FROM hiring_rights_events WHERE request_id=c.request_id) AND e.status='processing') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_restore_tombstones d WHERE d.organization_id=c.organization_id AND d.brand_id=c.brand_id AND d.candidate_id=c.candidate_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_candidates subject ON subject.id=a.candidate_id AND subject.organization_id=a.organization_id AND subject.brand_id=a.brand_id WHERE a.id=c.application_id AND a.organization_id=c.organization_id AND a.brand_id=c.brand_id AND a.candidate_id=c.candidate_id AND subject.merged_into IS NULL AND CASE c.field WHEN 'name' THEN subject.name WHEN 'email' THEN subject.email WHEN 'phone' THEN subject.phone WHEN 'contact_context' THEN a.contact_context END=c.new_value)

tools.name: search_candidates
tools.description: Bounded search within current grants and assignments.
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_search_budget(user_id,window_start,requests) VALUES (:__user_id,CAST(:__now/60000 AS INTEGER),1) ON CONFLICT(user_id) DO UPDATE SET window_start=excluded.window_start,requests=CASE WHEN hiring_search_budget.window_start<>excluded.window_start THEN 1 ELSE min(hiring_search_budget.requests+1,31) END RETURNING CASE WHEN requests<=30 THEN 200 ELSE 429 END AS status,CASE WHEN requests<=30 THEN 0 ELSE 60-CAST((:__now%60000)/1000 AS INTEGER) END AS retry_after,CASE WHEN requests<=30 THEN (SELECT json_group_array(json(json_object('id',id,'full_name',full_name,'email',email,'created_at',created_at,'next_cursor',next_cursor))) FROM (WITH authorized AS (SELECT DISTINCT c.id,c.name AS full_name,NULL AS email,c.created_at,hex(json_array('search_candidates',:__user_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:requisition_id,NULL,c.id)) AS token FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id AND c.organization_id=a.organization_id AND c.brand_id=a.brand_id WHERE a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND (:requisition_id IS NULL OR a.requisition_id=:requisition_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=a.organization_id AND p.brand_id=a.brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id) AND (p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') OR (p.role='reviewer' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM interviews i JOIN interview_assignments ia ON ia.interview_id=i.id AND ia.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND ia.brand_id=i.brand_id AND ia.requisition_id=i.requisition_id AND ia.application_id=i.application_id WHERE i.application_id=a.id AND i.tenant_id=a.organization_id AND i.brand_id=a.brand_id AND i.requisition_id=a.requisition_id AND i.status='scheduled' AND ia.reviewer_id=:__user_id AND ia.revoked_at IS NULL)))) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erasure_requests e WHERE e.candidate_id=c.id AND e.organization_id=c.organization_id AND e.brand_id=c.brand_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_deletion_tombstones d WHERE d.candidate_id=c.id AND d.organization_id=c.organization_id AND d.brand_id=c.brand_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_restore_tombstones d WHERE d.candidate_id=c.id AND d.organization_id=c.organization_id AND d.brand_id=c.brand_id) AND typeof(:q)='text' AND length(:q)<=200 AND instr(:q,char(0))=0 AND c.name LIKE '%' || replace(replace(replace(:q,'\','\\'),'%','\%'),'_','\_') || '%' ESCAPE '\' AND (:limit IS NULL OR (typeof(:limit) IN ('integer','real') AND :limit=CAST(:limit AS INTEGER) AND :limit BETWEEN 1 AND 50)) AND (:cursor IS NULL OR length(:cursor)<=4096)), anchor AS (SELECT created_at,id FROM authorized WHERE token=:cursor), page AS (SELECT * FROM authorized WHERE :cursor IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM anchor x WHERE authorized.created_at<x.created_at OR (authorized.created_at=x.created_at AND authorized.id>x.id)) ORDER BY created_at DESC,id ASC LIMIT CASE WHEN :limit IS NULL THEN 20 WHEN typeof(:limit) IN ('integer','real') AND :limit=CAST(:limit AS INTEGER) AND :limit BETWEEN 1 AND 50 THEN CAST(:limit AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END) SELECT id,full_name,email,created_at,CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM authorized n WHERE n.created_at<page.created_at OR (n.created_at=page.created_at AND n.id>page.id)) THEN token ELSE NULL END AS next_cursor FROM page ORDER BY created_at DESC,id ASC LIMIT 50)) ELSE '[]' END AS rows_json

tools.name: get_search_candidate
tools.description: Fetch one currently authorized search record.
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_search_budget(user_id,window_start,requests) VALUES (:__user_id,CAST(:__now/60000 AS INTEGER),1) ON CONFLICT(user_id) DO UPDATE SET window_start=excluded.window_start,requests=CASE WHEN hiring_search_budget.window_start<>excluded.window_start THEN 1 ELSE min(hiring_search_budget.requests+1,31) END RETURNING CASE WHEN requests<=30 THEN 200 ELSE 429 END AS status,CASE WHEN requests<=30 THEN 0 ELSE 60-CAST((:__now%60000)/1000 AS INTEGER) END AS retry_after,CASE WHEN requests<=30 THEN (SELECT json_group_array(json(json_object('id',id,'full_name',full_name,'email',email,'created_at',created_at))) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT c.id,c.name AS full_name,NULL AS email,c.created_at FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id AND c.organization_id=a.organization_id AND c.brand_id=a.brand_id WHERE a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND (:requisition_id IS NULL OR a.requisition_id=:requisition_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=a.organization_id AND p.brand_id=a.brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id) AND (p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') OR (p.role='reviewer' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM interviews i JOIN interview_assignments ia ON ia.interview_id=i.id AND ia.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND ia.brand_id=i.brand_id AND ia.requisition_id=i.requisition_id AND ia.application_id=i.application_id WHERE i.application_id=a.id AND i.tenant_id=a.organization_id AND i.brand_id=a.brand_id AND i.requisition_id=a.requisition_id AND i.status='scheduled' AND ia.reviewer_id=:__user_id AND ia.revoked_at IS NULL)))) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erasure_requests e WHERE e.candidate_id=c.id AND e.organization_id=c.organization_id AND e.brand_id=c.brand_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_deletion_tombstones d WHERE d.candidate_id=c.id AND d.organization_id=c.organization_id AND d.brand_id=c.brand_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_restore_tombstones d WHERE d.candidate_id=c.id AND d.organization_id=c.organization_id AND d.brand_id=c.brand_id) AND c.id=:id LIMIT 1)) ELSE '[]' END AS rows_json

statements: INSERT INTO hiring_search_budget(user_id,window_start,requests) VALUES (:__user_id,CAST(:__now/60000 AS INTEGER),1) ON CONFLICT(user_id) DO UPDATE SET window_start=excluded.window_start,requests=CASE WHEN hiring_search_budget.window_start<>excluded.window_start THEN 1 ELSE min(hiring_search_budget.requests+1,31) END RETURNING CASE WHEN requests<=30 THEN 200 ELSE 429 END AS status,CASE WHEN requests<=30 THEN 0 ELSE 60-CAST((:__now%60000)/1000 AS INTEGER) END AS retry_after,CASE WHEN requests<=30 THEN (SELECT json_group_array(json(json_object('id',id,'candidate_id',candidate_id,'requisition_id',requisition_id,'stage',stage,'created_at',created_at,'next_cursor',next_cursor))) FROM (WITH authorized AS (SELECT DISTINCT a.id,a.candidate_id,a.requisition_id,COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage) AS stage,a.created_at,hex(json_array('search_applications',:__user_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:requisition_id,:stage,a.id)) AS token FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id AND c.organization_id=a.organization_id AND c.brand_id=a.brand_id WHERE a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND (:requisition_id IS NULL OR a.requisition_id=:requisition_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=a.organization_id AND p.brand_id=a.brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id) AND (p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') OR (p.role='reviewer' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM interviews i JOIN interview_assignments ia ON ia.interview_id=i.id AND ia.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND ia.brand_id=i.brand_id AND ia.requisition_id=i.requisition_id AND ia.application_id=i.application_id WHERE i.application_id=a.id AND i.tenant_id=a.organization_id AND i.brand_id=a.brand_id AND i.requisition_id=a.requisition_id AND i.status='scheduled' AND ia.reviewer_id=:__user_id AND ia.revoked_at IS NULL)))) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erasure_requests e WHERE e.candidate_id=c.id AND e.organization_id=c.organization_id AND e.brand_id=c.brand_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_deletion_tombstones d WHERE d.candidate_id=c.id AND d.organization_id=c.organization_id AND d.brand_id=c.brand_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_restore_tombstones d WHERE d.candidate_id=c.id AND d.organization_id=c.organization_id AND d.brand_id=c.brand_id) AND (:stage IS NULL OR COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage)=:stage) AND typeof(:q)='text' AND length(:q)<=200 AND instr(:q,char(0))=0 AND c.name LIKE '%' || replace(replace(replace(:q,'\','\\'),'%','\%'),'_','\_') || '%' ESCAPE '\' AND (:limit IS NULL OR (typeof(:limit) IN ('integer','real') AND :limit=CAST(:limit AS INTEGER) AND :limit BETWEEN 1 AND 50)) AND (:cursor IS NULL OR length(:cursor)<=4096)), anchor AS (SELECT created_at,id FROM authorized WHERE token=:cursor), page AS (SELECT * FROM authorized WHERE :cursor IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM anchor x WHERE authorized.created_at<x.created_at OR (authorized.created_at=x.created_at AND authorized.id>x.id)) ORDER BY created_at DESC,id ASC LIMIT CASE WHEN :limit IS NULL THEN 20 WHEN typeof(:limit) IN ('integer','real') AND :limit=CAST(:limit AS INTEGER) AND :limit BETWEEN 1 AND 50 THEN CAST(:limit AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END) SELECT id,candidate_id,requisition_id,stage,created_at,CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM authorized n WHERE n.created_at<page.created_at OR (n.created_at=page.created_at AND n.id>page.id)) THEN token ELSE NULL END AS next_cursor FROM page ORDER BY created_at DESC,id ASC LIMIT 50)) ELSE '[]' END AS rows_json

tools.name: configure_application_receipt
tools.description: Owner enables automatic transactional receipts using this exact approved brand template version. Review text for brand identity and no staff/personal data. Does not authorize marketing.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO hiring_receipt_templates(organization_id,brand_id,template_id,template_version,configured_by,configured_at) SELECT t.organization_id,t.brand_id,t.id,t.version,:__user_id,:__now FROM hiring_communication_templates t JOIN hiring_template_approvals ap ON ap.template_id=t.id AND ap.version=t.version JOIN hiring_brands b ON b.id=t.brand_id AND b.organization_id=t.organization_id WHERE t.id=:template_id AND t.organization_id=:organization_id AND t.brand_id=:brand_id AND t.version=:expected_version AND ap.organization_id=t.organization_id AND ap.brand_id=t.brand_id AND ap.subject=t.subject AND ap.body=t.body AND instr(t.subject,b.name)>0 AND instr(t.body,b.name)>0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) ON CONFLICT(organization_id,brand_id) DO UPDATE SET template_id=excluded.template_id,template_version=excluded.template_version,configured_by=excluded.configured_by,configured_at=excluded.configured_at

tools.name: list_talent_pool
tools.description: Current separately consented brand talent pool; expired or erased participation is excluded.
tools.sql: SELECT c.id,c.name,c.email,MAX(t.expires_at) AS expires_at FROM hiring_talent_pool_terms t JOIN hiring_consent_records cr ON cr.id=t.consent_id JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=cr.application_id AND a.organization_id=cr.organization_id AND a.brand_id=cr.brand_id JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id AND c.organization_id=a.organization_id AND c.brand_id=a.brand_id WHERE a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND cr.purpose='talent_pool' AND cr.legal_basis='consent' AND cr.withdrawn_at IS NULL AND t.expires_at>:__now AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM erasure_requests e WHERE e.candidate_id=c.id AND e.organization_id=c.organization_id AND e.brand_id=c.brand_id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_deletion_tombstones e WHERE e.candidate_id=c.id AND e.organization_id=c.organization_id AND e.brand_id=c.brand_id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_restore_tombstones e WHERE e.candidate_id=c.id AND e.organization_id=c.organization_id AND e.brand_id=c.brand_id) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_organizations o WHERE o.id=a.organization_id AND o.status='active') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=a.organization_id AND p.brand_id=a.brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND c.id>COALESCE(:after_id,'') GROUP BY c.id,c.name,c.email ORDER BY c.id LIMIT 50

tools.name: get_my_talent_pool
tools.description: Current separately consented brand talent pool; expired or erased participation is excluded.
tools.sql: SELECT cr.id AS consent_id,t.expires_at FROM hiring_talent_pool_terms t JOIN hiring_consent_records cr ON cr.id=t.consent_id JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=cr.application_id AND a.organization_id=cr.organization_id AND a.brand_id=cr.brand_id JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id AND c.organization_id=a.organization_id AND c.brand_id=a.brand_id WHERE a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND cr.purpose='talent_pool' AND cr.legal_basis='consent' AND cr.withdrawn_at IS NULL AND t.expires_at>:__now AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM erasure_requests e WHERE e.candidate_id=c.id AND e.organization_id=c.organization_id AND e.brand_id=c.brand_id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_deletion_tombstones e WHERE e.candidate_id=c.id AND e.organization_id=c.organization_id AND e.brand_id=c.brand_id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_restore_tombstones e WHERE e.candidate_id=c.id AND e.organization_id=c.organization_id AND e.brand_id=c.brand_id) AND a.id=:application_id AND c.worker_user_id=:__user_id ORDER BY cr.id LIMIT 50

tools.name: withdraw_my_talent_pool
tools.description: Withdraw all future-contact talent-pool consent for your candidate in this brand. Application processing and communications consent are separate.
statements: UPDATE hiring_consent_records SET withdrawn_at=:__now WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND purpose='talent_pool' AND withdrawn_at IS NULL AND application_id IN (SELECT a.id FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id AND c.organization_id=a.organization_id AND c.brand_id=a.brand_id WHERE a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND c.worker_user_id=:__user_id AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications selected JOIN hiring_candidates own ON own.id=selected.candidate_id AND own.organization_id=selected.organization_id AND own.brand_id=selected.brand_id WHERE selected.id=:application_id AND selected.organization_id=:organization_id AND selected.brand_id=:brand_id AND own.worker_user_id=:__user_id)) AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id)

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'privacy.talent_pool.withdrawn',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE changes()>0

tools.name: get_funnel_analytics
tools.description: Fixed lifetime brand conversion counts. All counts suppressed when any observed milestone-pattern cohort has fewer than five distinct candidate records. No candidate data or filters.
tools.sql: WITH permitted AS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p JOIN hiring_organizations o ON o.id=p.organization_id AND o.status='active' WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter','auditor') AND p.requisition_id IS NULL), cohort AS (SELECT a.candidate_id,CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage) IN ('in_review','shortlisted','interviewing','decision_pending','offered','accepted','hired') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events e WHERE e.application_id=a.id AND e.organization_id=a.organization_id AND e.brand_id=a.brand_id AND e.to_stage IN ('in_review','shortlisted','interviewing','decision_pending','offered','accepted','hired')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS reviewed,CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage) IN ('interviewing','decision_pending') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events e WHERE e.application_id=a.id AND e.organization_id=a.organization_id AND e.brand_id=a.brand_id AND e.to_stage IN ('interviewing','decision_pending')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS interviewed,CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage) IN ('offered','accepted','hired') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events e WHERE e.application_id=a.id AND e.organization_id=a.organization_id AND e.brand_id=a.brand_id AND e.to_stage IN ('offered','accepted','hired')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS offered,CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage) IN ('hired') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events e WHERE e.application_id=a.id AND e.organization_id=a.organization_id AND e.brand_id=a.brand_id AND e.to_stage IN ('hired')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS hired FROM hiring_applications a WHERE a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM permitted)), cells AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT candidate_id) AS n FROM cohort GROUP BY reviewed,interviewed,offered,hired), privacy AS (SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cells WHERE n<5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS suppressed), counts AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS received,COALESCE(SUM(reviewed),0) AS reviewed,COALESCE(SUM(interviewed),0) AS interviewed,COALESCE(SUM(offered),0) AS offered,COALESCE(SUM(hired),0) AS hired FROM cohort) SELECT 'received' AS milestone,CASE WHEN privacy.suppressed=1 THEN NULL ELSE counts.received END AS count,privacy.suppressed FROM counts CROSS JOIN privacy WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM permitted) UNION ALL SELECT 'reviewed' AS milestone,CASE WHEN privacy.suppressed=1 THEN NULL ELSE counts.reviewed END AS count,privacy.suppressed FROM counts CROSS JOIN privacy WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM permitted) UNION ALL SELECT 'interviewed' AS milestone,CASE WHEN privacy.suppressed=1 THEN NULL ELSE counts.interviewed END AS count,privacy.suppressed FROM counts CROSS JOIN privacy WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM permitted) UNION ALL SELECT 'offered' AS milestone,CASE WHEN privacy.suppressed=1 THEN NULL ELSE counts.offered END AS count,privacy.suppressed FROM counts CROSS JOIN privacy WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM permitted) UNION ALL SELECT 'hired' AS milestone,CASE WHEN privacy.suppressed=1 THEN NULL ELSE counts.hired END AS count,privacy.suppressed FROM counts CROSS JOIN privacy WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM permitted)

tools.name: dry_run_requisition_import
tools.description: Validate v1 JSON without writes. Fixed row-index/error codes; forbidden is explicit. Commit always revalidates.
tools.sql: SELECT row_index,code FROM (SELECT -1 row_index,'invalid_document' code WHERE json_type(CASE WHEN json_valid(:rows_json) THEN :rows_json ELSE 'null' END) IS NOT 'array' OR json_array_length(CASE WHEN json_valid(:rows_json) THEN :rows_json ELSE 'null' END) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100 OR length(:rows_json)>50000 UNION ALL SELECT CAST(r.key AS INTEGER) row_index,'invalid_row' code FROM json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(:rows_json) THEN :rows_json ELSE 'null' END) r WHERE r.type<>'object' OR CASE WHEN r.type='object' THEN (json_type(r.value,'$.source_id') IS NOT 'text' OR (length(trim(json_extract(r.value,'$.source_id'))) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 128 OR length(json_extract(r.value,'$.source_id'))>128) OR json_type(r.value,'$.title') IS NOT 'text' OR (length(trim(json_extract(r.value,'$.title'))) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 200 OR length(json_extract(r.value,'$.title'))>200) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(r.value) k WHERE k.key NOT IN ('source_id','title')) OR (SELECT count(*) FROM json_each(r.value))<>2) ELSE 1 END UNION ALL SELECT -1 row_index,'duplicate_source' code FROM json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(:rows_json) THEN :rows_json ELSE 'null' END) r GROUP BY json_extract(CASE WHEN r.type='object' THEN r.value ELSE '{}' END,'$.source_id') HAVING count(*)>1) WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_integration_approvals ap WHERE ap.organization_id=:organization_id AND ap.brand_id=:brand_id AND ap.installation_id=:installation_id AND ap.capability='import' AND ap.source_reference=:source_reference AND ap.basis_reference=:basis_reference AND ap.contract_version='requisition-import-v1' AND ap.revoked_at IS NULL AND ap.expires_at>:__now) UNION ALL SELECT -1,'forbidden' WHERE NOT (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_integration_approvals ap WHERE ap.organization_id=:organization_id AND ap.brand_id=:brand_id AND ap.installation_id=:installation_id AND ap.capability='import' AND ap.source_reference=:source_reference AND ap.basis_reference=:basis_reference AND ap.contract_version='requisition-import-v1' AND ap.revoked_at IS NULL AND ap.expires_at>:__now))

tools.name: commit_requisition_import
tools.description: Governed requisition-import-v1; zero changes is denial or conflict. Approval is provisioned only by trusted operations.
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_import_batches(id,organization_id,brand_id,installation_id,source_reference,basis_reference,actor_user_id,state,row_count,created_at) SELECT :batch_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:installation_id,:source_reference,:basis_reference,:__user_id,'committed',json_array_length(CASE WHEN json_valid(:rows_json) THEN :rows_json ELSE 'null' END),:__now WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_integration_approvals ap WHERE ap.organization_id=:organization_id AND ap.brand_id=:brand_id AND ap.installation_id=:installation_id AND ap.capability='import' AND ap.source_reference=:source_reference AND ap.basis_reference=:basis_reference AND ap.contract_version='requisition-import-v1' AND ap.revoked_at IS NULL AND ap.expires_at>:__now) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT -1 row_index,'invalid_document' code WHERE json_type(CASE WHEN json_valid(:rows_json) THEN :rows_json ELSE 'null' END) IS NOT 'array' OR json_array_length(CASE WHEN json_valid(:rows_json) THEN :rows_json ELSE 'null' END) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100 OR length(:rows_json)>50000 UNION ALL SELECT CAST(r.key AS INTEGER) row_index,'invalid_row' code FROM json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(:rows_json) THEN :rows_json ELSE 'null' END) r WHERE r.type<>'object' OR CASE WHEN r.type='object' THEN (json_type(r.value,'$.source_id') IS NOT 'text' OR (length(trim(json_extract(r.value,'$.source_id'))) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 128 OR length(json_extract(r.value,'$.source_id'))>128) OR json_type(r.value,'$.title') IS NOT 'text' OR (length(trim(json_extract(r.value,'$.title'))) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 200 OR length(json_extract(r.value,'$.title'))>200) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(r.value) k WHERE k.key NOT IN ('source_id','title')) OR (SELECT count(*) FROM json_each(r.value))<>2) ELSE 1 END UNION ALL SELECT -1 row_index,'duplicate_source' code FROM json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(:rows_json) THEN :rows_json ELSE 'null' END) r GROUP BY json_extract(CASE WHEN r.type='object' THEN r.value ELSE '{}' END,'$.source_id') HAVING count(*)>1) AND length(trim(:batch_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND length(trim(:source_reference)) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND length(trim(:basis_reference)) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_import_batches WHERE id=:batch_id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_import_batches WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND installation_id=:installation_id AND source_reference=:source_reference)

INSERT INTO hiring_import_rows(batch_id,source_id,requisition_id,title) SELECT :batch_id,json_extract(value,'$.source_id'),'import-'||:batch_id||'-'||key,trim(json_extract(value,'$.title')) FROM json_each(CASE WHEN json_valid(:rows_json) THEN :rows_json ELSE 'null' END) WHERE changes()=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_import_batches b WHERE b.organization_id=:organization_id AND b.brand_id=:brand_id AND b.installation_id=:installation_id AND b.id=:batch_id AND b.actor_user_id=:__user_id AND b.state='committed') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_import_rows WHERE batch_id=:batch_id)

INSERT INTO hiring_requisitions(id,organization_id,brand_id,title,created_at,operation_id) SELECT requisition_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,title,:__now,'import-'||:batch_id FROM hiring_import_rows WHERE batch_id=:batch_id AND changes()>0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_import_batches b WHERE b.organization_id=:organization_id AND b.brand_id=:brand_id AND b.installation_id=:installation_id AND b.id=:batch_id AND b.actor_user_id=:__user_id AND b.state='committed')

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_webhook_deliveries(id,subscription_id,batch_id,event_type,next_at) SELECT s.id||'|'||:batch_id||'|import.committed',s.id,:batch_id,'import.committed',:__now FROM hiring_webhook_subscriptions s WHERE s.organization_id=:organization_id AND s.brand_id=:brand_id AND s.installation_id=:installation_id AND s.revoked_at IS NULL AND changes()>0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL)

tools.name: rollback_requisition_import
tools.description: Governed requisition-import-v1; zero changes is denial or conflict. Approval is provisioned only by trusted operations.
statements: UPDATE hiring_import_batches SET state='rolled_back',rolled_back_at=:__now WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND installation_id=:installation_id AND id=:batch_id AND actor_user_id=:__user_id AND state='committed' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_integration_approvals ap WHERE ap.organization_id=:organization_id AND ap.brand_id=:brand_id AND ap.installation_id=:installation_id AND ap.capability='import' AND ap.source_reference=hiring_import_batches.source_reference AND ap.basis_reference=hiring_import_batches.basis_reference AND ap.contract_version='requisition-import-v1' AND ap.revoked_at IS NULL AND ap.expires_at>:__now) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_import_rows r LEFT JOIN hiring_requisitions q ON q.id=r.requisition_id WHERE r.batch_id=:batch_id AND (q.id IS NULL OR NOT (q.title=r.title AND q.operation_id IS NOT NULL AND q.operation_id='import-'||:batch_id AND q.location IS NULL AND q.employment_type IS NULL AND q.compensation_type IS NULL AND q.description_version IS NULL AND q.owner_user_id IS NULL) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications a WHERE a.requisition_id=q.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_job_publications p WHERE p.requisition_id=q.id)))

DELETE FROM hiring_requisitions WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND id IN (SELECT requisition_id FROM hiring_import_rows WHERE batch_id=:batch_id) AND changes()=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL)

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_webhook_deliveries(id,subscription_id,batch_id,event_type,next_at) SELECT s.id||'|'||:batch_id||'|import.rolled_back',s.id,:batch_id,'import.rolled_back',:__now FROM hiring_webhook_subscriptions s WHERE s.organization_id=:organization_id AND s.brand_id=:brand_id AND s.installation_id=:installation_id AND s.revoked_at IS NULL AND changes()>0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL)

tools.name: subscribe_import_webhooks
tools.description: Governed requisition-import-v1; zero changes is denial or conflict. Approval is provisioned only by trusted operations.
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_webhook_subscriptions(id,organization_id,brand_id,installation_id,approval_id,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT :subscription_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:installation_id,ap.id,:__user_id,:__now FROM hiring_integration_approvals ap WHERE ap.id=:approval_id AND ap.organization_id=:organization_id AND ap.brand_id=:brand_id AND ap.installation_id=:installation_id AND ap.capability='outbound_webhooks' AND ap.contract_version='requisition-import-v1' AND ap.revoked_at IS NULL AND ap.expires_at>:__now AND ap.endpoint LIKE 'https://%' AND length(ap.secret_ref)>0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_webhook_subscriptions WHERE id=:subscription_id)

tools.name: revoke_import_webhooks
tools.description: Governed requisition-import-v1; zero changes is denial or conflict. Approval is provisioned only by trusted operations.
statements: UPDATE hiring_webhook_subscriptions SET revoked_at=:__now,revoked_by=:__user_id WHERE id=:subscription_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND installation_id=:installation_id AND revoked_at IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL)

tools.name: claim_import_webhook
tools.description: Governed requisition-import-v1; zero changes is denial or conflict. Approval is provisioned only by trusted operations.
statements: UPDATE hiring_webhook_deliveries AS d SET state='sending',attempts=attempts+1,claim_id=:claim_id,claimed_at=:__now WHERE d.id=:delivery_id AND attempts<5 AND ((state='pending' AND next_at<=:__now) OR (state='sending' AND claimed_at<:__now-300000)) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_webhook_subscriptions s JOIN hiring_integration_approvals ap ON ap.id=s.approval_id WHERE s.id=d.subscription_id AND s.organization_id=:organization_id AND s.brand_id=:brand_id AND s.installation_id=:installation_id AND s.revoked_at IS NULL AND ap.organization_id=s.organization_id AND ap.brand_id=s.brand_id AND ap.installation_id=s.installation_id AND ap.capability='outbound_webhooks' AND ap.contract_version='requisition-import-v1' AND ap.revoked_at IS NULL AND ap.expires_at>:__now AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=s.organization_id AND p.brand_id=s.brand_id AND p.user_id=s.actor_user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL)) AND :__user_id='system'||char(58)||'worker'

tools.name: read_import_webhook
tools.description: Governed requisition-import-v1; zero changes is denial or conflict. Approval is provisioned only by trusted operations.
tools.sql: SELECT d.id,d.event_type,d.attempts,b.row_count,s.installation_id,s.organization_id,s.brand_id,ap.endpoint,ap.secret_ref FROM hiring_webhook_deliveries d JOIN hiring_import_batches b ON b.id=d.batch_id JOIN hiring_webhook_subscriptions s ON s.id=d.subscription_id JOIN hiring_integration_approvals ap ON ap.id=s.approval_id WHERE d.id=:delivery_id AND d.claim_id=:claim_id AND d.state='sending' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_webhook_subscriptions s JOIN hiring_integration_approvals ap ON ap.id=s.approval_id WHERE s.id=d.subscription_id AND s.organization_id=:organization_id AND s.brand_id=:brand_id AND s.installation_id=:installation_id AND s.revoked_at IS NULL AND ap.organization_id=s.organization_id AND ap.brand_id=s.brand_id AND ap.installation_id=s.installation_id AND ap.capability='outbound_webhooks' AND ap.contract_version='requisition-import-v1' AND ap.revoked_at IS NULL AND ap.expires_at>:__now AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=s.organization_id AND p.brand_id=s.brand_id AND p.user_id=s.actor_user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL)) AND :__user_id='system'||char(58)||'worker'

tools.name: finish_import_webhook
tools.description: Governed requisition-import-v1; zero changes is denial or conflict. Approval is provisioned only by trusted operations.
statements: UPDATE hiring_webhook_deliveries AS d SET state=CASE WHEN :success=1 THEN 'sent' WHEN attempts>=5 THEN 'dead' ELSE 'pending' END,next_at=:__now+60000*(1 << attempts) WHERE d.id=:delivery_id AND d.claim_id=:claim_id AND state='sending' AND :success IN (0,1) AND :__user_id='system'||char(58)||'worker' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_webhook_subscriptions s WHERE s.id=d.subscription_id AND s.organization_id=:organization_id AND s.brand_id=:brand_id AND s.installation_id=:installation_id)

tools.name: get_requisition_import
tools.description: Owner-only bounded operational state, without source contents or secrets.
tools.sql: SELECT id,state,row_count,created_at,rolled_back_at FROM hiring_import_batches WHERE id=:batch_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND installation_id=:installation_id AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL)

tools.name: list_import_webhook_deliveries
tools.description: Owner-only bounded operational state, without source contents or secrets.
tools.sql: SELECT d.id,d.event_type,d.state,d.attempts,d.next_at FROM hiring_webhook_deliveries d JOIN hiring_webhook_subscriptions s ON s.id=d.subscription_id WHERE s.organization_id=:organization_id AND s.brand_id=:brand_id AND s.installation_id=:installation_id AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) ORDER BY d.next_at,d.id LIMIT 100

tools.name: list_import_webhook_queue
tools.description: Worker-only exact-scope bounded queue; current outbound approval and owner grants required.
tools.sql: SELECT d.id FROM hiring_webhook_deliveries d WHERE d.attempts<5 AND ((d.state='pending' AND d.next_at<=:__now) OR (d.state='sending' AND d.claimed_at<:__now-300000)) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_webhook_subscriptions s JOIN hiring_integration_approvals ap ON ap.id=s.approval_id WHERE s.id=d.subscription_id AND s.organization_id=:organization_id AND s.brand_id=:brand_id AND s.installation_id=:installation_id AND s.revoked_at IS NULL AND ap.organization_id=s.organization_id AND ap.brand_id=s.brand_id AND ap.installation_id=s.installation_id AND ap.capability='outbound_webhooks' AND ap.contract_version='requisition-import-v1' AND ap.revoked_at IS NULL AND ap.expires_at>:__now AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=s.organization_id AND p.brand_id=s.brand_id AND p.user_id=s.actor_user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL)) AND :__user_id='system'||char(58)||'worker' ORDER BY d.next_at,d.id LIMIT 25

tools.name: get_current_pipeline
tools.description: Current application counts by effective stage, restricted to current grants and reviewer assignments; no candidate content or list limit.
tools.sql: SELECT COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage) AS stage,COUNT(*) AS count FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id AND c.organization_id=a.organization_id AND c.brand_id=a.brand_id JOIN hiring_requisitions r ON r.id=a.requisition_id AND r.organization_id=a.organization_id AND r.brand_id=a.brand_id WHERE a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter' ,'reviewer') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id) AND (p.role<>'reviewer' OR a.assignee_user_id=:__user_id)) GROUP BY COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage)

tools.name: configure_internship_requisition
tools.description: Owner configures restricted internship intake and an approved direct Interns invitation template. Use relink_internship_requisition_template to move to a newer approved version. Does not send email.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO hiring_internship_requisitions(requisition_id,organization_id,brand_id,onboarding_url,template_id,template_version,configured_by,configured_at) SELECT :requisition_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:onboarding_url,:template_id,:template_version,:__user_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=:requisition_id)) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_requisitions WHERE id=:requisition_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AND (:onboarding_url='https://interns.proappstore.online' OR :onboarding_url LIKE 'https://interns.proappstore.online/%') AND :onboarding_url NOT GLOB '*['||char(10)||char(13)||' <>" ]*' AND length(:onboarding_url)<=2000 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_template_approvals WHERE template_id=:template_id AND version=:template_version AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND instr(body,:onboarding_url)>0)

tools.name: configure_internship_campaign
tools.description: Owner registers an exact LinkedIn ad campaign and its evidence; enabled=0 revokes new intake.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO hiring_internship_campaigns(id,requisition_id,organization_id,brand_id,source_url,evidence,enabled,configured_by,configured_at) SELECT :campaign_id,:requisition_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:source_url,:evidence,:enabled,:__user_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=:requisition_id)) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_internship_requisitions WHERE requisition_id=:requisition_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AND :source_url LIKE 'https://www.linkedin.com/campaignmanager/%' AND length(trim(:evidence)) BETWEEN 1 AND 10000 AND length(trim(:campaign_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND :enabled IN (0,1) ON CONFLICT(id,requisition_id) DO UPDATE SET enabled=excluded.enabled,configured_by=excluded.configured_by,configured_at=excluded.configured_at

tools.name: get_internship_policy
tools.description: Read configured restricted intake for this requisition; recruiter scoped.
tools.sql: SELECT ir.requisition_id,ir.organization_id,ir.brand_id,ir.onboarding_url,ir.template_id,COALESCE((SELECT r.new_version FROM hiring_internship_template_relinks r WHERE r.requisition_id=ir.requisition_id ORDER BY r.rowid DESC LIMIT 1),ir.template_version) AS template_version,ir.configured_by,ir.configured_at FROM hiring_internship_requisitions ir WHERE ir.requisition_id=:requisition_id AND ir.organization_id=:organization_id AND ir.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=:requisition_id))

tools.name: list_internship_campaigns
tools.description: List exact campaign allowlist for staff; never public.
tools.sql: SELECT c.* FROM hiring_internship_campaigns c WHERE c.requisition_id=:requisition_id AND c.organization_id=:organization_id AND c.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=:requisition_id))

tools.name: record_internship_progress
tools.description: Record attributed internship onboarding evidence with optimistic ordering. No email send or interview.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO hiring_internship_progress(operation_id,organization_id,brand_id,requisition_id,application_id,status,reason_code,evidence,discord_status,discord_username,actor_user_id,created_at,version) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:requisition_id,:application_id,:status,:reason_code,:evidence,:discord_status,:discord_username,:__user_id,:__now,:expected_version+1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=:requisition_id)) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_internship_requisitions ir ON ir.requisition_id=a.requisition_id WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND a.requisition_id=:requisition_id) AND :expected_version=coalesce((SELECT max(version) FROM hiring_internship_progress WHERE application_id=:application_id),0) AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND :expected_version=CAST(:expected_version AS INTEGER) AND :expected_version>=0

tools.name: list_internship_progress
tools.description: Scoped historical internship onboarding evidence; no public candidate data.
tools.sql: SELECT x.* FROM hiring_internship_progress x WHERE x.application_id=:application_id AND x.organization_id=:organization_id AND x.brand_id=:brand_id AND x.requisition_id=:requisition_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=:requisition_id)) ORDER BY version DESC

tools.name: create_working_interview_invitation
tools.description: Record an already sent working-interview invitation with current playbook version and private join confirmation. Owners (managers) and scoped recruiters only; does not send mail.
statements:
INSERT INTO working_interview_records(id,version,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,invitation,owner_user_id,playbook_version,invited_at,created_at,actor_user_id,operation_id)
 SELECT :record_id,1,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,:invitation,:owner_user_id,:playbook_version,:__now,:__now,:__user_id,:operation_id FROM hiring_applications a
 WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=a.organization_id AND p.brand_id=a.brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:record_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND length(trim(:invitation)) BETWEEN 1 AND 20000 AND :secure_join_confirmed=1
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM working_interview_records WHERE id=:record_id)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_restricted_internships WHERE requisition_id=a.requisition_id)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=a.organization_id AND p.brand_id=a.brand_id AND p.user_id=:owner_user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id))
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_org_playbooks b WHERE b.organization_id=a.organization_id AND b.version=:playbook_version AND b.version=(SELECT MAX(version) FROM hiring_org_playbooks WHERE organization_id=a.organization_id) AND json_extract(b.payload,'$.meeting.time') GLOB '[0-2][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]' AND substr(json_extract(b.payload,'$.meeting.time'),1,2)<='23' AND length(trim(json_extract(b.payload,'$.meeting.timezone')))>0)

tools.name: record_working_interview_outcome
tools.description: Append an audited outcome revision with optimistic concurrency. Only the invitation owner with active recruiter access, or an active owner (manager), may record.
statements:
INSERT INTO working_interview_records(id,version,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,invitation,owner_user_id,playbook_version,outcome,exceptions,invited_at,completed_at,created_at,actor_user_id,operation_id)
 SELECT w.id,:expected_version+1,w.organization_id,w.brand_id,w.application_id,w.invitation,w.owner_user_id,w.playbook_version,:outcome,:exceptions,w.invited_at,:__now,:__now,:__user_id,:operation_id FROM working_interview_records w JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=w.application_id AND a.organization_id=w.organization_id AND a.brand_id=w.brand_id
 WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=a.organization_id AND p.brand_id=a.brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) AND w.id=:record_id AND w.version=:expected_version AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id)
 AND (w.owner_user_id=:__user_id OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=a.organization_id AND p.brand_id=a.brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)))
 AND typeof(:expected_version) IN ('integer','real') AND :expected_version=CAST(:expected_version AS INTEGER) AND :expected_version>=1 AND length(trim(:outcome)) BETWEEN 1 AND 10000 AND length(:exceptions)<=10000

tools.name: get_working_interview_records
tools.description: Latest durable working-interview records. Owners/managers and scoped recruiters only; all other roles receive no rows. No meeting configuration or secret references are returned.
tools.sql: SELECT w.id,w.version,w.invitation,w.owner_user_id,w.playbook_version,w.outcome,w.exceptions,w.invited_at,w.completed_at,w.created_at,w.actor_user_id FROM working_interview_records w JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=w.application_id AND a.organization_id=w.organization_id AND a.brand_id=w.brand_id WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=a.organization_id AND p.brand_id=a.brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) AND w.version=(SELECT MAX(v.version) FROM working_interview_records v WHERE v.id=w.id) ORDER BY w.invited_at DESC,w.id LIMIT 100

tools.name: save_vacancy_terms
tools.description: Explicitly review structured vacancy terms; appends an audited version, invalidates publication review. Published legacy vacancies may be backfilled once. Never infers terms from title.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO hiring_vacancy_terms(requisition_id,version,organization_id,brand_id,engagement_basis,programme_kind,compensation_type,compensation_amount,compensation_currency,weekly_hours_min,weekly_hours_max,programme_weeks,weeks_basis,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT r.id,:expected_version+1,r.organization_id,r.brand_id,:engagement_basis,:programme_kind,:compensation_type,:compensation_amount,:compensation_currency,:weekly_hours_min,:weekly_hours_max,:programme_weeks,:weeks_basis,:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now FROM hiring_requisitions r WHERE r.id=:requisition_id AND r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=r.organization_id AND p.brand_id=r.brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=r.id)) AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND :expected_version=coalesce((SELECT max(version) FROM hiring_vacancy_terms WHERE requisition_id=r.id),0) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_job_publications WHERE requisition_id=r.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access pub WHERE pub.organization_id=r.organization_id AND pub.brand_id=r.brand_id AND pub.user_id=:__user_id AND pub.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND pub.requisition_id IS NULL))

tools.name: create_vacancy_with_terms
tools.description: Atomically create a vacancy with explicitly reviewed engagement, compensation and programme terms. Invalid terms roll back creation.
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_requisitions(id,organization_id,brand_id,title,created_at,operation_id) SELECT :requisition_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:title,:__now,:operation_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=NULL) AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND length(trim(:title))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,NULL,'requisition.created',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=NULL) AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_requisitions WHERE id=:requisition_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND operation_id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1

INSERT INTO hiring_vacancy_terms(requisition_id,version,organization_id,brand_id,engagement_basis,programme_kind,compensation_type,compensation_amount,compensation_currency,weekly_hours_min,weekly_hours_max,programme_weeks,weeks_basis,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT r.id,1,r.organization_id,r.brand_id,:engagement_basis,:programme_kind,:compensation_type,:compensation_amount,:compensation_currency,:weekly_hours_min,:weekly_hours_max,:programme_weeks,:weeks_basis,:__user_id,:operation_id||'-terms',:__now FROM hiring_requisitions r WHERE r.id=:requisition_id AND r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=r.organization_id AND p.brand_id=r.brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=r.id)) AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND r.operation_id=:operation_id AND changes()=1

tools.name: record_lifecycle_transition
tools.description: Record accepted → onboarding → onboarded → active, or rejected/withdrawn before activation. Completion requires registration, requirements and handoff evidence. Exact retry uses get_lifecycle_result.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO hiring_lifecycle_events_v2 (organization_id,brand_id,requisition_id,application_id,operation_id,expected_version,from_stage,to_stage,evidence,registration_evidence,requirements_evidence,handoff_evidence,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT :organization_id,:brand_id,:requisition_id,:application_id,:operation_id,:expected_version,:from_stage,:to_stage,:evidence,:registration_evidence,:requirements_evidence,:handoff_evidence,:__user_id,:__now WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_lifecycle_events_v2 WHERE operation_id=:operation_id)

tools.name: get_lifecycle_result
tools.description: Confirm an exact scoped lifecycle operation, including actor, evidence and original version, even after later transitions.
tools.sql: SELECT e.* FROM hiring_lifecycle_history e WHERE e.organization_id=:organization_id AND e.brand_id=:brand_id AND e.requisition_id=:requisition_id AND e.application_id=:application_id AND e.operation_id=:operation_id AND e.expected_version=:expected_version AND e.from_stage=:from_stage AND e.to_stage=:to_stage AND e.evidence=:evidence AND e.registration_evidence=:registration_evidence AND e.requirements_evidence=:requirements_evidence AND e.handoff_evidence=:handoff_evidence AND e.actor_user_id=:__user_id AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access g WHERE g.user_id=:__user_id AND g.organization_id=e.organization_id AND g.brand_id=e.brand_id AND g.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (g.requisition_id IS NULL OR g.requisition_id=e.requisition_id))

tools.name: list_lifecycle_events
tools.description: Scoped immutable onboarding handoff/completion evidence, actors and times for one application.
tools.sql: SELECT e.* FROM hiring_lifecycle_history e WHERE e.organization_id=:organization_id AND e.brand_id=:brand_id AND e.requisition_id=:requisition_id AND e.application_id=:application_id AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access g WHERE g.user_id=:__user_id AND g.organization_id=e.organization_id AND g.brand_id=e.brand_id AND g.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (g.requisition_id IS NULL OR g.requisition_id=e.requisition_id)) ORDER BY expected_version DESC LIMIT 100

tools.name: correct_accepted_offer
tools.description: Owner records an evidence-backed administrative correction of mistaken accepted offer terms. Preserves original offer/acceptance and does not send or authorize a new offer. Read get_offer_correction_result after writes or lost responses.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO hiring_offer_corrections(operation_id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,offer_id,offer_version,expected_offer_lock_version,expected_application_version,correction_version,terms_json,acceptance_evidence,reason,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,:offer_id,:expected_offer_version,:expected_offer_lock_version,:expected_application_version,:expected_correction_version+1,:terms_json,:acceptance_evidence,:reason,:__user_id,:__now WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_offer_corrections WHERE operation_id=:operation_id)

tools.name: get_offer_correction_result
tools.description: Owner-scoped exact correction readback; changed payloads and other actors do not reconcile as success.
tools.sql: SELECT x.* FROM hiring_offer_corrections x WHERE x.organization_id=:organization_id AND x.brand_id=:brand_id AND x.application_id=:application_id AND x.offer_id=:offer_id AND x.operation_id=:operation_id AND x.actor_user_id=:__user_id AND x.expected_application_version=:expected_application_version AND x.offer_version=:expected_offer_version AND x.expected_offer_lock_version=:expected_offer_lock_version AND x.correction_version=:expected_correction_version+1 AND x.terms_json=:terms_json AND x.acceptance_evidence=:acceptance_evidence AND x.reason=:reason AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access g JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=x.application_id AND a.organization_id=g.organization_id AND a.brand_id=g.brand_id WHERE g.user_id=:__user_id AND g.organization_id=x.organization_id AND g.brand_id=x.brand_id AND g.role='owner' AND (g.requisition_id IS NULL OR g.requisition_id=a.requisition_id))

tools.name: list_offer_corrections
tools.description: Owner reads immutable administrative corrections of one accepted offer.
tools.sql: SELECT x.* FROM hiring_offer_corrections x WHERE x.organization_id=:organization_id AND x.brand_id=:brand_id AND x.application_id=:application_id AND x.offer_id=:offer_id AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access g JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=x.application_id AND a.organization_id=g.organization_id AND a.brand_id=g.brand_id WHERE g.user_id=:__user_id AND g.organization_id=x.organization_id AND g.brand_id=x.brand_id AND g.role='owner' AND (g.requisition_id IS NULL OR g.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) ORDER BY x.correction_version DESC LIMIT 100
