tools.name: hiring_v1_create_requisition
tools.description: Hiring mutation contract v1. Create a draft requisition for internal sourcing Refused stage and decision writes return an error; zero changes may indicate a retry.
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_requisitions(id,organization_id,brand_id,title,created_at,operation_id) SELECT :requisition_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:title,:__now,:operation_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=NULL) AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND length(trim(:title))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND :__user_id NOT IN ('system','automation','api_key','system'||char(58)||'worker') AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND typeof(:expected_version) IN ('integer','real') AND :expected_version=CAST(:expected_version AS INTEGER) AND :expected_version>=0 AND :expected_version=0

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,NULL,'requisition.created',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=NULL) AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_requisitions WHERE id=:requisition_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND operation_id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1 AND :__user_id NOT IN ('system','automation','api_key','system'||char(58)||'worker') AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND typeof(:expected_version) IN ('integer','real') AND :expected_version=CAST(:expected_version AS INTEGER) AND :expected_version>=0 AND :expected_version=0

tools.name: hiring_v1_update_requisition
tools.description: Hiring mutation contract v1. Append a scoped structured PD version. After publication, only a brand owner may revise the published PD; each revision is audited and increments the publication version. Refused stage and decision writes return an error; zero changes may indicate a retry.
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_publication_edit_checks(kind,organization_id,brand_id,requisition_id,actor_user_id,expected_version,operation_id) SELECT 'pd',:organization_id,:brand_id,:requisition_id,:__user_id,:expected_version,:operation_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_job_publications WHERE requisition_id=:requisition_id) AND :__user_id NOT IN ('system','automation','api_key','system'||char(58)||'worker') AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND typeof(:expected_version) IN ('integer','real') AND :expected_version=CAST(:expected_version AS INTEGER) AND :expected_version>=0

INSERT INTO hiring_pd_versions(requisition_id,version,payload,actor_user_id,updated_at,operation_id) SELECT r.id,:expected_version+1,json_object('overview',:overview,'rolePurpose',:rolePurpose,'responsibilities',json(:responsibilities),'requirements',json(:requirements),'workingArrangement',:workingArrangement,'compensation',:compensation,'benefits',:benefits,'applicationProcess',:applicationProcess,'privacyContact',:privacyContact),:__user_id,:__now,:operation_id FROM hiring_requisitions r WHERE r.id=:requisition_id AND r.organization_id=:organization_id AND r.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=r.organization_id AND p.brand_id=r.brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=r.id)) AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_job_publications WHERE requisition_id=r.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access own WHERE own.organization_id=r.organization_id AND own.brand_id=r.brand_id AND own.user_id=:__user_id AND own.role='owner' AND own.requisition_id IS NULL)) AND :expected_version=coalesce((SELECT max(version) FROM hiring_pd_versions WHERE requisition_id=r.id),0) AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_pd_versions WHERE operation_id=:operation_id) AND length(:overview)<=20000 AND length(:rolePurpose)<=20000 AND CASE WHEN json_valid(:responsibilities) THEN json_type(:responsibilities)='array' AND json_array_length(:responsibilities)<=100 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(:responsibilities) WHERE type<>'text' OR length(value)>2000) ELSE 0 END AND CASE WHEN json_valid(:requirements) THEN json_type(:requirements)='array' AND json_array_length(:requirements)<=100 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(:requirements) WHERE type<>'text' OR length(value)>2000) ELSE 0 END AND length(:workingArrangement)<=20000 AND length(:compensation)<=20000 AND length(:benefits)<=20000 AND length(:applicationProcess)<=20000 AND length(:privacyContact)<=20000 AND :__user_id NOT IN ('system','automation','api_key','system'||char(58)||'worker') AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND typeof(:expected_version) IN ('integer','real') AND :expected_version=CAST(:expected_version AS INTEGER) AND :expected_version>=0

INSERT INTO hiring_published_pd_revisions(requisition_id,publication_version,pd_version,payload,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT j.requisition_id,j.version+1,p.version,p.payload,:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now FROM hiring_job_publications j JOIN hiring_pd_versions p ON p.requisition_id=j.requisition_id AND p.operation_id=:operation_id WHERE j.requisition_id=:requisition_id AND j.organization_id=:organization_id AND j.brand_id=:brand_id AND j.status='published' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_pd_versions a WHERE a.requisition_id=:requisition_id AND a.operation_id=:operation_id AND a.actor_user_id=:__user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access own WHERE own.organization_id=:organization_id AND own.brand_id=:brand_id AND own.user_id=:__user_id AND own.role='owner' AND own.requisition_id IS NULL) AND :__user_id NOT IN ('system','automation','api_key','system'||char(58)||'worker') AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND typeof(:expected_version) IN ('integer','real') AND :expected_version=CAST(:expected_version AS INTEGER) AND :expected_version>=0

UPDATE hiring_job_publications SET version=version+1 WHERE requisition_id=:requisition_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_published_pd_revisions e WHERE e.requisition_id=:requisition_id AND e.operation_id=:operation_id AND e.publication_version=hiring_job_publications.version+1) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND :__user_id NOT IN ('system','automation','api_key','system'||char(58)||'worker') AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND typeof(:expected_version) IN ('integer','real') AND :expected_version=CAST(:expected_version AS INTEGER) AND :expected_version>=0

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at,object_type,object_id) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_job_publications WHERE requisition_id=:requisition_id) THEN 'requisition.pd_revised' ELSE 'requisition.pd_saved' END,:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now,'requisition',:requisition_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_pd_versions v WHERE v.requisition_id=:requisition_id AND v.operation_id=:operation_id AND v.actor_user_id=:__user_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events a WHERE a.operation_id=:operation_id) AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_job_publications j WHERE j.requisition_id=:requisition_id AND j.organization_id=:organization_id AND j.brand_id=:brand_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_published_pd_revisions e JOIN hiring_job_publications j ON j.requisition_id=e.requisition_id AND j.version=e.publication_version WHERE e.requisition_id=:requisition_id AND e.operation_id=:operation_id)) AND :__user_id NOT IN ('system','automation','api_key','system'||char(58)||'worker') AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND typeof(:expected_version) IN ('integer','real') AND :expected_version=CAST(:expected_version AS INTEGER) AND :expected_version>=0

tools.name: hiring_v1_advance_application
tools.description: Hiring mutation contract v1. Change stage using application-stages.json v1 edges, expected version, scoped owner/recruiter authority, operation deduplication and atomic history/audit Refused stage and decision writes return an error; zero changes may indicate a retry.
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_mutation_checks(kind,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,actor_user_id,expected_version,from_stage,to_stage,operation_id,reason) VALUES('stage',:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,:__user_id,:expected_version,:from_stage,:to_stage,:operation_id,:reason)

INSERT INTO hiring_decisions SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,a.requisition_id,a.id,:__user_id,(SELECT p.role FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id) ORDER BY p.role LIMIT 1),:to_stage,:reason,:__now,a.version,COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage),:operation_id FROM hiring_applications a WHERE id=:application_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND version=:expected_version AND COALESCE(workflow_stage,lifecycle_stage,accepted_stage,stage_extension,stage)=:from_stage AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND ((COALESCE(workflow_stage,lifecycle_stage,accepted_stage,stage_extension,stage)='submitted' AND :to_stage IN ('in_review')) OR (COALESCE(workflow_stage,lifecycle_stage,accepted_stage,stage_extension,stage)='in_review' AND :to_stage IN ('shortlisted','rejected','interviewing')) OR (COALESCE(workflow_stage,lifecycle_stage,accepted_stage,stage_extension,stage)='shortlisted' AND :to_stage IN ('offered','rejected','interviewing')) OR (COALESCE(workflow_stage,lifecycle_stage,accepted_stage,stage_extension,stage)='offered' AND :to_stage IN ('hired','rejected')) OR (COALESCE(workflow_stage,lifecycle_stage,accepted_stage,stage_extension,stage)='interviewing' AND :to_stage IN ('decision_pending')) OR (COALESCE(workflow_stage,lifecycle_stage,accepted_stage,stage_extension,stage)='decision_pending' AND :to_stage IN ('offered','rejected'))) AND length(trim(:reason))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events WHERE id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND (:to_stage NOT IN ('offered','hired') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_offers o JOIN hiring_offer_versions v ON v.offer_id=o.id AND v.version=o.current_version WHERE o.application_id=:application_id AND o.tenant_id=:organization_id AND o.brand_id=:brand_id AND o.status='approved')) AND :to_stage IN ('hired','rejected') AND :__user_id NOT IN ('system','automation','api_key','system'||char(58)||'worker') AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND typeof(:expected_version) IN ('integer','real') AND :expected_version=CAST(:expected_version AS INTEGER) AND :expected_version>=0 AND :to_stage NOT IN ('hired','rejected','withdrawn','accepted')

UPDATE hiring_applications SET stage=CASE WHEN :to_stage='shortlisted' THEN 'in_review' ELSE :to_stage END,stage_extension=CASE WHEN :to_stage='shortlisted' THEN 'shortlisted' ELSE NULL END,version=version+1,updated_at=:__now WHERE id=:application_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND version=:expected_version AND COALESCE(workflow_stage,lifecycle_stage,accepted_stage,stage_extension,stage)=:from_stage AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND ((COALESCE(workflow_stage,lifecycle_stage,accepted_stage,stage_extension,stage)='submitted' AND :to_stage IN ('in_review')) OR (COALESCE(workflow_stage,lifecycle_stage,accepted_stage,stage_extension,stage)='in_review' AND :to_stage IN ('shortlisted','rejected','interviewing')) OR (COALESCE(workflow_stage,lifecycle_stage,accepted_stage,stage_extension,stage)='shortlisted' AND :to_stage IN ('offered','rejected','interviewing')) OR (COALESCE(workflow_stage,lifecycle_stage,accepted_stage,stage_extension,stage)='offered' AND :to_stage IN ('hired','rejected')) OR (COALESCE(workflow_stage,lifecycle_stage,accepted_stage,stage_extension,stage)='interviewing' AND :to_stage IN ('decision_pending')) OR (COALESCE(workflow_stage,lifecycle_stage,accepted_stage,stage_extension,stage)='decision_pending' AND :to_stage IN ('offered','rejected'))) AND length(trim(:reason))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events WHERE id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND (:to_stage NOT IN ('offered','hired') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_offers o JOIN hiring_offer_versions v ON v.offer_id=o.id AND v.version=o.current_version WHERE o.application_id=:application_id AND o.tenant_id=:organization_id AND o.brand_id=:brand_id AND o.status='approved')) AND (:to_stage NOT IN ('hired','rejected') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_decisions d WHERE d.operation_id=:operation_id AND d.actor_id=:__user_id AND d.application_id=:application_id)) AND :__user_id NOT IN ('system','automation','api_key','system'||char(58)||'worker') AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND typeof(:expected_version) IN ('integer','real') AND :expected_version=CAST(:expected_version AS INTEGER) AND :expected_version>=0 AND :to_stage NOT IN ('hired','rejected','withdrawn','accepted')

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_stage_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,from_stage,to_stage,version,reason,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,:from_stage,:to_stage,:expected_version+1,:reason,:__user_id,:__now FROM hiring_applications a WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND a.version=:expected_version+1 AND COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage)=:to_stage AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1 AND :__user_id NOT IN ('system','automation','api_key','system'||char(58)||'worker') AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND typeof(:expected_version) IN ('integer','real') AND :expected_version=CAST(:expected_version AS INTEGER) AND :expected_version>=0 AND :to_stage NOT IN ('hired','rejected','withdrawn','accepted')

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'application.stage_changed',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events WHERE id=:operation_id AND application_id=:application_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1 AND :__user_id NOT IN ('system','automation','api_key','system'||char(58)||'worker') AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND typeof(:expected_version) IN ('integer','real') AND :expected_version=CAST(:expected_version AS INTEGER) AND :expected_version>=0 AND :to_stage NOT IN ('hired','rejected','withdrawn','accepted')

tools.name: hiring_v1_submit_scorecard
tools.description: Hiring mutation contract v1. Append own assigned scorecard revision. expected_version=0 creates; draft or final submitted; submission locks assignment scorecard. No decision or communication authority. Refused stage and decision writes return an error; zero changes may indicate a retry.
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_scorecard_versions(id,assignment_id,interview_id,application_id,tenant_id,brand_id,requisition_id,reviewer_id,version,status,criteria_json,created_at,submitted_at,operation_id) SELECT :__uuid,a.id,a.interview_id,a.application_id,a.tenant_id,a.brand_id,a.requisition_id,:__user_id,:expected_version+1,:status,:criteria_json,:__now,CASE WHEN :status='submitted' THEN :__now END,:operation_id FROM interview_assignments a JOIN interviews i ON i.id=a.interview_id WHERE a.id=:assignment_id AND a.interview_id=:interview_id AND a.application_id=:application_id AND a.tenant_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND a.reviewer_id=:__user_id AND a.revoked_at IS NULL AND i.status='scheduled' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications app WHERE app.id=a.application_id AND app.organization_id=a.tenant_id AND app.brand_id=a.brand_id AND app.requisition_id=a.requisition_id) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=a.tenant_id AND p.brand_id=a.brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter','reviewer') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) AND :expected_version=COALESCE((SELECT MAX(version) FROM hiring_scorecard_versions WHERE assignment_id=a.id),0) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_scorecard_versions WHERE assignment_id=a.id AND status='submitted') AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_scorecard_versions WHERE operation_id=:operation_id) AND :__user_id NOT IN ('system','automation','api_key','system'||char(58)||'worker') AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND typeof(:expected_version) IN ('integer','real') AND :expected_version=CAST(:expected_version AS INTEGER) AND :expected_version>=0 AND :status='submitted'

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at,object_type,object_id,redacted_summary) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,CASE WHEN :status='submitted' THEN 'scorecard.submitted' ELSE 'scorecard.draft_saved' END,:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now,'scorecard',:assignment_id,'Scorecard version recorded' WHERE changes()=1 AND :__user_id NOT IN ('system','automation','api_key','system'||char(58)||'worker') AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND typeof(:expected_version) IN ('integer','real') AND :expected_version=CAST(:expected_version AS INTEGER) AND :expected_version>=0 AND :status='submitted'

tools.name: hiring_v1_record_decision
tools.description: Hiring mutation contract v1. record decision. Identity and grants are server-derived; exact scoped versions and immutable audit evidence. Refused stage and decision writes return an error; zero changes may indicate a retry.
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_mutation_checks(kind,organization_id,brand_id,requisition_id,application_id,actor_user_id,actor_id,actor_role,expected_version,to_stage,operation_id,reason) VALUES('decision',:organization_id,:brand_id,:requisition_id,:application_id,:__user_id,NULL,NULL,:expected_version,:disposition,:operation_id,COALESCE(:rationale,''))

INSERT INTO hiring_decisions SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,a.requisition_id,a.id,:__user_id,(SELECT p.role FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id) ORDER BY p.role LIMIT 1),:disposition,COALESCE(:rationale,''),:__now,a.version,COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage),:operation_id FROM hiring_applications a WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) AND :__user_id NOT IN ('system','automation','api_key','system'||char(58)||'worker') AND a.requisition_id=:requisition_id AND a.version=:expected_version AND (NULL IS NULL OR NULL=:__user_id) AND (NULL IS NULL OR NULL=(SELECT p.role FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id) ORDER BY p.role LIMIT 1)) AND ((:disposition='hired' AND COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage)='offered') OR (:disposition='rejected' AND COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage) IN ('in_review','shortlisted','offered','decision_pending')) OR (:disposition IN ('withdrawn','deferred') AND COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage) IN ('submitted','in_review','shortlisted','interviewing','decision_pending','offered'))) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE id=:operation_id OR operation_id=:operation_id) AND :__user_id NOT IN ('system','automation','api_key','system'||char(58)||'worker') AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND typeof(:expected_version) IN ('integer','real') AND :expected_version=CAST(:expected_version AS INTEGER) AND :expected_version>=0

UPDATE hiring_applications SET stage=CASE WHEN :disposition='deferred' THEN stage ELSE :disposition END,stage_extension=CASE WHEN :disposition='deferred' THEN stage_extension ELSE NULL END,version=version+1,updated_at=:__now WHERE id=:application_id AND changes()=1 AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_decisions d WHERE d.operation_id=:operation_id AND d.application_id=hiring_applications.id AND d.actor_id=:__user_id AND d.application_version=:expected_version) AND :__user_id NOT IN ('system','automation','api_key','system'||char(58)||'worker') AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND typeof(:expected_version) IN ('integer','real') AND :expected_version=CAST(:expected_version AS INTEGER) AND :expected_version>=0

INSERT INTO hiring_stage_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,from_stage,to_stage,version,reason,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,a.id,(SELECT from_stage FROM hiring_decisions WHERE operation_id=:operation_id AND actor_id=:__user_id),COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage),a.version,COALESCE(:rationale,''),:__user_id,:__now FROM hiring_applications a WHERE a.id=:application_id AND changes()=1 AND :__user_id NOT IN ('system','automation','api_key','system'||char(58)||'worker') AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND typeof(:expected_version) IN ('integer','real') AND :expected_version=CAST(:expected_version AS INTEGER) AND :expected_version>=0

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at,request_id,object_type,object_id,redacted_summary) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,a.id,'decision.recorded',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now,:operation_id,'hiring_decisions',:operation_id,'decision.recorded' FROM hiring_applications a WHERE a.id=(SELECT application_id FROM hiring_decisions WHERE operation_id=:operation_id) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) AND :__user_id NOT IN ('system','automation','api_key','system'||char(58)||'worker') AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE id=:operation_id OR operation_id=:operation_id) AND :__user_id NOT IN ('system','automation','api_key','system'||char(58)||'worker') AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND typeof(:expected_version) IN ('integer','real') AND :expected_version=CAST(:expected_version AS INTEGER) AND :expected_version>=0

tools.name: hiring_v1_record_lifecycle_transition
tools.description: Hiring mutation contract v1. Record accepted → onboarding → onboarded → active, or rejected/withdrawn before activation. Completion requires registration, requirements and handoff evidence. Exact retry uses get_lifecycle_result. Refused stage and decision writes return an error; zero changes may indicate a retry.
statements: INSERT INTO hiring_lifecycle_events_v2 (organization_id,brand_id,requisition_id,application_id,operation_id,expected_version,from_stage,to_stage,evidence,registration_evidence,requirements_evidence,handoff_evidence,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT :organization_id,:brand_id,:requisition_id,:application_id,:operation_id,:expected_version,:from_stage,:to_stage,:evidence,:registration_evidence,:requirements_evidence,:handoff_evidence,:__user_id,:__now WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_lifecycle_events_v2 WHERE operation_id=:operation_id) AND :__user_id NOT IN ('system','automation','api_key','system'||char(58)||'worker') AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND typeof(:expected_version) IN ('integer','real') AND :expected_version=CAST(:expected_version AS INTEGER) AND :expected_version>=0

tools.name: hiring_v1_draft_message
tools.description: Hiring mutation contract v1. Save an unsent email draft to the internal outbox; no send capability Refused stage and decision writes return an error; zero changes may indicate a retry.
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_outbox(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,recipient_email,subject,body,status,actor_user_id,created_at,operation_id,logical_email_id,template_id,template_version) SELECT :draft_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,:recipient_email,:subject,:body,'draft',:__user_id,:__now,:operation_id,:__uuid,:template_id,:template_version FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND c.email=:recipient_email AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND length(trim(:subject))>0 AND length(trim(:body))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND :__user_id NOT IN ('system','automation','api_key','system'||char(58)||'worker') AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND typeof(:expected_version) IN ('integer','real') AND :expected_version=CAST(:expected_version AS INTEGER) AND :expected_version>=0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications v WHERE v.id=:application_id AND v.organization_id=:organization_id AND v.brand_id=:brand_id AND v.version=:expected_version)

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'communication.draft_created',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_outbox WHERE id=:draft_id AND application_id=:application_id AND status='draft' AND operation_id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND changes()=1 AND :__user_id NOT IN ('system','automation','api_key','system'||char(58)||'worker') AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND typeof(:expected_version) IN ('integer','real') AND :expected_version=CAST(:expected_version AS INTEGER) AND :expected_version>=0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications v WHERE v.id=:application_id AND v.organization_id=:organization_id AND v.brand_id=:brand_id AND v.version=:expected_version)

tools.name: hiring_v1_send_approved_message
tools.description: Hiring mutation contract v1. outbox.queued; atomic scoped outbox transition, no provider call Refused stage and decision writes return an error; zero changes may indicate a retry. Requires preview of the immutable draft and pinned approved template version; the authorised user confirms the queued message in the app, not a provider delivery receipt.

id=(SELECT t.id FROM hiring_communication_templates t JOIN hiring_template_approvals ap ON ap.template_id=t.id AND ap.version=t.version WHERE (hiring_outbox.template_id IS NULL OR (t.id=hiring_outbox.template_id AND t.version=hiring_outbox.template_version)) AND t.organization_id=hiring_outbox.organization_id AND t.brand_id=hiring_outbox.brand_id AND t.subject=hiring_outbox.subject AND t.body=hiring_outbox.body ORDER BY t.id LIMIT 1)),logical_email_id=COALESCE(logical_email_id,:__uuid),delivery_state='pending',idempotency_key=operation_id WHERE id=:draft_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND application_id=:application_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND length(trim(:operation_id))>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND delivery_state='draft' AND operation_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_communication_templates t JOIN hiring_template_approvals ap ON ap.template_id=t.id AND ap.version=t.version JOIN hiring_applications a ON a.id=hiring_outbox.application_id JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id WHERE (hiring_outbox.template_id IS NULL OR (t.id=hiring_outbox.template_id AND t.version=hiring_outbox.template_version)) AND t.organization_id=hiring_outbox.organization_id AND :__user_id NOT IN ('system','automation','api_key','system'||char(58)||'worker') AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND typeof(:expected_version) IN ('integer','real') AND :expected_version=CAST(:expected_version AS INTEGER) AND :expected_version>=0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_outbox v WHERE v.id=:draft_id AND v.organization_id=:organization_id AND v.brand_id=:brand_id AND v.application_id=:application_id AND v.template_id IS NOT NULL AND v.template_version=:expected_version)

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at,request_id,object_type,object_id,redacted_summary) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'outbox.queued',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now,:operation_id,'outbox',:draft_id,'outbox.queued' WHERE changes()=1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications pa WHERE pa.id=:application_id AND pa.organization_id=:organization_id AND pa.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=pa.requisition_id))) AND :__user_id NOT IN ('system','automation','api_key','system'||char(58)||'worker') AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND typeof(:expected_version) IN ('integer','real') AND :expected_version=CAST(:expected_version AS INTEGER) AND :expected_version>=0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_outbox v WHERE v.id=:draft_id AND v.organization_id=:organization_id AND v.brand_id=:brand_id AND v.application_id=:application_id AND v.template_id IS NOT NULL AND v.template_version=:expected_version)

tools.name: update_application_interns_fields
tools.description: Owner or recruiter sets the Discord handle and Interns invite ID on one scoped application with expected version and audit. Omit a field to retain it; empty Discord handle clears it. Verify the returned changes and read back the application.
statements: UPDATE hiring_applications AS a SET discord_handle=CASE WHEN :discord_handle IS NULL THEN discord_handle ELSE NULLIF(trim(:discord_handle),'') END,interns_app_id=CASE WHEN :interns_app_id IS NULL THEN interns_app_id ELSE trim(:interns_app_id) END,version=version+1,updated_at=:__now WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND a.version=:expected_version AND (:discord_handle IS NOT NULL OR :interns_app_id IS NOT NULL) AND (:discord_handle IS NULL OR length(trim(:discord_handle))<=100) AND (:interns_app_id IS NULL OR length(trim(:interns_app_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 200) AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=a.organization_id AND p.brand_id=a.brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id))

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at,object_type,object_id,redacted_summary) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'application.interns_fields_updated',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now,'application',:application_id,'Interns reference or Discord handle updated' WHERE changes()=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications a WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=a.organization_id AND p.brand_id=a.brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)))

tools.name: update_invite_status
tools.description: Owner or recruiter manually sets the Interns onboarding registration status (invited, registered, expired, or revoked) on one scoped application with expected version and audit. Use to confirm a candidate registered after accepting an invite, or to mark an invite expired or revoked. An unrecognised status makes zero changes; verify the returned changes and read back the application.
statements: UPDATE hiring_applications AS a SET interns_registration_status=:status,version=version+1,updated_at=:__now WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND a.version=:expected_version AND :status IN ('invited','registered','expired','revoked') AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=a.organization_id AND p.brand_id=a.brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id))

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at,object_type,object_id,redacted_summary) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'application.invite_status_updated',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now,'application',:application_id,'Interns registration status set to '||:status WHERE changes()=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications a WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=a.organization_id AND p.brand_id=a.brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)))

tools.name: list_onboarding_crossref
tools.description: Read current onboarding people with their latest onboarding lifecycle evidence and Hiring/Interns references for granted requisitions. Interns status is local pending evidence, not a live Interns lookup.
tools.sql: SELECT a.id AS application_id,a.requisition_id,c.name AS applicant_name,c.email AS applicant_email,COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage) AS current_status,a.interns_app_id,a.interns_invite_status,a.interns_registration_status,a.discord_handle,e.operation_id AS onboarding_operation_id,e.created_at AS onboarding_started_at FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id AND c.organization_id=a.organization_id AND c.brand_id=a.brand_id LEFT JOIN hiring_lifecycle_history e ON e.operation_id=(SELECT h.operation_id FROM hiring_lifecycle_history h WHERE h.application_id=a.id AND h.organization_id=a.organization_id AND h.brand_id=a.brand_id AND h.to_stage='onboarding' ORDER BY h.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND COALESCE(a.workflow_stage,a.lifecycle_stage,a.accepted_stage,a.stage_extension,a.stage)='onboarding' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=a.organization_id AND p.brand_id=a.brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=a.requisition_id)) ORDER BY a.updated_at DESC LIMIT 100

tools.name: query_audit_log
tools.description: Read scoped MCP audit entries by candidate, entity, time, tool, or caller. Results include redacted input JSON.

from_ts.description: Inclusive Unix milliseconds; seconds are accepted and normalized.

to_ts.description: Exclusive Unix milliseconds; seconds are accepted and normalized.

tools.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT id,(CASE WHEN abs(timestamp)<10000000000 THEN timestamp*1000 ELSE timestamp END) AS timestamp,caller_agent_id,caller_session_id,tool_name,input_json,result_status,result_summary,affected_entity_ids_json,operation_id,candidate_id,entity_id FROM mcp_audit_log WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id UNION ALL SELECT e.id,(CASE WHEN abs(e.created_at)<10000000000 THEN e.created_at*1000 ELSE e.created_at END),NULL,NULL,e.action,'{}','completed',e.redacted_summary,json_array(e.object_id),e.operation_id,NULL,e.object_id FROM hiring_audit_events e WHERE e.organization_id=:organization_id AND e.brand_id=:brand_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mcp_audit_log a WHERE a.organization_id=e.organization_id AND a.brand_id=e.brand_id AND a.operation_id=e.operation_id)) WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter','auditor')) AND (:candidate_id IS NULL OR candidate_id=:candidate_id) AND (:entity_id IS NULL OR entity_id=:entity_id) AND (:operation_id IS NULL OR operation_id=:operation_id) AND (:tool_name IS NULL OR tool_name=:tool_name) AND (:caller_agent_id IS NULL OR caller_agent_id=:caller_agent_id) AND (:from_ts IS NULL OR timestamp>=(CASE WHEN :from_ts IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (CASE WHEN abs(:from_ts)<10000000000 THEN :from_ts*1000 ELSE :from_ts END) END)) AND (:to_ts IS NULL OR timestamp<(CASE WHEN :to_ts IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (CASE WHEN abs(:to_ts)<10000000000 THEN :to_ts*1000 ELSE :to_ts END) END)) ORDER BY timestamp DESC,id DESC LIMIT min(max(coalesce(:limit,100),1),100)

tools.name: log_external_action
tools.description: Record an actual email, LinkedIn, or Discord action, or append a clearly labeled manual journal entry. This tool does not perform an external action.

performed_at.description: User-supplied occurrence time in Unix milliseconds; seconds are accepted and normalized. Manual journal recording time is server-supplied.

statements: INSERT INTO hiring_mcp_refusals(message) SELECT message FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN :kind NOT IN ('email','linkedin','discord','journal') THEN 'invalid_kind_allowed_email_linkedin_discord' WHEN NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND p.requisition_id IS NULL)) THEN 'not_found' WHEN :target_org_id IS NOT NULL AND :target_org_id<>:organization_id THEN 'not_found' WHEN :target_candidate_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_candidates c WHERE c.id=:target_candidate_id AND c.organization_id=:organization_id AND c.brand_id=:brand_id) THEN 'not_found' WHEN NOT json_valid(:params_json) THEN 'invalid_params_json' WHEN :kind='journal' AND NOT ((:application_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications a WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND (:target_candidate_id IS NULL OR a.candidate_id=:target_candidate_id)))) THEN 'not_found' WHEN :kind='journal' AND NOT (json_valid(:params_json) AND json_type(:params_json)='object' AND json_extract(:params_json,'$.entry_type') IN ('action','observation','decision','message','outcome','uncertainty','pending','correction') AND length(trim(coalesce(:notes,''))) BETWEEN 1 AND 5000 AND length(trim(coalesce(:performed_by,''))) BETWEEN 1 AND 300 AND :performed_at>0 AND :gmail_message_id IS NULL AND :linkedin_message_id IS NULL AND :discord_message_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(:params_json) WHERE key NOT IN ('entry_type','outcome','uncertainty','next_step','receipt_ref','approval_ref','correction_of')) AND (json_extract(:params_json,'$.entry_type')<>'pending' OR json_extract(:params_json,'$.next_step') IS NOT NULL) AND (json_extract(:params_json,'$.entry_type')<>'correction' OR json_extract(:params_json,'$.correction_of') IS NOT NULL) AND (json_extract(:params_json,'$.outcome') IS NULL OR (json_type(:params_json,'$.outcome')='text' AND length(trim(json_extract(:params_json,'$.outcome'))) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000)) AND (json_extract(:params_json,'$.uncertainty') IS NULL OR (json_type(:params_json,'$.uncertainty')='text' AND length(trim(json_extract(:params_json,'$.uncertainty'))) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000)) AND (json_extract(:params_json,'$.next_step') IS NULL OR (json_type(:params_json,'$.next_step')='text' AND length(trim(json_extract(:params_json,'$.next_step'))) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000)) AND (json_extract(:params_json,'$.receipt_ref') IS NULL OR (json_type(:params_json,'$.receipt_ref')='text' AND length(trim(json_extract(:params_json,'$.receipt_ref'))) BETWEEN 1 AND 300 AND instr(json_extract(:params_json,'$.receipt_ref'),'?')=0 AND instr(json_extract(:params_json,'$.receipt_ref'),'#')=0)) AND (json_extract(:params_json,'$.approval_ref') IS NULL OR (json_type(:params_json,'$.approval_ref')='text' AND length(trim(json_extract(:params_json,'$.approval_ref'))) BETWEEN 1 AND 300 AND instr(json_extract(:params_json,'$.approval_ref'),'?')=0 AND instr(json_extract(:params_json,'$.approval_ref'),'#')=0)) AND (json_extract(:params_json,'$.correction_of') IS NULL OR (json_type(:params_json,'$.correction_of')='text' AND length(trim(json_extract(:params_json,'$.correction_of'))) BETWEEN 1 AND 300 AND instr(json_extract(:params_json,'$.correction_of'),'?')=0 AND instr(json_extract(:params_json,'$.correction_of'),'#')=0))) THEN 'invalid_params_json_journal' WHEN :kind='journal' AND json_extract(:params_json,'$.correction_of') IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mcp_audit_log j WHERE j.id=json_extract(:params_json,'$.correction_of') AND j.organization_id=:organization_id AND j.brand_id=:brand_id AND j.tool_name='manual_journal') THEN 'not_found' WHEN NOT (length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128) THEN 'duplicate_operation_id' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM external_actions WHERE operation_id=:operation_id) THEN 'duplicate_operation_id' WHEN :kind='journal' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mcp_audit_log WHERE id=:operation_id AND (tool_name<>'manual_journal' OR organization_id<>:organization_id OR brand_id<>:brand_id OR input_json<>json_object('kind','journal','entry_type',json_extract(:params_json,'$.entry_type'),'summary',:notes,'outcome',json_extract(:params_json,'$.outcome'),'uncertainty',json_extract(:params_json,'$.uncertainty'),'next_step',json_extract(:params_json,'$.next_step'),'receipt_ref',json_extract(:params_json,'$.receipt_ref'),'approval_ref',json_extract(:params_json,'$.approval_ref'),'correction_of',json_extract(:params_json,'$.correction_of'),'application_id',:application_id,'candidate_id',coalesce(:target_candidate_id,(SELECT a.candidate_id FROM hiring_applications a WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id)),'org_id',coalesce(:target_org_id,:organization_id),'occurred_at',(CASE WHEN abs(:performed_at)<10000000000 THEN :performed_at*1000 ELSE :performed_at END),'claimed_performer',:performed_by,'recorder_user_id',:__user_id))) THEN 'duplicate_operation_id' ELSE NULL END AS message) WHERE message IS NOT NULL

INSERT INTO external_actions(id,organization_id,brand_id,target_candidate_id,target_org_id,performed_at,kind,gmail_message_id,linkedin_message_id,discord_message_id,params_json,performed_by,notes,operation_id) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:target_candidate_id,coalesce(:target_org_id,:organization_id),(CASE WHEN abs(:performed_at)<10000000000 THEN :performed_at*1000 ELSE :performed_at END),:kind,:gmail_message_id,:linkedin_message_id,:discord_message_id,:params_json,:performed_by,:notes,:operation_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND json_valid(:params_json) AND (:target_org_id IS NULL OR :target_org_id=:organization_id) AND (:target_candidate_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_candidates c WHERE c.id=:target_candidate_id AND c.organization_id=:organization_id AND c.brand_id=:brand_id)) AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM external_actions WHERE operation_id=:operation_id) AND :kind<>'journal'

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at,object_type,object_id,redacted_summary) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,'external_action.'||:kind,:__user_id,:operation_id,(CASE WHEN abs(:performed_at)<10000000000 THEN :performed_at*1000 ELSE :performed_at END),'external_action',:operation_id,coalesce(:notes,'External action recorded') WHERE changes()=1

INSERT INTO mcp_audit_log(id,organization_id,brand_id,candidate_id,entity_id,timestamp,caller_agent_id,caller_session_id,tool_name,input_json,result_status,result_summary,affected_entity_ids_json,operation_id) SELECT lower(hex(randomblob(16))),:organization_id,:brand_id,:target_candidate_id,:operation_id,(CASE WHEN abs(:performed_at)<10000000000 THEN :performed_at*1000 ELSE :performed_at END),NULL,NULL,'log_external_action',json_object('kind',:kind,'target_candidate_id',:target_candidate_id,'target_org_id',:target_org_id,'application_id',:application_id,'performed_by',:performed_by,'performed_at',:performed_at,'params_json','[REDACTED]','gmail_message_id',:gmail_message_id,'linkedin_message_id',:linkedin_message_id,'discord_message_id',:discord_message_id,'notes',:notes,'operation_id',:operation_id),'completed','SQL :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,coalesce(:target_candidate_id,(SELECT a.candidate_id FROM hiring_applications a WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id)),coalesce(:application_id,:operation_id),(CASE WHEN abs(:__now)<10000000000 THEN :__now*1000 ELSE :__now END),NULL,NULL,'manual_journal',json_object('kind','journal','entry_type',json_extract(:params_json,'$.entry_type'),'summary',:notes,'outcome',json_extract(:params_json,'$.outcome'),'uncertainty',json_extract(:params_json,'$.uncertainty'),'next_step',json_extract(:params_json,'$.next_step'),'receipt_ref',json_extract(:params_json,'$.receipt_ref'),'approval_ref',json_extract(:params_json,'$.approval_ref'),'correction_of',json_extract(:params_json,'$.correction_of'),'application_id',:application_id,'candidate_id',coalesce(:target_candidate_id,(SELECT a.candidate_id FROM hiring_applications a WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id)),'org_id',coalesce(:target_org_id,:organization_id),'occurred_at',(CASE WHEN abs(:performed_at)<10000000000 THEN :performed_at*1000 ELSE :performed_at END),'claimed_performer',:performed_by,'recorder_user_id',:__user_id),'recorded',:notes,json_array(coalesce(:application_id,coalesce(:target_candidate_id,(SELECT a.candidate_id FROM hiring_applications a WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id)),:operation_id)),:operation_id WHERE :kind='journal' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND (:application_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications a WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND (:target_candidate_id IS NULL OR a.candidate_id=:target_candidate_id))) AND json_valid(:params_json) AND json_type(:params_json)='object' AND json_extract(:params_json,'$.entry_type') IN ('action','observation','decision','message','outcome','uncertainty','pending','correction') AND length(trim(coalesce(:notes,''))) BETWEEN 1 AND 5000 AND length(trim(coalesce(:performed_by,''))) BETWEEN 1 AND 300 AND :performed_at>0 AND :gmail_message_id IS NULL AND :linkedin_message_id IS NULL AND :discord_message_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(:params_json) WHERE key NOT IN ('entry_type','outcome','uncertainty','next_step','receipt_ref','approval_ref','correction_of')) AND (json_extract(:params_json,'$.entry_type')<>'pending' OR json_extract(:params_json,'$.next_step') IS NOT NULL) AND (json_extract(:params_json,'$.entry_type')<>'correction' OR json_extract(:params_json,'$.correction_of') IS NOT NULL) AND (json_extract(:params_json,'$.outcome') IS NULL OR (json_type(:params_json,'$.outcome')='text' AND length(trim(json_extract(:params_json,'$.outcome'))) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000)) AND (json_extract(:params_json,'$.uncertainty') IS NULL OR (json_type(:params_json,'$.uncertainty')='text' AND length(trim(json_extract(:params_json,'$.uncertainty'))) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000)) AND (json_extract(:params_json,'$.next_step') IS NULL OR (json_type(:params_json,'$.next_step')='text' AND length(trim(json_extract(:params_json,'$.next_step'))) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000)) AND (json_extract(:params_json,'$.receipt_ref') IS NULL OR (json_type(:params_json,'$.receipt_ref')='text' AND length(trim(json_extract(:params_json,'$.receipt_ref'))) BETWEEN 1 AND 300 AND instr(json_extract(:params_json,'$.receipt_ref'),'?')=0 AND instr(json_extract(:params_json,'$.receipt_ref'),'#')=0)) AND (json_extract(:params_json,'$.approval_ref') IS NULL OR (json_type(:params_json,'$.approval_ref')='text' AND length(trim(json_extract(:params_json,'$.approval_ref'))) BETWEEN 1 AND 300 AND instr(json_extract(:params_json,'$.approval_ref'),'?')=0 AND instr(json_extract(:params_json,'$.approval_ref'),'#')=0)) AND (json_extract(:params_json,'$.correction_of') IS NULL OR (json_type(:params_json,'$.correction_of')='text' AND length(trim(json_extract(:params_json,'$.correction_of'))) BETWEEN 1 AND 300 AND instr(json_extract(:params_json,'$.correction_of'),'?')=0 AND instr(json_extract(:params_json,'$.correction_of'),'#')=0)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mcp_audit_log WHERE id=:operation_id)

tools.name: get_activity_timeline
tools.description: Read a chronological timeline of scoped MCP audit and externally recorded actions.

from_ts.description: Inclusive Unix milliseconds; seconds are accepted and normalized.

to_ts.description: Exclusive Unix milliseconds; seconds are accepted and normalized.

tools.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT id,(CASE WHEN tool_name='manual_journal' THEN (CASE WHEN tool_name='manual_journal' THEN json_extract(input_json,'$.occurred_at') ELSE NULL END) ELSE (CASE WHEN abs(timestamp)<10000000000 THEN timestamp*1000 ELSE timestamp END) END) AS ts,(CASE WHEN tool_name='manual_journal' THEN 'journal' ELSE 'mcp' END) AS source,(CASE WHEN tool_name='manual_journal' THEN 'journal' ELSE tool_name END) AS kind,(CASE WHEN tool_name='manual_journal' THEN (CASE WHEN tool_name='manual_journal' THEN json_extract(input_json,'$.recorder_user_id') ELSE NULL END) ELSE caller_agent_id END) AS actor,result_summary AS summary,operation_id,candidate_id,organization_id AS org_id,(CASE WHEN tool_name='manual_journal' THEN (CASE WHEN abs(timestamp)<10000000000 THEN timestamp*1000 ELSE timestamp END) ELSE NULL END) AS recorded_at,(CASE WHEN tool_name='manual_journal' THEN json_extract(input_json,'$.entry_type') ELSE NULL END) AS entry_type,(CASE WHEN tool_name='manual_journal' THEN json_extract(input_json,'$.claimed_performer') ELSE NULL END) AS claimed_performer,(CASE WHEN tool_name='manual_journal' THEN json_extract(input_json,'$.application_id') ELSE NULL END) AS application_id,(CASE WHEN tool_name='manual_journal' THEN json_extract(input_json,'$.outcome') ELSE NULL END) AS outcome,(CASE WHEN tool_name='manual_journal' THEN json_extract(input_json,'$.uncertainty') ELSE NULL END) AS uncertainty,(CASE WHEN tool_name='manual_journal' THEN json_extract(input_json,'$.next_step') ELSE NULL END) AS next_step,(CASE WHEN tool_name='manual_journal' THEN json_extract(input_json,'$.receipt_ref') ELSE NULL END) AS receipt_ref,(CASE WHEN tool_name='manual_journal' THEN json_extract(input_json,'$.approval_ref') ELSE NULL END) AS approval_ref,(CASE WHEN tool_name='manual_journal' THEN json_extract(input_json,'$.correction_of') ELSE NULL END) AS correction_of FROM mcp_audit_log WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND (:candidate_id IS NULL OR candidate_id=:candidate_id) AND (:org_id IS NULL OR organization_id=:org_id) UNION ALL SELECT id,(CASE WHEN abs(performed_at)<10000000000 THEN performed_at*1000 ELSE performed_at END) AS ts,'external' AS source,kind,performed_by AS actor,notes AS summary,operation_id,target_candidate_id AS candidate_id,target_org_id AS org_id,NULL AS recorded_at,NULL AS entry_type,NULL AS claimed_performer,NULL AS application_id,NULL AS outcome,NULL AS uncertainty,NULL AS next_step,NULL AS receipt_ref,NULL AS approval_ref,NULL AS correction_of FROM external_actions WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND (:candidate_id IS NULL OR target_candidate_id=:candidate_id) AND (:org_id IS NULL OR target_org_id=:org_id) UNION ALL SELECT e.id,(CASE WHEN abs(e.created_at)<10000000000 THEN e.created_at*1000 ELSE e.created_at END),'audit',e.action,e.actor_user_id,e.redacted_summary,e.operation_id,NULL,e.organization_id,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL FROM hiring_audit_events e WHERE e.organization_id=:organization_id AND e.brand_id=:brand_id AND :candidate_id IS NULL AND (:org_id IS NULL OR e.organization_id=:org_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mcp_audit_log a WHERE a.organization_id=e.organization_id AND a.brand_id=e.brand_id AND a.operation_id=e.operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM external_actions x WHERE x.organization_id=e.organization_id AND x.brand_id=e.brand_id AND x.operation_id=e.operation_id)) WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter','auditor')) AND (:from_ts IS NULL OR ts>=(CASE WHEN :from_ts IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (CASE WHEN abs(:from_ts)<10000000000 THEN :from_ts*1000 ELSE :from_ts END) END)) AND (:to_ts IS NULL OR ts<(CASE WHEN :to_ts IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (CASE WHEN abs(:to_ts)<10000000000 THEN :to_ts*1000 ELSE :to_ts END) END)) AND ((:before_ts IS NULL AND :before_id IS NULL AND :before_source IS NULL) OR (:before_ts IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(:before_id))>0 AND :before_source IN ('mcp','external','audit','journal') AND (ts<(CASE WHEN abs(:before_ts)<10000000000 THEN :before_ts*1000 ELSE :before_ts END) OR (ts=(CASE WHEN abs(:before_ts)<10000000000 THEN :before_ts*1000 ELSE :before_ts END) AND (id<:before_id OR (id=:before_id AND source<:before_source)))))) ORDER BY ts DESC,id DESC,source DESC LIMIT min(max(coalesce(:limit,100),1),100)

tools.name: create_next_action
tools.description: Create an open next action linked to a candidate or organization and optionally an audit event.
statements: INSERT INTO next_actions(id,organization_id,brand_id,candidate_id,org_id,action,due_at,owner,status,triggering_event_id,created_at,updated_at,operation_id) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:candidate_id,coalesce(:org_id,:organization_id),:action,:due_at,:owner,'open',:triggering_event_id,:__now,:__now,:operation_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND (:candidate_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_candidates c WHERE c.id=:candidate_id AND c.organization_id=:organization_id AND c.brand_id=:brand_id)) AND (:org_id IS NULL OR :org_id=:organization_id) AND (:triggering_event_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mcp_audit_log a WHERE a.id=:triggering_event_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id)) AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM next_actions WHERE operation_id=:operation_id)

INSERT INTO mcp_audit_log(id,organization_id,brand_id,candidate_id,entity_id,timestamp,caller_agent_id,caller_session_id,tool_name,input_json,result_status,result_summary,affected_entity_ids_json,operation_id) SELECT lower(hex(randomblob(16))),:organization_id,:brand_id,:candidate_id,:operation_id,(CASE WHEN abs(:__now)<10000000000 THEN :__now*1000 ELSE :__now END),NULL,NULL,'create_next_action',json_object('candidate_id',:candidate_id,'org_id',:org_id,'action',:action,'due_at',:due_at,'owner',:owner,'triggering_event_id',:triggering_event_id,'operation_id',:operation_id),'completed','SQL mutation completed',json_array(:operation_id),:operation_id WHERE changes()=1 AND :__user_id IS NOT NULL

tools.name: update_next_action
tools.description: Update an existing next action, including blocker state and due date.
statements: UPDATE next_actions SET action=coalesce(:action,action),due_at=coalesce(:due_at,due_at),owner=coalesce(:owner,owner),status=coalesce(:status,status),blocker_reason=CASE WHEN :status='blocked' THEN :blocker_reason WHEN :status IS NOT NULL THEN NULL ELSE coalesce(:blocker_reason,blocker_reason) END,updated_at=:__now,operation_id=:operation_id WHERE id=:id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND status<>'done' AND (:status IS NULL OR :status IN ('open','done','blocked')) AND (:status IS NULL OR :status<>'blocked' OR length(trim(:blocker_reason))>0) AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM next_actions n WHERE n.operation_id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mcp_audit_log a WHERE a.operation_id=:operation_id)

INSERT INTO mcp_audit_log(id,organization_id,brand_id,candidate_id,entity_id,timestamp,caller_agent_id,caller_session_id,tool_name,input_json,result_status,result_summary,affected_entity_ids_json,operation_id) SELECT lower(hex(randomblob(16))),:organization_id,:brand_id,NULL,:id,(CASE WHEN abs(:__now)<10000000000 THEN :__now*1000 ELSE :__now END),NULL,NULL,'update_next_action',json_object('id',:id,'action',:action,'due_at',:due_at,'owner',:owner,'status',:status,'blocker_reason',:blocker_reason,'operation_id',:operation_id),'completed','SQL mutation completed',json_array(:id),:operation_id WHERE changes()=1 AND :__user_id IS NOT NULL

tools.name: complete_next_action
tools.description: Mark one scoped next action done.
statements: UPDATE next_actions SET status='done',blocker_reason=NULL,updated_at=:__now,operation_id=:operation_id WHERE id=:id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND status<>'done' AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM next_actions n WHERE n.operation_id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mcp_audit_log a WHERE a.operation_id=:operation_id)

INSERT INTO mcp_audit_log(id,organization_id,brand_id,candidate_id,entity_id,timestamp,caller_agent_id,caller_session_id,tool_name,input_json,result_status,result_summary,affected_entity_ids_json,operation_id) SELECT lower(hex(randomblob(16))),:organization_id,:brand_id,NULL,:id,(CASE WHEN abs(:__now)<10000000000 THEN :__now*1000 ELSE :__now END),NULL,NULL,'complete_next_action',json_object('id',:id,'operation_id',:operation_id),'completed','SQL mutation completed',json_array(:id),:operation_id WHERE changes()=1 AND :__user_id IS NOT NULL

tools.name: list_next_actions
tools.description: List scoped next actions by candidate, organization, status, and owner.
tools.sql: SELECT id,candidate_id,org_id,action,due_at,owner,status,blocker_reason,triggering_event_id,created_at,updated_at FROM next_actions WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter','auditor')) AND (:candidate_id IS NULL OR candidate_id=:candidate_id) AND (:org_id IS NULL OR org_id=:org_id) AND (:status IS NULL OR status=:status) AND (:owner IS NULL OR owner=:owner) ORDER BY due_at ASC,id ASC LIMIT min(max(coalesce(:limit,100),1),100)

tools.name: session_start
tools.description: Resume work with open actions, overdue actions, and recent audit or external activity since a timestamp.

since.description: Inclusive Unix milliseconds; seconds are accepted and normalized. Defaults to the last 24 hours.

tools.sql: SELECT (SELECT coalesce(json_group_array(json_object('id',id,'candidate_id',candidate_id,'action',action,'due_at',due_at,'owner',owner,'status',status)),json('[]')) FROM (SELECT id,candidate_id,action,due_at,owner,status FROM next_actions WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND status='open' ORDER BY due_at LIMIT 100)) AS open_actions,(SELECT coalesce(json_group_array(json_object('id',id,'candidate_id',candidate_id,'action',action,'due_at',due_at,'owner',owner)),json('[]')) FROM (SELECT id,candidate_id,action,due_at,owner FROM next_actions WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND status='open' AND (CASE WHEN abs(due_at)<10000000000 THEN due_at*1000 ELSE due_at END)<(CASE WHEN abs(:__now)<10000000000 THEN :__now*1000 ELSE :__now END) ORDER BY due_at LIMIT 100)) AS overdue_actions,(SELECT coalesce(json_group_array(json_object('id',id,'ts',ts,'kind',kind,'source',source)),json('[]')) FROM (SELECT id,(CASE WHEN abs(timestamp)<10000000000 THEN timestamp*1000 ELSE timestamp END) AS ts,tool_name AS kind,'mcp' AS source FROM mcp_audit_log WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND (CASE WHEN abs(timestamp)<10000000000 THEN timestamp*1000 ELSE timestamp END)>=coalesce((CASE WHEN :since IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (CASE WHEN abs(:since)<10000000000 THEN :since*1000 ELSE :since END) END),(CASE WHEN abs(:__now)<10000000000 THEN :__now*1000 ELSE :__now END)-86400000) UNION ALL SELECT id,(CASE WHEN abs(performed_at)<10000000000 THEN performed_at*1000 ELSE performed_at END) AS ts,kind,'external' AS source FROM external_actions WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND (CASE WHEN abs(performed_at)<10000000000 THEN performed_at*1000 ELSE performed_at END)>=coalesce((CASE WHEN :since IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (CASE WHEN abs(:since)<10000000000 THEN :since*1000 ELSE :since END) END),(CASE WHEN abs(:__now)<10000000000 THEN :__now*1000 ELSE :__now END)-86400000) UNION ALL SELECT e.id,(CASE WHEN abs(e.created_at)<10000000000 THEN e.created_at*1000 ELSE e.created_at END) AS ts,e.action AS kind,'audit' AS source FROM hiring_audit_events e WHERE e.organization_id=:organization_id AND e.brand_id=:brand_id AND (CASE WHEN abs(e.created_at)<10000000000 THEN e.created_at*1000 ELSE e.created_at END)>=coalesce((CASE WHEN UPDATE hiring_job_publications SET status=CASE WHEN :linkedin_status IN ('expired','closed') THEN 'closed' ELSE 'published' END,lifecycle_status=CASE WHEN :linkedin_status='expired' THEN 'expired' WHEN :linkedin_status='closed' THEN 'closed' ELSE 'published' END,expiry_date=coalesce((CASE WHEN abs(:expiry_date)<10000000000 THEN :expiry_date*1000 ELSE :expiry_date END),expiry_date),version=version+1 WHERE requisition_id=:requisition_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND version=:expected_version AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND :linkedin_status IN ('active','paused','expired','closed') AND length(trim(:reason)) BETWEEN 1 AND 1000 AND (:expiry_date IS NULL OR :expiry_date>0) AND (status='published' OR (:linkedin_status IN ('expired','closed') AND lifecycle_status='expired')) AND NOT (:linkedin_status='active' AND expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND (CASE WHEN abs(expiry_date)<10000000000 THEN expiry_date*1000 ELSE expiry_date END)<=(CASE WHEN abs(:__now)<10000000000 THEN :__now*1000 ELSE :__now END) AND :expiry_date IS NULL)

INSERT INTO hiring_publication_controls(requisition_id,paused) SELECT :requisition_id,CASE WHEN :linkedin_status='paused' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM hiring_job_publications j WHERE j.requisition_id=:requisition_id AND j.organization_id=:organization_id AND j.brand_id=:brand_id AND j.version=:expected_version+1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND p.requisition_id IS NULL) AND changes()=1 ON CONFLICT(requisition_id) DO UPDATE SET paused=excluded.paused

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at,object_type,object_id,redacted_summary) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,'requisition.linkedin_status_recorded',:__user_id,:operation_id,(CASE WHEN abs(:__now)<10000000000 THEN :__now*1000 ELSE :__now END),'requisition',:requisition_id,:reason WHERE changes()=1

INSERT INTO mcp_audit_log(id,organization_id,brand_id,entity_id,timestamp,tool_name,input_json,result_status,result_summary,affected_entity_ids_json,operation_id) SELECT lower(hex(randomblob(16))),:organization_id,:brand_id,:requisition_id,(CASE WHEN abs(:__now)<10000000000 THEN :__now*1000 ELSE :__now END),'record_linkedin_status',json_object('requisition_id',:requisition_id,'expected_version',:expected_version,'operation_id',:operation_id),'completed','Publication changed',json_array(:requisition_id),:operation_id WHERE changes()=1 AND :__user_id IS NOT NULL

tools.name: get_job_linkedin_status
tools.description: Read the effective lifecycle status, current LinkedIn job ID, expiry date (Unix milliseconds), and expected publication version.
tools.sql: SELECT j.requisition_id,j.linkedin_job_id,(CASE WHEN abs(j.expiry_date)<10000000000 THEN j.expiry_date*1000 ELSE j.expiry_date END) AS expiry_date,j.version AS expected_version,CASE WHEN j.lifecycle_status='expired' THEN 'expired' WHEN j.lifecycle_status='closed' OR j.status='closed' THEN 'closed' WHEN pc.paused=1 THEN 'paused' WHEN j.status='published' THEN 'published' ELSE 'draft' END AS status FROM hiring_job_publications j LEFT JOIN hiring_publication_controls pc ON pc.requisition_id=j.requisition_id WHERE j.requisition_id=:requisition_id AND j.organization_id=:organization_id AND j.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=:organization_id AND p.brand_id=:brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=:requisition_id)) LIMIT 1

tools.name: find_job_by_linkedin_id
tools.description: Search current and historical LinkedIn job IDs within an authorized brand; expected_version is the publication version.
tools.sql: SELECT j.requisition_id,j.linkedin_job_id,(CASE WHEN abs(j.expiry_date)<10000000000 THEN j.expiry_date*1000 ELSE j.expiry_date END) AS expiry_date,j.version AS expected_version,CASE WHEN j.lifecycle_status='expired' THEN 'expired' WHEN j.lifecycle_status='closed' OR j.status='closed' THEN 'closed' WHEN pc.paused=1 THEN 'paused' WHEN j.status='published' THEN 'published' ELSE 'draft' END AS status FROM hiring_job_publications j LEFT JOIN hiring_publication_controls pc ON pc.requisition_id=j.requisition_id WHERE j.organization_id=:organization_id AND j.brand_id=:brand_id AND (j.linkedin_job_id=:linkedin_job_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_linkedin_repost_history h WHERE h.requisition_id=j.requisition_id AND h.previous_linkedin_job_id=:linkedin_job_id)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_effective_access p WHERE p.organization_id=j.organization_id AND p.brand_id=j.brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role IN ('owner','recruiter') AND (p.requisition_id IS NULL OR p.requisition_id=j.requisition_id)) ORDER BY j.created_at DESC LIMIT 100

tools.name: complete_application_attachment_upload
tools.description: Uploader records successful private object upload; attachment remains pending_review and unserved.
statements: UPDATE hiring_attachments SET uploaded_at=:__now WHERE id=:attachment_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND application_id=:application_id AND uploader_user_id=:__user_id AND review_status='pending_review' AND scan_state<>'deleted' AND uploaded_at IS NULL AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id)

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at,object_type,object_id,redacted_summary) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'attachment.uploaded',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now,'attachment',:attachment_id,'Private attachment uploaded pending manager review' WHERE changes()=1

tools.name: release_application_attachment
tools.description: Brand owner manually releases one uploaded quarantined attachment after review. Records reviewer and time in the audit trail. No byte-serving capability is issued.
statements: UPDATE hiring_attachments SET review_status='approved',reviewed_by=:__user_id,reviewed_at=:__now WHERE id=:attachment_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND application_id=:application_id AND review_status='pending_review' AND scan_state IN ('pending','clean') AND uploaded_at IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(:operation_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id OR id=:operation_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_effective_access p ON p.organization_id=a.organization_id AND p.brand_id=a.brand_id AND p.user_id=:__user_id AND p.role='owner' AND p.requisition_id IS NULL WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id)

INSERT INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at,object_type,object_id,redacted_summary) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'attachment.released',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now,'attachment',:attachment_id,'Manager released attachment from quarantine' WHERE changes()=1
